English Question: What is the fundamental law of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको मौलिक कानून के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Constitution of Nepal
Explanation: Article 1 declares the Constitution as the fundamental law of Nepal.

English Question: According to the Constitution, in whom is the sovereignty and state authority of Nepal vested?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता तथा राज्यसत्ता कसमा निहित छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Nepalese people
Explanation: Article 2 vests sovereignty and state authority in the Nepalese people.

English Question: How does the Constitution define the nation of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानले नेपाल राष्ट्रलाई कसरी परिभाषित गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): All the Nepalese people with multiethnic, multilingual, multi-religious, multicultural characteristics and geographical diversity, united by common aspirations and allegiance to Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): बहुजातीय, बहुभाषिक, बहुधार्मिक, बहुसांस्कृतिक विशेषता तथा भौगोलिक विविधतासहितका सम्पूर्ण नेपाली जनता, जो राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्रता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, राष्ट्रिय हित र समृद्धिप्रति साझा आकांक्षाद्वारा एकीकृत छन्।
Explanation: Article 3 defines the nation of Nepal.

English Question: Which Article declares the Constitution to be the fundamental law of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानलाई मौलिक कानून घोषणा गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 1
Explanation: Article 1 establishes the Constitution as the fundamental law.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who exercises state authority, and under what framework is it exercised?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यसत्ता कसमा निहित छ, र त्यो कुन आधारमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State authority is vested in the Nepalese people and is exercised in accordance with the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): राज्यसत्ता नेपाली जनतामा निहित हुन्छ र संविधानबमोजिम प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
Explanation: This combines both clauses of Article 2.

English Question: What form of state is Nepal according to Article 4?
Nepali Question: धारा ४ अनुसार नेपाल कस्तो राज्य हो?
Gold Answer (EN): An independent, indivisible, sovereign, secular, inclusive, democratic, socialism-oriented, federal democratic republic.
Gold Answer (NE): स्वतन्त्र, अविभाज्य, सार्वभौम, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, समावेशी, लोकतान्त्रिक, समाजवादउन्मुख, संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र।
Explanation: Article 4(1) defines the nature of the Nepali state.

English Question: How does the Constitution define the term "secular"?
Nepali Question: संविधानले "धर्मनिरपेक्ष" लाई कसरी परिभाषित गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Religious and cultural freedoms, including protection of religion and culture handed down from time immemorial.
Gold Answer (NE): सनातनदेखि चलिआएको धर्म तथा संस्कृतिको संरक्षणसहित धार्मिक तथा सांस्कृतिक स्वतन्त्रता।
Explanation: The explanation to Article 4 provides the constitutional definition of secularism.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what are the two legal consequences of acting contrary to Nepal's national interest?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको राष्ट्रिय हितविपरीत कार्य गरेमा के कानुनी परिणाम हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Such conduct is punishable under federal law because it is contrary to Nepal's national interest.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय हितविपरीत कार्य संघीय कानूनबमोजिम दण्डनीय हुन्छ।
Explanation: Requires connecting Article 5(1), which defines national interest, with Article 5(2), which prescribes punishment.

English Question: What is the difference between the languages of the nation and the official language of Nepal?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रका भाषा र नेपालको सरकारी भाषाबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): All mother tongues spoken in Nepal are languages of the nation, whereas Nepali in the Devanagari script is the official language.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालमा मातृभाषाका रूपमा बोलिने सबै भाषा राष्ट्रका भाषा हुन् भने देवनागरी लिपिमा नेपाली भाषा सरकारी भाषा हो।
Explanation: Compares Articles 6 and 7.

English Question: Which constitutional schedule specifies the method of drawing the national flag of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय झण्डा बनाउने विधि कुन अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedule 1
Explanation: Article 8(2) states that the method of drawing the national flag is set out in Schedule 1.

English Question: What type of citizenship system does Nepal have according to the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालमा कस्तो नागरिकता प्रणालीको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Single federal citizenship with State identity.
Explanation: Article 10(2) establishes a single federal citizenship with State identity.

English Question: Which Article guarantees that no citizen of Nepal shall be deprived of the right to obtain citizenship?
Nepali Question: कुनै पनि नेपाली नागरिकलाई नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकारबाट वञ्चित गर्न नहुने व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 10
Explanation: Article 10(1) guarantees the right to obtain citizenship.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who is eligible to acquire Nepali citizenship by descent at birth?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार जन्मकै आधारमा वंशजको नेपाली नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्न को योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A person whose father or mother was a citizen of Nepal at the time of the person's birth.
Gold Answer (NE): जन्मका बेला बाबु वा आमा नेपाली नागरिक भएको व्यक्ति।
Explanation: Article 11(2)(b) defines citizenship by descent.

English Question: What type of citizenship may a foreign woman married to a Nepali citizen acquire under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: नेपाली नागरिकसँग वैवाहिक सम्बन्ध भएकी विदेशी महिलाले संविधानअनुसार कुन प्रकारको नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्न सक्छिन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Naturalized citizenship of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 11(6) provides for naturalized citizenship.

English Question: Which Article allows a citizenship certificate to be issued in the name of either the mother or the father?
Nepali Question: नागरिकताको प्रमाणपत्र आमा वा बाबुको नामबाट लिन सकिने व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 12
Explanation: Article 12 provides citizenship with identity by the name of either parent.

English Question: What is the difference between citizenship by descent and naturalized citizenship under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार वंशजको नागरिकता र अंगीकृत नागरिकताबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Citizenship by descent is acquired based on constitutional eligibility, while naturalized citizenship is granted in accordance with the Federal law to eligible persons.
Gold Answer (NE): वंशजको नागरिकता संवैधानिक योग्यताका आधारमा प्राप्त हुन्छ भने अंगीकृत नागरिकता संघीय कानूनबमोजिम योग्य व्यक्तिलाई प्रदान गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 11 distinguishes citizenship by descent from naturalized citizenship.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what happens to the citizenship status of a child born in Nepal to a Nepali mother if the child's father is later found to be a foreign citizen?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाली आमाबाट नेपालमा जन्मिएको र बाबुको पहिचान नभएको व्यक्तिको बाबु पछि विदेशी नागरिक भएको पुष्टि भएमा उसको नागरिकतामा के परिवर्तन हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person's citizenship by descent is converted into naturalized citizenship in accordance with the Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो व्यक्तिको वंशजको नागरिकता संघीय कानूनबमोजिम अंगीकृत नागरिकतामा रूपान्तरण गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 11(5) and its proviso establish this rule.

English Question: Which level of government has the authority to grant honorary citizenship of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको मानार्थ नागरिकता प्रदान गर्ने अधिकार कुन तहको सरकारलाई छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Government of Nepal
Explanation: Article 11(9) authorizes the Government of Nepal to grant honorary citizenship in accordance with Federal law.

English Question: Which rights may a non-resident Nepalese citizen enjoy under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकले कुन-कुन अधिकार उपभोग गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Economic, social and cultural rights.
Explanation: Article 14 specifies the rights available to non-resident Nepalese citizens.

English Question: Which Article provides for non-resident Nepalese citizenship?
Nepali Question: गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकताको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 14
Explanation: Article 14 establishes the provision for non-resident Nepalese citizenship.

English Question: Under what condition does a child born to parents who obtained citizenship by birth acquire citizenship by descent upon attaining majority?
Nepali Question: जन्मका आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त गरेका आमाबाबुको सन्तानले वयस्क भएपछि कुन अवस्थामा वंशजको नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): If both the father and the mother are citizens of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): बाबु र आमा दुवै नेपाली नागरिक भएमा।
Explanation: Article 11(3) specifies this condition.

English Question: Which Article provides citizenship by descent to a minor whose parents are unknown?
Nepali Question: बाबु–आमाको ठेगाना नखुलेको नाबालकलाई वंशजको नागरिकता दिने व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 11(4)
Explanation: Article 11(4) covers abandoned minors.

English Question: Until when is a minor with unknown parents considered a citizen of Nepal by descent?
Nepali Question: बाबु–आमाको पहिचान नभएको नाबालकलाई कहिलेसम्म वंशजको नागरिक मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Until the father or mother is traced.
Explanation: Article 11(4).

English Question: What happens to the citizenship status of a child whose parents were initially unknown if one parent is later identified?
Nepali Question: सुरुमा बाबु–आमाको पहिचान नभएको बालकको बाबु वा आमा पछि पत्ता लागेमा उसको नागरिकताको अवस्था के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The temporary presumption of citizenship by descent ends, and citizenship is determined according to the Constitution and Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): वंशजको अस्थायी मान्यता अन्त्य भई संविधान तथा संघीय कानूनबमोजिम नागरिकता निर्धारण हुन्छ।
Explanation: Derived from Article 11(4).

English Question: A child born in Nepal to a Nepali mother whose father is not traced is entitled to which type of citizenship?
Nepali Question: नेपाली आमाबाट नेपालमा जन्मिएको र बाबुको पहिचान नभएको व्यक्तिले कुन प्रकारको नागरिकता पाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Citizenship by descent.
Explanation: Article 11(5).

English Question: Under Article 11(5), what changes if the father of a child born to a Nepali mother is later found to be a foreign citizen?
Nepali Question: धारा ११(५) अनुसार नेपाली आमाबाट जन्मिएको व्यक्तिको बाबु पछि विदेशी नागरिक भएको पुष्टि भएमा के परिवर्तन हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Citizenship by descent is converted into naturalized citizenship in accordance with Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): वंशजको नागरिकता संघीय कानूनबमोजिम अंगीकृत नागरिकतामा रूपान्तरण हुन्छ।
Explanation: Compares the main clause and proviso of Article 11(5).

English Question: Which type of citizenship may a child born to a Nepali mother and a foreign father acquire if permanently residing in Nepal and not holding foreign citizenship?
Nepali Question: नेपाली आमा र विदेशी बाबुबाट जन्मिएको, नेपालमा स्थायी बसोबास गर्ने र विदेशी नागरिकता नलिएको व्यक्तिले कुन नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Naturalized citizenship.
Explanation: Article 11(7).

English Question: Under Article 11(7), when may a child born in Nepal to a Nepali mother and a foreign father obtain citizenship by descent instead of naturalized citizenship?
Nepali Question: धारा ११(७) अनुसार नेपाली आमा र विदेशी बाबुबाट जन्मिएको व्यक्तिले कुन अवस्थामा अंगीकृत होइन, वंशजको नागरिकता पाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): If both the mother and father are Nepali citizens at the time citizenship is acquired.
Gold Answer (NE): नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने समयमा बाबु र आमा दुवै नेपाली नागरिक भएमा।
Explanation: Article 11(7) proviso.

English Question: Which authority may grant naturalized citizenship in cases not specifically covered by Article 11?
Nepali Question: धारा ११ मा उल्लेख नभएका अवस्थामा अंगीकृत नागरिकता दिने अधिकार कसलाई छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 11(8).

English Question: What type of citizenship may the Government of Nepal grant under Article 11(9)?
Nepali Question: धारा ११(९) अनुसार नेपाल सरकारले कुन प्रकारको नागरिकता प्रदान गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Honorary citizenship.
Explanation: Article 11(9).

English Question: What happens to persons domiciled in territory that merges into Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा गाभिएको क्षेत्रमा बसोबास गर्ने व्यक्तिको नागरिकतामा के व्यवस्था हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They become citizens of Nepal, subject to Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय कानूनबमोजिम उनीहरू नेपाली नागरिक बन्छन्।
Explanation: Article 11(10).

English Question: Which Article provides for the acquisition, reacquisition and termination of citizenship?
Nepali Question: नागरिकताको प्राप्ति, पुनःप्राप्ति तथा समाप्तिसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 13.
Explanation: Article 13.

English Question: For what purpose is non-resident Nepali citizenship granted under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकता किन प्रदान गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): To enable eligible persons to enjoy economic, social and cultural rights in accordance with Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): योग्य व्यक्तिले संघीय कानूनबमोजिम आर्थिक, सामाजिक तथा सांस्कृतिक अधिकार उपभोग गर्न सकून् भन्ने उद्देश्यले।
Explanation: Article 14.

English Question: Citizens of which regional organization's member states are not eligible for non-resident Nepali citizenship under Article 14?
Nepali Question: धारा १४ अनुसार कुन क्षेत्रीय संगठनका सदस्य राष्ट्रका नागरिकले गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्न सक्दैनन्?
Gold Answer (EN): South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC).
Explanation: Article 14 excludes citizens residing in SAARC member states.

English Question: Which Article provides for the maintenance of records relating to the identity and citizenship of every citizen of Nepal?
Nepali Question: प्रत्येक नेपाली नागरिकको पहिचान तथा नागरिकतासम्बन्धी अभिलेख राख्ने व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 15.
Explanation: Article 15 provides for citizenship records.

English Question: What fundamental right is guaranteed under Article 16 of the Constitution of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा १६ ले कुन मौलिक हकको सुनिश्चितता गर्दछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Right to live with dignity
Explanation: Article 16 guarantees every person's right to live with dignity.

English Question: According to the Constitution, can any law provide for the death penalty?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुनै कानूनले मृत्युदण्डको व्यवस्था गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. No law shall provide for the death penalty.
Gold Answer (NE): सक्दैन। कुनै पनि कानूनले मृत्युदण्डको व्यवस्था गर्न सक्दैन।
Explanation: Article 16(2) expressly prohibits the death penalty.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the right to live with dignity?
Nepali Question: सम्मानपूर्वक बाँच्न पाउने हकको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 16
Explanation: Article 16 establishes the right to live with dignity.

English Question: According to the Constitution, under what condition may a person be deprived of personal liberty?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुन अवस्थामा कुनै व्यक्तिलाई व्यक्तिगत स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Only in accordance with law.
Explanation: Article 17(1) protects personal liberty except in accordance with law.

English Question: How many specific freedoms are guaranteed to every citizen under Article 17(2)?
Nepali Question: धारा १७(२) अन्तर्गत प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई कति वटा स्वतन्त्रताहरू सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six freedoms
Explanation: Article 17(2) lists six constitutional freedoms.

English Question: Which constitutional freedom allows citizens to form political parties?
Nepali Question: नागरिकलाई राजनीतिक दल गठन गर्न दिने संवैधानिक स्वतन्त्रता कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Freedom to form political parties
Explanation: Article 17(2)(c) guarantees this freedom.

English Question: Which freedom protects peaceful assembly, and which freedom protects the formation of unions and associations?
Nepali Question: कुन स्वतन्त्रताले शान्तिपूर्ण भेला हुन पाउने अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्छ, र कुन स्वतन्त्रताले संघ तथा संस्था गठन गर्न पाउने अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Freedom to assemble peaceably and without arms; Freedom to form unions and associations.
Gold Answer (NE): हतियारविहीन शान्तिपूर्ण भेला हुने स्वतन्त्रता; संघ तथा संस्था गठन गर्ने स्वतन्त्रता।
Explanation: Compares Article 17(2)(b) and Article 17(2)(d).

English Question: According to the Constitution, can the freedom of opinion and expression be reasonably restricted by law?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार विचार तथा अभिव्यक्तिको स्वतन्त्रतामा कानूनद्वारा मनासिब प्रतिबन्ध लगाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes. Reasonable restrictions may be imposed by law under the circumstances specified in the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): सकिन्छ। संविधानमा उल्लेखित अवस्थाहरूमा कानूनद्वारा मनासिब प्रतिबन्ध लगाउन सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 17(2)(a) and its proviso permit reasonable restrictions.

English Question: According to the Constitution, are all citizens equal before the law?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार सबै नागरिक कानूनको दृष्टिमा समान छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes. All citizens are equal before the law.
Gold Answer (NE): हुन्। सबै नागरिक कानूनको दृष्टिमा समान छन्।
Explanation: Article 18(1) establishes equality before the law.

English Question: Name any four grounds on which discrimination is prohibited under Article 18(2).
Nepali Question: धारा १८(२) अनुसार भेदभाव गर्न नहुने कुनै चार आधारहरूको नाम लेख्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Any four of the following: origin, religion, race, caste, tribe, sex, physical condition, health condition, marital status, pregnancy, economic condition, language, region, ideology, or similar grounds.
Gold Answer (NE): निम्नमध्ये कुनै चार: उत्पत्ति, धर्म, जात, जाति, लिङ्ग, शारीरिक अवस्था, स्वास्थ्य अवस्था, वैवाहिक स्थिति, गर्भावस्था, आर्थिक अवस्था, भाषा, क्षेत्र, विचार वा यस्तै अन्य आधार।
Explanation: Article 18(2) lists the prohibited grounds of discrimination.

English Question: Which fundamental right protects the freedom of communication in Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा सञ्चारको स्वतन्त्रताको संरक्षण गर्ने मौलिक हक कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Right to Communication
Explanation: Article 19 guarantees the right to communication.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the Right to Communication?
Nepali Question: सञ्चारसम्बन्धी हकको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 19
Explanation: Article 19 establishes the Right to Communication.

English Question: According to the Constitution, can newspapers or other media be closed merely because they published or broadcast news?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार समाचार प्रकाशित वा प्रसारण गरेको आधारमा मात्र पत्रपत्रिका वा सञ्चारमाध्यम बन्द गर्न पाइन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. Newspapers and other communication media cannot be closed merely for publishing or broadcasting news.
Gold Answer (NE): पाइँदैन। समाचार प्रकाशित वा प्रसारण गरेको आधारमा मात्र सञ्चारमाध्यम बन्द गर्न पाइँदैन।
Explanation: Article 19 protects media from arbitrary closure based solely on published or broadcast content.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what right does every person have when arrested?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार पक्राउ परेका प्रत्येक व्यक्तिलाई कुन अधिकार सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to be informed of the grounds for arrest.
Explanation: Article 20 guarantees procedural rights for arrested persons.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the Rights relating to Justice?
Nepali Question: न्यायसम्बन्धी हकको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 20
Explanation: Article 20 establishes the Rights relating to Justice.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what right does an accused person have regarding legal representation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार अभियुक्तलाई कानुनी प्रतिनिधित्व सम्बन्धी कुन अधिकार प्राप्त छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of their choice.
Gold Answer (NE): आफ्नो रोजाइको कानून व्यवसायीसँग परामर्श गर्न तथा प्रतिरक्षा गराउन पाउने अधिकार।
Explanation: Article 20 guarantees legal representation as a fundamental right.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what information is a victim of crime entitled to receive?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार अपराधपीडितले कुन जानकारी प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकार राख्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Information about the investigation and proceedings of the case.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुसन्धान तथा मुद्दाको कारबाही सम्बन्धी जानकारी।
Explanation: Article 21 guarantees victims access to information about their cases.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the Rights of Victims of Crime?
Nepali Question: अपराधपीडितको हकको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 21
Explanation: Article 21 establishes the Rights of Victims of Crime.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what treatment is prohibited while a person is in custody?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार हिरासतमा रहेको व्यक्तिलाई कस्तो व्यवहार गर्न निषेध गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Torture and cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment.
Gold Answer (NE): यातना तथा क्रूर, अमानवीय वा अपमानजनक व्यवहार।
Explanation: Article 22 prohibits torture and other inhuman treatment in custody.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which Article protects victims of crime, and which Article protects persons against torture while in custody?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुन धाराले अपराधपीडितको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ र कुन धाराले हिरासतमा यातनाविरुद्धको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 21 protects victims of crime, while Article 22 protects persons against torture in custody.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा २१ ले अपराधपीडितको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ भने धारा २२ ले हिरासतमा यातनाविरुद्धको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ।
Explanation: This compares the protections provided by Articles 21 and 22.

English Question: Which constitutional right protects a person against preventive detention except as provided by law?
Nepali Question: कानूनबमोजिम बाहेक प्रतिरोधात्मक नजरबन्दबाट व्यक्तिलाई संरक्षण गर्ने संवैधानिक हक कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Right against Preventive Detention
Explanation: Article 23 protects individuals against preventive detention except in circumstances provided by law.

English Question: Which practice is prohibited under Article 24 of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानको धारा २४ अनुसार कुन प्रथालाई निषेध गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Untouchability and discrimination
Explanation: Article 24 prohibits untouchability and discrimination in any form.

English Question: According to the Constitution, does every citizen have the right to acquire, own, sell and otherwise dispose of property?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई सम्पत्ति आर्जन, स्वामित्व, बिक्री तथा अन्य रूपमा उपयोग वा हस्तान्तरण गर्ने हक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes, subject to law.
Explanation: Article 25 guarantees property rights subject to law.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what does the right to freedom of religion primarily guarantee?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार धर्मसम्बन्धी स्वतन्त्रताको हकले मुख्य रूपमा के सुनिश्चित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The freedom to profess, practice and protect one's religion according to one's faith.
Gold Answer (NE): आफ्नो आस्थाअनुसार धर्म मान्ने, अभ्यास गर्ने तथा संरक्षण गर्ने स्वतन्त्रता।
Explanation: Article 26 guarantees freedom of religion while subject to constitutional limitations.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the Right to Information?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको हक सुनिश्चित गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 27
Explanation: Article 27 establishes the Right to Information.

English Question: Which fundamental right protects the privacy of a person's residence, property, documents, data, correspondence and personal information?
Nepali Question: व्यक्तिको घर, सम्पत्ति, कागजात, तथ्याङ्क, पत्राचार तथा व्यक्तिगत जानकारीको गोपनीयताको संरक्षण गर्ने मौलिक हक कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Right to Privacy
Explanation: Article 28 guarantees the right to privacy.

English Question: Which level of law determines punishment for acts prohibited under the Right against Exploitation?
Nepali Question: शोषणविरुद्धको हक अन्तर्गत निषेध गरिएका कार्यको सजाय कुन तहको कानूनले निर्धारण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal law
Explanation: Article 29 provides that punishment for prohibited acts shall be determined by Federal law.

English Question: Which constitutional right protects a clean environment, and which protects access to health services?
Nepali Question: कुन संवैधानिक हकले स्वच्छ वातावरणको संरक्षण गर्छ र कुन हकले स्वास्थ्य सेवामा पहुँच सुनिश्चित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 30 protects the right to a clean environment, while Article 35 protects the right relating to health.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा ३० ले स्वच्छ वातावरणको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ भने धारा ३५ ले स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ।
Explanation: This compares environmental rights with health rights under the Constitution.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which two groups are guaranteed both free education and compulsory basic education?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार निःशुल्क शिक्षा तथा अनिवार्य आधारभूत शिक्षा दुवैको सुनिश्चितता कुन समूहका लागि गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): All citizens at the basic level.
Explanation: Article 31 guarantees compulsory and free basic education for every citizen.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which two fundamental rights together balance citizens' access to public information and protection of personal information?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार सार्वजनिक सूचनामा पहुँच र व्यक्तिगत जानकारीको संरक्षणबीच सन्तुलन कायम गर्ने दुई मौलिक हक कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Right to Information and the Right to Privacy.
Explanation: Articles 27 and 28 together ensure transparency while protecting personal privacy.

English Question: Which constitutional right guarantees every community the right to preserve and promote its language, script, culture, cultural civilization and heritage?
Nepali Question: प्रत्येक समुदायलाई आफ्नो भाषा, लिपि, संस्कृति, सांस्कृतिक सभ्यता तथा सम्पदाको संरक्षण र प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने हक सुनिश्चित गर्ने संवैधानिक हक कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Right to Language and Culture
Explanation: Article 32 guarantees every community the right to preserve and promote its language and culture.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who has the right to employment?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार रोजगारीको हक कसलाई प्राप्त छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Every citizen
Explanation: Article 33 guarantees every citizen the right to employment.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what does the Right to Labour guarantee to every worker?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार श्रमसम्बन्धी हकले प्रत्येक श्रमिकलाई के सुनिश्चित गर्दछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to appropriate remuneration, facilities and social security, and the right to form and join trade unions in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): उपयुक्त पारिश्रमिक, सुविधा, सामाजिक सुरक्षा तथा कानूनबमोजिम ट्रेड युनियन गठन र त्यसमा सहभागी हुने हक।
Explanation: Article 34 defines the protections available to workers.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what basic health service is guaranteed to every citizen?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई कुन आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Free basic health services.
Explanation: Article 35(1) guarantees free basic health services.

English Question: Which Article guarantees the Right relating to Food?
Nepali Question: खाद्यसम्बन्धी हक सुनिश्चित गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 36
Explanation: Article 36 establishes the Right relating to Food.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what protection does the Right to Housing provide against eviction?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार आवाससम्बन्धी हकले कसरी जबरजस्ती घरबाट हटाउन नपाइने व्यवस्था गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No citizen shall be evicted from the housing owned or occupied by them except in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): कानूनबमोजिम बाहेक कुनै पनि नागरिकलाई निजले बसोबास गरेको वा स्वामित्वमा रहेको आवासबाट बेदखल गर्न पाइँदैन।
Explanation: Article 37 protects citizens from unlawful eviction.

English Question: Which group is specifically guaranteed the right to safe motherhood and reproductive health under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार सुरक्षित मातृत्व तथा प्रजनन स्वास्थ्यको हक विशेष रूपमा कसलाई सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Women
Explanation: Article 38 guarantees women the right to safe motherhood and reproductive health.

English Question: According to the Constitution, every child has the right to what type of identity?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रत्येक बालबालिकालाई कस्तो पहिचानको हक सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Name and birth registration
Explanation: Article 39 guarantees every child the right to name and birth registration.

English Question: Which constitutional Article guarantees the rights of women, and which Article guarantees the rights of children?
Nepali Question: कुन धाराले महिलाको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ र कुन धाराले बालबालिकाको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 38 guarantees the rights of women, while Article 39 guarantees the rights of children.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा ३८ ले महिलाको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ भने धारा ३९ ले बालबालिकाको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ।
Explanation: Compares the protections under Articles 38 and 39.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which Article guarantees the right to constitutional remedies for the enforcement of fundamental rights, and which Article sets out the fundamental duties of citizens?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार मौलिक हकको कार्यान्वयनका लागि संवैधानिक उपचारको हक कुन धाराले सुनिश्चित गर्छ र नागरिकका कर्तव्य कुन धारामा उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 46 guarantees the right to constitutional remedies, while Article 48 sets out the fundamental duties of citizens.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा ४६ ले संवैधानिक उपचारको हक सुनिश्चित गर्छ भने धारा ४८ मा नागरिकका कर्तव्य उल्लेख गरिएको छ।
Explanation: This question requires linking Articles 46 and 48 within Part 3 of the Constitution.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what are the directive principles, policies and obligations intended to serve as?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार निर्देशक सिद्धान्त, नीति तथा दायित्वहरू केका लागि मार्गदर्शक हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Guiding principles for the governance of the State.
Explanation: Article 49(1)

English Question: Which Article states that the directive principles, policies and obligations are guiding principles for the governance of the State?
Nepali Question: निर्देशक सिद्धान्त, नीति तथा दायित्व राज्य सञ्चालनका मार्गदर्शक सिद्धान्त हुन् भन्ने व्यवस्था कुन धाराले गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 49
Explanation: Article 49 establishes this principle.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the political objective of the State?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यको राजनीतिक उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To establish a public welfare system of governance based on justice, the rule of law, fundamental rights, human rights, gender equality, proportional inclusion, participation and social justice.
Gold Answer (NE): न्याय, कानूनी शासन, मौलिक हक, मानव अधिकार, लैङ्गिक समानता, समानुपातिक समावेशिता, सहभागिता तथा सामाजिक न्यायमा आधारित जनकल्याणकारी शासन प्रणाली स्थापना गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 50(1) summarizes the political objective.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what type of economy is the State directed to develop?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यले कस्तो अर्थतन्त्र विकास गर्ने उद्देश्य राखेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A socialism-oriented independent and prosperous economy.
Explanation: Article 50(3).

English Question: Which objective relates to establishing a public welfare system of governance, and which relates to developing a socialism-oriented economy?
Nepali Question: जनकल्याणकारी शासन प्रणाली स्थापना गर्ने उद्देश्य कुन हो र समाजवादउन्मुख अर्थतन्त्र विकास गर्ने उद्देश्य कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The political objective relates to public welfare governance, while the economic objective relates to developing a socialism-oriented economy.
Gold Answer (NE): राजनीतिक उद्देश्य जनकल्याणकारी शासनसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने आर्थिक उद्देश्य समाजवादउन्मुख अर्थतन्त्रसँग सम्बन्धित छ।
Explanation: Compares Article 50(1) and Article 50(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the first policy relating to national unity and national security?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रिय एकता तथा राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षासम्बन्धी पहिलो नीति के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To protect the freedom, sovereignty, territorial integrity and independence of Nepal while keeping national unity intact.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय एकतालाई अक्षुण्ण राख्दै नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता तथा स्वतन्त्रताको संरक्षण गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 51(a)(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which three security organizations are specifically mentioned in the national security policy?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा नीतिमा विशेष रूपमा उल्लेख गरिएका तीन सुरक्षा निकाय कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal Army, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाली सेना, नेपाल प्रहरी र सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल नेपाल।
Explanation: Article 51(a)(5).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which principle guides the relationship between the Federal Units in the system of governance?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार शासन प्रणालीमा संघीय एकाइहरूबीचको सम्बन्ध कुन सिद्धान्तद्वारा निर्देशित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Cooperative federalism.
Explanation: Article 50(1) states that relations between Federal Units shall be maintained on the basis of cooperative federalism.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what principle should be incorporated into the system of governance on the basis of local autonomy and decentralization?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार स्थानीय स्वायत्तता र विकेन्द्रीकरणका आधारमा शासन प्रणालीमा कुन सिद्धान्त समावेश गरिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The principle of proportional participation.
Explanation: Article 50(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the primary objective of Nepal's international relations?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To enhance the dignity of the nation in the world community while safeguarding Nepal's freedom, sovereignty, territorial integrity, independence and national interest.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, स्वतन्त्रता तथा राष्ट्रिय हितको संरक्षण गर्दै विश्व समुदायमा राष्ट्रको प्रतिष्ठा अभिवृद्धि गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 50(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what should remain intact while protecting Nepal's freedom, sovereignty, territorial integrity and independence?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता तथा स्वतन्त्रताको संरक्षण गर्दा केलाई अक्षुण्ण राख्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National unity.
Explanation: Article 51(a)(1) states that national unity shall remain intact while protecting Nepal's sovereignty and independence.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which three dimensions of diversity are specifically mentioned in promoting national unity among communities?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार समुदायहरूबीच राष्ट्रिय एकता प्रवर्द्धन गर्दा कुन तीन प्रकारका विविधतालाई विशेष रूपमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Religion, language and culture.
Explanation: Article 51(a)(2) mentions maintaining cohesion among castes, tribes, religions, languages, cultures and communities.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what kind of security system should the State develop to maintain law and order?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कानून र व्यवस्था कायम गर्न राज्यले कस्तो सुरक्षा प्रणाली विकास गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A national security system.
Explanation: Article 51(a)(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is meant by good governance in the context of public administration?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार सार्वजनिक प्रशासनको सन्दर्भमा सुशासन भन्नाले के जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Public administration that is fair, competent, impartial, transparent, corruption-free, accountable and participatory while ensuring equal and easy access to public services.
Gold Answer (NE): समान तथा सहज सार्वजनिक सेवा पहुँच सुनिश्चित गर्दै निष्पक्ष, सक्षम, पारदर्शी, भ्रष्टाचारमुक्त, उत्तरदायी तथा सहभागितामूलक सार्वजनिक प्रशासन।
Explanation: Article 51(b)(4).

English Question: Which Article contains the State Policies relating to the political and governance system?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक तथा शासन प्रणालीसम्बन्धी राज्यका नीतिहरू कुन धारामा उल्लेख छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 51(b).
Explanation: Article 51(b) sets out policies relating to the political and governance system.

English Question: According to the Constitution, international treaties and agreements to which Nepal is a party should be what?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाल पक्ष भएका अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सन्धि तथा सम्झौताहरूलाई के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They should be implemented.
Explanation: Article 51(b)(3) requires implementation of international treaties and agreements to which Nepal is a party.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which policy promotes studies and research for protecting cultural heritage, and which policy focuses on the development of arts, literature and music?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुन नीतिले सांस्कृतिक सम्पदाको संरक्षणका लागि अध्ययन तथा अनुसन्धानलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छ र कुन नीतिले कला, साहित्य तथा संगीतको विकासमा जोड दिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 51(c)(2) promotes studies and research for cultural heritage, while Article 51(c)(4) focuses on arts, literature and music.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा ५१(ग)(२) ले सांस्कृतिक सम्पदाको अध्ययन तथा अनुसन्धानलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छ भने धारा ५१(ग)(४) ले कला, साहित्य तथा संगीतको विकासमा जोड दिन्छ।
Explanation: Compares two different social and cultural policies.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which three sectors are expected to contribute to enhancing the national economy through partnership?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार साझेदारीमार्फत राष्ट्रिय अर्थतन्त्रलाई सुदृढ बनाउन कुन तीन क्षेत्रको सहभागिता अपेक्षित छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Public, private and cooperative sectors.
Explanation: Article 51(d)(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what two measures are emphasized to make the national economy competitive while protecting consumers' interests?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार उपभोक्ताको हित संरक्षण गर्दै राष्ट्रिय अर्थतन्त्रलाई प्रतिस्पर्धी बनाउन कुन दुई उपायमा जोड दिइएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Maintaining trade fairness and discipline, and eliminating black marketing, monopoly, artificial scarcity and restrictions on competition.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यापारमा निष्पक्षता र अनुशासन कायम गर्ने तथा कालोबजारी, एकाधिकार, कृत्रिम अभाव र प्रतिस्पर्धा सीमित गर्ने गतिविधिको अन्त्य गर्ने।
Explanation: Article 51(d)(7).

English Question: According to the Constitution, for what types of investment should foreign capital and technology be encouraged?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार विदेशी पूँजी तथा प्रविधिगत लगानी मुख्यतया कस्ता क्षेत्रमा प्रोत्साहित गरिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Import substitution, export promotion and infrastructure development, in consonance with the national interest.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय हितअनुकूल आयात प्रतिस्थापन, निर्यात प्रवर्द्धन तथा पूर्वाधार विकासका क्षेत्रमा।
Explanation: Article 51(d)(10).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what existing land ownership system should scientific land reforms end?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार वैज्ञानिक भूमि सुधारले कुन विद्यमान भूमि स्वामित्व प्रणालीको अन्त्य गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Dual land ownership.
Explanation: Article 51(e)(1) states that scientific land reforms should end the dual ownership system.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what are the two primary objectives of land-use policies in agriculture?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कृषिमा भूमि उपयोग नीतिका दुई प्रमुख उद्देश्य के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): To increase agricultural production and productivity, and to promote commercialization, industrialization, diversification and modernization of agriculture.
Gold Answer (NE): कृषि उत्पादन तथा उत्पादकत्व वृद्धि गर्नु तथा कृषिको व्यावसायीकरण, औद्योगिकीकरण, विविधीकरण र आधुनिकीकरणलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 51(e)(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, to what should farmers be provided easy access?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार किसानलाई कुन कुरामा सहज पहुँच उपलब्ध गराइनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Agricultural inputs, agricultural products at fair prices, and markets.
Gold Answer (NE): कृषि सामग्री, उचित मूल्यमा कृषि उत्पादन तथा बजार।
Explanation: Article 51(e)(5).

English Question: Which Article contains the State Policies relating to Development?
Nepali Question: विकाससम्बन्धी राज्यका नीतिहरू कुन धारामा उल्लेख छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 51(f).
Explanation: Article 51(f) outlines development policies.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what type of physical infrastructure should the State develop?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यले कस्तो प्रकारको भौतिक पूर्वाधार विकास गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Balanced, environment-friendly, quality and sustainable physical infrastructure.
Gold Answer (NE): सन्तुलित, वातावरणमैत्री, गुणस्तरीय तथा दिगो भौतिक पूर्वाधार।
Explanation: Article 51(f)(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what two actions should the State take to strengthen information technology for national development?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रिय विकासका लागि सूचना प्रविधिलाई सुदृढ बनाउन राज्यले कुन दुई कार्य गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Develop and expand information technology according to national needs, and make optimum use of information technology in national development.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय आवश्यकताअनुसार सूचना प्रविधिको विकास तथा विस्तार गर्ने र राष्ट्रिय विकासमा यसको अधिकतम उपयोग गर्ने।
Explanation: Article 51(f)(5).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which information system should be developed to manage citizens' information in an integrated manner?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नागरिकको विवरण एकीकृत रूपमा व्यवस्थापन गर्न कुन सूचना प्रणाली विकास गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): An integrated national identity management information system.
Gold Answer (NE): एकीकृत राष्ट्रिय परिचय व्यवस्थापन सूचना प्रणाली।
Explanation: Article 51(f)(7).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which principle gives priority and preferential rights to local communities in the distribution of benefits from natural resources?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्राकृतिक स्रोतबाट प्राप्त लाभको वितरणमा स्थानीय समुदायलाई प्राथमिकता र अग्राधिकार दिने सिद्धान्त कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Priority and preferential rights of local communities.
Explanation: Article 51(g)(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which policy focuses on renewable energy development, and which policy focuses on forest conservation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुन नीतिले नवीकरणीय ऊर्जाको विकासमा जोड दिन्छ र कुन नीतिले वन संरक्षणमा जोड दिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 51(g)(3) focuses on renewable energy, while Article 51(g)(5) focuses on conserving forests, wildlife, birds, vegetation and biodiversity.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा ५१(छ)(३) ले नवीकरणीय ऊर्जामा जोड दिन्छ भने धारा ५१(छ)(५) ले वन, वन्यजन्तु, चराचुरुङ्गी, वनस्पति तथा जैविक विविधताको संरक्षणमा जोड दिन्छ।
Explanation: Compares two environmental policies under Article 51(g).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which environmental principles should guide environmentally sustainable development?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार वातावरणीय दिगो विकास कुन वातावरणीय सिद्धान्तहरूद्वारा निर्देशित हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The polluter pays principle, the precautionary principle, and the principle of prior informed consent.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदूषकले तिर्ने सिद्धान्त, पूर्वसावधानीको सिद्धान्त तथा पूर्वसूचित सहमतिको सिद्धान्त।
Explanation: Article 51(g)(8) explicitly identifies these environmental principles.

English Question: According to the Constitution, how many levels constitute the main structure of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाल संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रको मुख्य राज्य संरचनामा कति तह छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Three levels.
Explanation: Article 56(1) establishes a three-level structure of government.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what are the three levels of government in Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालका सरकारका तीन तह कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Federation, State and Local level.
Explanation: Article 56(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which constitutional values must all three levels of government protect?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार तीनै तहका सरकारले कुन-कुन संवैधानिक मूल्यहरूको संरक्षण गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal's freedom, sovereignty, territorial integrity, independence, national interest, human rights, fundamental rights, rule of law, separation of powers, checks and balances, inclusive representation, equality and the federal democratic republican system.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, स्वतन्त्रता, राष्ट्रिय हित, मानव अधिकार, मौलिक हक, कानूनी शासन, शक्ति पृथकीकरण, नियन्त्रण तथा सन्तुलन, समावेशी प्रतिनिधित्व, समानता तथा संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतान्त्रिक प्रणाली।
Explanation: Article 56(6) lists the constitutional values protected by all levels of government.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what institutions exist under the Local level?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार स्थानीय तह अन्तर्गत कुन-कुन संस्थाहरू रहेका छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Institutions, Municipalities and District Assemblies.
Explanation: Article 56(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, for what two purposes may a Special, Protected or Autonomous Region be established?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार विशेष, संरक्षित वा स्वायत्त क्षेत्र कुन दुई उद्देश्यका लागि स्थापना गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Social and cultural protection, and economic development.
Gold Answer (NE): सामाजिक तथा सांस्कृतिक संरक्षण र आर्थिक विकास।
Explanation: Article 56(5).

English Question: Which Article provides for the distribution of State powers among different levels of government?
Nepali Question: विभिन्न तहका सरकारबीच राज्य शक्तिको बाँडफाँटको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 57.
Explanation: Article 57 distributes legislative powers among the three levels.

English Question: According to the Constitution, in which Schedule are the powers of the Federation enumerated?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार संघका अधिकारहरू कुन अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख गरिएका छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedule 5.
Explanation: Article 57(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which Schedule contains the powers of the Local level, and which Schedule contains the concurrent powers of the Federation, State and Local levels?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार स्थानीय तहका अधिकार कुन अनुसूचीमा छन् र संघ, प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहका साझा अधिकार कुन अनुसूचीमा छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedule 8 contains the powers of the Local level, while Schedule 9 contains the concurrent powers of the Federation, State and Local levels.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुसूची ८ मा स्थानीय तहका अधिकार छन् भने अनुसूची ९ मा संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहका साझा अधिकार छन्।
Explanation: Compares Articles 57(4) and 57(5).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what happens if a State law is inconsistent with a Federal law in matters of concurrent powers?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार साझा अधिकारका विषयमा प्रदेश कानून संघीय कानूनसँग बाझिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The State law is invalid to the extent of the inconsistency.
Gold Answer (NE): बाझिएको हदसम्म प्रदेश कानून अमान्य हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 57(6).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what happens if a law made by a Village Assembly or Municipal Assembly is inconsistent with the relevant State law in matters of concurrent powers?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार साझा अधिकारका विषयमा गाउँसभा वा नगरसभाले बनाएको कानून सम्बन्धित प्रदेश कानूनसँग बाझिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It is invalid to the extent of the inconsistency.
Explanation: Article 57(7).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which level of government exercises residual powers on matters not listed in any constitutional schedule?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुनै पनि संवैधानिक अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख नभएका विषयमा अवशिष्ट अधिकार कुन तहको सरकारलाई हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federation.
Explanation: Article 58 vests residual powers in the Federation.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which three levels of government may formulate and implement policies and plans within their financial jurisdiction?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार आफ्नो वित्तीय अधिकार क्षेत्रभित्र नीति तथा योजना निर्माण र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने तीन तहका सरकार कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federation, State and Local level.
Explanation: Article 59(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what forms may benefits derived from the use of natural resources be distributed to project-affected regions and local communities?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्राकृतिक स्रोतको उपयोगबाट प्राप्त लाभ आयोजना प्रभावित क्षेत्र तथा स्थानीय समुदायलाई कुन-कुन स्वरूपमा वितरण गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Royalty, services or goods.
Explanation: Article 59(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what two conditions govern priority for local community investment in the utilization of natural resources?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्राकृतिक स्रोतको उपयोगमा स्थानीय समुदायको लगानीलाई प्राथमिकता दिन कुन दुई आधारलाई विचार गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The nature of the investment and the size of the investment.
Explanation: Article 59(5).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which level of government has the power to obtain foreign assistance and borrow loans?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार वैदेशिक सहायता प्राप्त गर्ने तथा ऋण लिने अधिकार कुन तहको सरकारलाई छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 59(6).

English Question: Which Article provides for the distribution of sources of revenue among the Federation, State and Local level?
Nepali Question: संघ, प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहबीच राजस्व स्रोतको बाँडफाँटको व्यवस्था गर्ने धारा कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 60.
Explanation: Article 60 governs the distribution of revenue sources.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which constitutional commission recommends the amount of fiscal transfer receivable by the State and Local level?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहले प्राप्त गर्ने वित्तीय हस्तान्तरणको रकम कुन संवैधानिक आयोगले सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोग।
Explanation: Article 60(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who recommends the amount of fiscal transfer to the State and Local level, and who distributes fiscal equalization grants?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहलाई वित्तीय हस्तान्तरणको रकम कसले सिफारिस गर्छ र वित्तीय समानीकरण अनुदान कसले वितरण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission recommends the fiscal transfer amount, while the Government of Nepal distributes fiscal equalization grants.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले वित्तीय हस्तान्तरणको रकम सिफारिस गर्छ भने नेपाल सरकारले वित्तीय समानीकरण अनुदान वितरण गर्छ।
Explanation: Compares Articles 60(3) and 60(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what factors must be considered when enacting a Federal Act on the distribution of revenues?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राजस्व बाँडफाँटसम्बन्धी संघीय कानून बनाउँदा कुन-कुन आधारहरू विचार गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National policies, national requirements, autonomy of State and Local levels, services to the people, financial powers, revenue collection capacity, revenue potential and use, regional balance, poverty and inequality reduction, ending deprivation, and temporary or contingent needs.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय नीति, राष्ट्रिय आवश्यकता, प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहको स्वायत्तता, जनसेवा, वित्तीय अधिकार, राजस्व संकलन क्षमता, राजस्वको सम्भावना र उपयोग, क्षेत्रीय सन्तुलन, गरिबी तथा असमानता न्यूनीकरण, वञ्चितीकरणको अन्त्य तथा अस्थायी वा आकस्मिक आवश्यकता।
Explanation: Article 60(8) lists the considerations for revenue distribution legislation.

English Question: According to the Constitution, how should revenues be distributed among the Federation, State and Local level?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार संघ, प्रदेश तथा स्थानीय तहबीच राजस्व कसरी वितरण गरिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In a balanced and transparent manner.
Explanation: Article 60(7).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who is the head of state of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको राष्ट्रप्रमुख को हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 61(2) states that the President is the head of state.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the main duty of the President of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको राष्ट्रपतिको मुख्य कर्तव्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To abide by and protect the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानको पालना गर्नु तथा यसको संरक्षण गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 61(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, which bodies together form the electoral college for electing the President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपति निर्वाचनका लागि निर्वाचन मण्डल कुन-कुन निकायका सदस्यहरूबाट बनेको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Members of the Federal Parliament and the State Assemblies.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसद् तथा प्रदेश सभाका सदस्यहरू।
Explanation: Article 62(1).

English Question: Which Article provides for the election of the President?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिको निर्वाचन सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन धारामा गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 62.
Explanation: Article 62 governs the election process.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what voting outcome is required for a candidate to be elected President in the first round?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार पहिलो चरणमै राष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित हुन उम्मेदवारले कस्तो मत प्राप्त गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A majority of the then existing total votes of the electoral college.
Gold Answer (NE): निर्वाचन मण्डलका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल मतको बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 62(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what happens if no candidate secures a majority in the first round of the presidential election?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिको निर्वाचनको पहिलो चरणमा कुनै उम्मेदवारले बहुमत प्राप्त नगरेमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A second round is held between the two candidates receiving the highest number of votes.
Gold Answer (NE): सबैभन्दा बढी मत प्राप्त गर्ने दुई उम्मेदवारबीच दोस्रो चरणको मतदान हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 62(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the term of office of the President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिको कार्यकाल कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 63(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the minimum age required to become President, and what is the maximum number of times a person may be elected President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपति बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ र एक व्यक्ति बढीमा कति पटक राष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least 45 years of age, and no more than two terms.
Gold Answer (NE): कम्तीमा ४५ वर्ष उमेर तथा बढीमा दुई पटक।
Explanation: Articles 64(1)(b) and 64(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom does the President submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई बुझाउँछन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Vice-President.
Explanation: Article 65(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, through whom are the recommendations and consent of the Council of Ministers submitted to the President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिस तथा सहमति राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष कसमार्फत प्रस्तुत गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Through the Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 66(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who performs the functions of the President during the President's absence?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिको अनुपस्थितिमा राष्ट्रपतिको कार्य कसले सम्पादन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Vice-President.
Explanation: Article 67(2) provides that the Vice-President performs the functions of the President during the President's absence.

English Question: Which Article provides that the qualifications, election procedure and term of office of the Vice-President shall be the same as those of the President?
Nepali Question: उपराष्ट्रपतिको योग्यता, निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया र कार्यकाल राष्ट्रपतिको जस्तै हुने व्यवस्था कुन धारामा गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 69.
Explanation: Article 69 states that these provisions are the same as those applicable to the President.

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom does the Vice-President submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार उपराष्ट्रपतिले आफ्नो लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई बुझाउँछन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 68(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom does the President submit a resignation, and to whom does the Vice-President submit a resignation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले कसलाई राजीनामा दिन्छन् र उपराष्ट्रपतिले कसलाई राजीनामा दिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President resigns to the Vice-President, while the Vice-President resigns to the President.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले उपराष्ट्रपतिलाई राजीनामा दिन्छन् भने उपराष्ट्रपतिले राष्ट्रपतिलाई राजीनामा दिन्छन्।
Explanation: Compares Articles 65(a) and 68(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, before whom does the President take the oath of office and secrecy?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसको समक्ष लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Justice.
Explanation: Article 71.

English Question: According to the Constitution, before whom does the Vice-President take the oath of office and secrecy?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार उपराष्ट्रपतिले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसको समक्ष लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 71.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what principle must be ensured when electing the President and the Vice-President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपतिको निर्वाचन गर्दा कुन प्रतिनिधित्वको सिद्धान्त सुनिश्चित गरिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They must represent different sex or different community.
Gold Answer (NE): फरक लिङ्ग वा फरक समुदायको प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 70 requires representation of different sex or community.

English Question: According to the Constitution, if a person holding a political office filled by election, nomination or appointment is appointed as the Vice-President, what happens to that office?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार निर्वाचन, मनोनयन वा नियुक्तिबाट प्राप्त राजनीतिक पदमा रहेको व्यक्ति उपराष्ट्रपति नियुक्त भएमा उसको अघिल्लो पदको के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The previous office becomes vacant automatically.
Explanation: Article 67(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what arrangements must the Government of Nepal make for the offices of the President and Vice-President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपति तथा उपराष्ट्रपतिको कार्यालयका लागि नेपाल सरकारले के व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It shall provide the necessary employees and other arrangements required for the functioning of the offices.
Gold Answer (NE): कार्यालय सञ्चालनका लागि आवश्यक कर्मचारी तथा अन्य आवश्यक व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 73(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, how many separate offices are established for the President and the Vice-President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपतिका लागि कति छुट्टाछुट्टै कार्यालय रहने व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Two separate offices.
Explanation: Article 73(1) provides that separate offices shall exist for the President and the Vice-President.

English Question: According to the Constitution, what form of government does Nepal have?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालमा कस्तो प्रकारको शासन प्रणाली रहेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A multi-party, competitive, federal, democratic, republican, parliamentary form of government based on pluralism.
Gold Answer (NE): बहुदलीय, प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक, संघीय, लोकतान्त्रिक, गणतान्त्रिक तथा बहुलवादमा आधारित संसदीय शासन प्रणाली।
Explanation: Article 74 defines Nepal's form of government.

English Question: According to the Constitution, in whom is the executive power of Nepal vested?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको कार्यकारी शक्ति कसमा निहित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Council of Ministers.
Explanation: Article 75(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who is responsible for issuing general directives and regulating the governance of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको शासन सञ्चालनका लागि सामान्य निर्देशन जारी गर्ने तथा नियन्त्रण र नियमन गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कसको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Council of Ministers.
Explanation: Article 75(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, in whose name are all Federal executive functions performed?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार संघीय कार्यकारी कार्यहरू कसको नाममा सम्पादन गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In the name of the Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 75(3).

English Question: Which Article provides for the constitution of the Council of Ministers?
Nepali Question: मन्त्रिपरिषद्को गठनसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन धारामा गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 76.
Explanation: Article 76 governs the appointment of the Prime Minister and formation of the Council of Ministers.

English Question: According to the Constitution, whom does the President appoint as Prime Minister when a single parliamentary party commands a majority in the House of Representatives?
Nepali Question: प्रतिनिधिसभामा कुनै एक संसदीय दलको स्पष्ट बहुमत भएमा संविधानअनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले कसलाई प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The leader of the parliamentary party commanding the majority in the House of Representatives.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रतिनिधिसभामा बहुमत प्राप्त संसदीय दलको नेता।
Explanation: Article 76(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, if no political party has a majority in the House of Representatives, who may be appointed Prime Minister?
Nepali Question: प्रतिनिधिसभामा कुनै दलको स्पष्ट बहुमत नभएमा संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्री कसलाई नियुक्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A member of the House of Representatives who can command a majority with the support of two or more parties.
Gold Answer (NE): दुई वा दुईभन्दा बढी दलको समर्थनबाट बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने प्रतिनिधिसभाको सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 76(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who appoints the Prime Minister, and on whose recommendation is the Council of Ministers constituted?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्री कसले नियुक्त गर्छन् र मन्त्रिपरिषद् कसको सिफारिसमा गठन हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President appoints the Prime Minister, and the Council of Ministers is constituted on the recommendation of the Prime Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्छन् र प्रधानमन्त्रीको सिफारिसमा मन्त्रिपरिषद् गठन हुन्छ।
Explanation: Compares Articles 76(1) and 76(9).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what is the maximum number of Ministers that may comprise the Council of Ministers, including the Prime Minister?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीसहित मन्त्रिपरिषद्मा बढीमा कति जना मन्त्री रहन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty-five Ministers.
Explanation: Article 76(9).

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom are the Prime Minister and Ministers collectively responsible?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रीहरू सामूहिक रूपमा कसप्रति उत्तरदायी हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federal Parliament.
Explanation: Article 76(10).

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom does the Prime Minister submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीले आफ्नो लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई बुझाउँछन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 77(1)(a) provides that the Prime Minister resigns by submitting a written resignation to the President.

English Question: According to the Constitution, to whom does a Minister submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार मन्त्रीले आफ्नो लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई बुझाउँछन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 77(2)(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what happens to the Council of Ministers if the office of the Prime Minister becomes vacant?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीको पद रिक्त भएमा मन्त्रिपरिषद्को के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The same Council of Ministers continues to function until a new Council of Ministers is constituted.
Gold Answer (NE): नयाँ मन्त्रिपरिषद् गठन नभएसम्म सोही मन्त्रिपरिषद्ले कार्य सञ्चालन गरिरहन्छ।
Explanation: Article 77(3).

English Question: According to the Constitution, if the Prime Minister dies, who acts as the Prime Minister until a new Prime Minister is appointed?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीको मृत्यु भएमा नयाँ प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त नभएसम्म कार्यवाहक प्रधानमन्त्रीको रूपमा कसले काम गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The senior-most Minister.
Explanation: Proviso to Article 77(3).

English Question: Which Article allows a person who is not a member of the Federal Parliament to be appointed as a Minister?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसद्को सदस्य नभएको व्यक्तिलाई मन्त्री नियुक्त गर्न सकिने व्यवस्था कुन धारामा गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 78.
Explanation: Article 78 provides this exception.

English Question: According to the Constitution, within how many months must a Minister who is not a member of the Federal Parliament obtain membership?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसद्को सदस्य नभएको मन्त्रीले कति महिनाभित्र संसद्को सदस्यता प्राप्त गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within six months.
Explanation: Article 78(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, on whose recommendation may the President appoint a person who is not a member of the Federal Parliament as a Minister?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार संघीय संसद्को सदस्य नभएको व्यक्तिलाई मन्त्री नियुक्त गर्दा राष्ट्रपतिले कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): On the recommendation of the Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 78(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who receives the resignation of the Prime Minister, and who receives the resignation of a Minister?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीको राजीनामा कसले प्राप्त गर्छ र मन्त्रीको राजीनामा कसले प्राप्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President receives the Prime Minister's resignation, while the Prime Minister receives a Minister's resignation.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीको राजीनामा प्राप्त गर्छन् भने प्रधानमन्त्रीले मन्त्रीको राजीनामा प्राप्त गर्छन्।
Explanation: Compares Articles 77(1)(a) and 77(2)(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, is a person who was defeated in the election to the current House of Representatives eligible to be appointed as a Minister during the term of that House?
Nepali Question: वर्तमान प्रतिनिधिसभाको निर्वाचनमा पराजित भएको व्यक्ति सोही प्रतिनिधिसभाको कार्यकालमा मन्त्री नियुक्त हुन योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. A person defeated in the election to the current House of Representatives is not eligible to be appointed as a Minister during that House's term.
Gold Answer (NE): हुँदैन। वर्तमान प्रतिनिधिसभाको निर्वाचनमा पराजित व्यक्ति सोही प्रतिनिधिसभाको कार्यकालभर मन्त्री नियुक्त हुन योग्य हुँदैन।
Explanation: Article 78(4).

English Question: According to the Constitution, by what type of law are the remuneration and other facilities of the Prime Minister and Ministers provided?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रीहरूको पारिश्रमिक तथा अन्य सुविधा कुन प्रकारको कानुनद्वारा निर्धारण गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A Federal Act.
Explanation: Article 79. Until such an Act is enacted, they are as specified by the Government of Nepal.

English Question: According to the Constitution, before whom does the Prime Minister take the oath of office and secrecy?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसको समक्ष लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 80 provides that the Prime Minister takes the oath before the President.

English Question: According to the Constitution, before whom do Ministers of State and Assistant Ministers take the oath of office and secrecy?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यमन्त्री तथा सहायक मन्त्रीहरूले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसको समक्ष लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 80 distinguishes between Cabinet Ministers and Ministers of State/Assistant Ministers.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who administers the oath of office to the Prime Minister, and who administers the oath to Ministers of State and Assistant Ministers?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीलाई पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसले गराउँछ र राज्यमन्त्री तथा सहायक मन्त्रीलाई कसले शपथ गराउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President administers the oath to the Prime Minister, while the Prime Minister administers the oath to Ministers of State and Assistant Ministers.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीलाई शपथ गराउँछन् भने प्रधानमन्त्रीले राज्यमन्त्री तथा सहायक मन्त्रीलाई शपथ गराउँछन्।
Explanation: Compares the oath-taking authorities under Article 80.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who must inform the President about the resolutions of the Council of Ministers?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार मन्त्रिपरिषद्का निर्णयहरूको जानकारी राष्ट्रपतिलाई कसले गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 81(a).

English Question: According to the Constitution, who has the duty to inform the President about Bills to be introduced in the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार संघीय संसद्मा पेश गरिने विधेयकहरूको जानकारी राष्ट्रपतिलाई गराउने दायित्व कसको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 81(b).

English Question: According to the Constitution, what information regarding the country's affairs must the Prime Minister provide to the President?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रधानमन्त्रीले राष्ट्रपतिलाई देशको अवस्थासम्बन्धी कुन जानकारी दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The current general state of affairs of the country and matters concerning foreign relations.
Gold Answer (NE): देशको समसामयिक सामान्य अवस्था तथा वैदेशिक सम्बन्धसम्बन्धी विषयहरू।
Explanation: Article 81(d).

English Question: Which Article governs the transaction of the business of the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारको कार्य सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन धारामा गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 82.
Explanation: Article 82 governs the transaction of government business.

English Question: According to the Constitution, in accordance with what are the business of the Government of Nepal allocated and transacted?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाल सरकारको कार्य कुन आधारमा बाँडफाँट र सञ्चालन गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In accordance with the rules approved by the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारले स्वीकृत गरेका नियमहरू अनुसार।
Explanation: Article 82(1).

English Question: According to the Constitution, can a court question whether the rules governing the transaction of the Government of Nepal's business have been observed?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाल सरकारको कार्य सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी नियमहरूको पालना भएको वा नभएको विषयमा अदालतमा प्रश्न उठाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. No question may be raised in any court regarding whether those rules have been observed.
Gold Answer (NE): सकिँदैन। ती नियमहरूको पालना भएको वा नभएको विषयमा कुनै अदालतमा प्रश्न उठाउन सकिँदैन।
Explanation: Article 82(2).

English Question: According to the Constitution, besides the resolutions of the Council of Ministers and Bills to be introduced in the Federal Parliament, name one additional category of information that the Prime Minister must provide to the President.
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार मन्त्रिपरिषद्का निर्णय र संघीय संसद्मा पेश गरिने विधेयकबाहेक प्रधानमन्त्रीले राष्ट्रपतिलाई उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्ने थप जानकारीमध्ये एउटा उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Either (i) other necessary information requested by the President regarding those matters, or (ii) the current general state of affairs of the country and matters concerning foreign relations.
Gold Answer (NE): (१) ती विषयमा राष्ट्रपतिले मागेको अन्य आवश्यक जानकारी, वा (२) देशको समसामयिक सामान्य अवस्था तथा वैदेशिक सम्बन्धसम्बन्धी जानकारी।
Explanation: Requires integrating Article 81(c) and 81(d), making it a controlled multi-clause factual question.

English Question: According to the Constitution, in which House may a Money Bill be introduced?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार धन विधेयक कुन सदनमा मात्र प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): House of Representatives only.
Explanation: Article 110(1) provides that a Money Bill may be introduced only in the House of Representatives.

English Question: Can a Money Bill be introduced as a non-government Bill?
Nepali Question: के धन विधेयक गैर-सरकारी विधेयकका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. It may be introduced only as a Government Bill.
Gold Answer (NE): सकिँदैन। यो सरकारको विधेयकका रूपमा मात्र प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 110(2) requires every Money Bill to be introduced only as a Government Bill.

English Question: Bills concerning which security bodies must be introduced only as Government Bills?
Nepali Question: कुन सुरक्षा निकायसँग सम्बन्धित विधेयकहरू सरकारको विधेयकका रूपमा मात्र प्रस्तुत गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal Army, Nepal Police, and Armed Police Force, Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाली सेना, नेपाल प्रहरी र सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल।
Explanation: Article 110(2) specifies these security bodies.

English Question: Who makes the final decision on whether a Bill is a Money Bill?
Nepali Question: कुनै विधेयक धन विधेयक हो वा होइन भन्ने अन्तिम निर्णय कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker.
Explanation: Article 110(4) states that the Speaker's decision is final.

English Question: Does a Bill become a Money Bill solely because it imposes licence fees, application fees, renewal fees, fines, or imprisonment penalties?
Nepali Question: के इजाजतपत्र शुल्क, निवेदन शुल्क, नवीकरण शुल्क, जरिवाना वा कैद सजायको व्यवस्था भएकै कारण कुनै विधेयक धन विधेयक मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 110(3) explicitly excludes such Bills from being treated as Money Bills solely on that basis.

English Question: Within how many days must the National Assembly return a Money Bill received from the House of Representatives with suggestions, if any?
Nepali Question: प्रतिनिधि सभाबाट प्राप्त धन विधेयक राष्ट्रिय सभाले सुझावसहित कति दिनभित्र फिर्ता गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 111(2) fixes a fifteen-day period.

English Question: What may the House of Representatives do if the National Assembly does not return a Money Bill within fifteen days?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सभाले धन विधेयक पन्ध्र दिनभित्र फिर्ता नगरे प्रतिनिधि सभाले के गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may present the Bill to the President for assent.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष स्वीकृतिका लागि विधेयक प्रस्तुत गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 111(4) permits the House of Representatives to present the Bill directly for assent after fifteen days.

English Question: Within what period must the National Assembly return a Bill other than a Money Bill received from the House of Representatives?
Nepali Question: प्रतिनिधि सभाबाट प्राप्त धन विधेयक बाहेकको विधेयक राष्ट्रिय सभाले कति अवधिभित्र फिर्ता गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within two months.
Explanation: Article 111(5) prescribes a two-month period.

English Question: If the National Assembly fails to return a non-Money Bill within two months, what majority is required in the House of Representatives to present it to the President for assent?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सभाले धन विधेयक बाहेकको विधेयक दुई महिनाभित्र फिर्ता नगरे, राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष स्वीकृतिका लागि पठाउन प्रतिनिधि सभामा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A majority of the total number of its existing members.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रतिनिधि सभाका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य सङ्ख्याको बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 111(5) specifies the required majority.

English Question: Which type of Bill is excluded from the procedures under Article 111(6) regarding rejection or amendment by the other House?
Nepali Question: अर्को सदनबाट अस्वीकृत वा संशोधन गरिने प्रक्रियाबाट कुन प्रकारको विधेयक बाहिर राखिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A Money Bill.
Explanation: Article 111(6) applies to Bills other than Money Bills.

English Question: Which House presents a Bill to the President after it is passed in a joint sitting of both Houses?
Nepali Question: दुवै सदनको संयुक्त बैठकबाट विधेयक पारित भएपछि राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष कुन सदनले विधेयक प्रस्तुत गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The House in which the Bill originated.
Explanation: Article 111(9) assigns this responsibility to the originating House.

English Question: Does the prorogation of a House stop deliberations on a Bill?
Nepali Question: कुनै सदनको अधिवेशन अन्त्य भएमा विधेयकमाथिको विचार रोकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. Deliberations may continue in the succeeding session.
Gold Answer (NE): रोकिँदैन। अर्को अधिवेशनमा विचार जारी रहन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 111(10) permits deliberations to continue in the succeeding session.

English Question: What happens to a Bill introduced in the House of Representatives if that House is dissolved or its term expires while the Bill is under consideration?
Nepali Question: प्रतिनिधि सभामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको विधेयक विचाराधीन अवस्थामै प्रतिनिधि सभा विघटन भए वा कार्यकाल समाप्त भए के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Bill lapses.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 111(10) states that such a Bill lapses.

English Question: Who may withdraw a Bill, subject to the approval of the House?
Nepali Question: सदनको स्वीकृतिसहित विधेयक कसले फिर्ता लिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person who introduced the Bill.
Explanation: Article 112 authorizes the proposer of the Bill to withdraw it with House approval.

English Question: Within how many days must the President give assent to a Bill submitted under Article 113, unless it is returned for reconsideration?
Nepali Question: धारा ११३ बमोजिम पेश गरिएको विधेयकमा पुनर्विचारका लागि फिर्ता नगरिएमा राष्ट्रपतिले कति दिनभित्र स्वीकृति दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 113(2) requires assent within fifteen days.

English Question: Can the President return a Money Bill for reconsideration?
Nepali Question: के राष्ट्रपतिले धन विधेयक पुनर्विचारका लागि फिर्ता पठाउन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 113(3) allows reconsideration only for Bills other than Money Bills.

English Question: Under what condition may the President promulgate an Ordinance?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिले कुन अवस्थामा अध्यादेश जारी गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): When both Houses are not in session and immediate action is necessary, on the recommendation of the Council of Ministers.
Gold Answer (NE): दुवै सदन अधिवेशनमा नरहेको र तत्काल कार्य गर्न आवश्यक भएको अवस्थामा मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिसमा।
Explanation: Article 114(1) specifies these constitutional conditions.

English Question: Unless it is earlier repealed or becomes ineffective, after how many days from the commencement of a meeting of both Houses does an Ordinance cease to be effective?
