Nepali Question: पहिले नै खारेज वा निष्प्रभावी नभएमा, दुवै सदनको बैठक प्रारम्भ भएको दिनदेखि कति दिनपछि अध्यादेश स्वतः निष्प्रभावी हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty days.
Explanation: Article 114(2)(c) provides that an Ordinance automatically ceases to be effective after sixty days from the relevant meeting of both Houses.

English Question: According to the Constitution, can a tax be levied except in accordance with law?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कानुनबाहेक कर लगाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. A tax may be levied only in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): हुँदैन। कानुनबमोजिम मात्र कर लगाउन सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 115(1) requires taxes to be levied only in accordance with law.

English Question: Under what legal authority may the Government of Nepal raise loans or provide guarantees?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारले ऋण उठाउन वा जमानत दिन कुन कानुनी आधार आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Only as provided by Federal law.
Explanation: Article 115(2) limits government borrowing and guarantees to Federal law.

English Question: What is the name of the government fund into which most federal revenues are credited?
Nepali Question: अधिकांश संघीय राजस्व जम्मा हुने सरकारी कोषको नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federal Consolidated Fund.
Explanation: Article 116 establishes the Federal Consolidated Fund.

English Question: Which type of revenue is excluded from being credited to the Federal Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: संघीय सञ्चित कोषमा जम्मा नगर्ने राजस्व कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Revenues of trusts (Guthi).
Explanation: Article 116 expressly excludes Guthi revenues.

English Question: Name one circumstance in which expenditure may legally be incurred from the Federal Consolidated Fund.
Nepali Question: संघीय सञ्चित कोषबाट खर्च गर्न मिल्ने एउटा संवैधानिक अवस्था उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): For example, expenditure authorized under a Federal Appropriation Act.
Gold Answer (NE): उदाहरणका लागि, संघीय विनियोजन ऐनद्वारा स्वीकृत खर्च।
Explanation: Article 117 lists the constitutionally permitted expenditures.

English Question: Which Article governs matters relating to the Federal Contingency Fund, even though Article 117 discusses expenditures?
Nepali Question: खर्चसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था Article 117 मा भए पनि संघीय आकस्मिक कोषसम्बन्धी विषय कुन धाराले नियमन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 124.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 117 specifically refers to Article 124.

English Question: Does expenditure charged on the Federal Consolidated Fund require approval of the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संघीय सञ्चित कोषमा भारित खर्चका लागि संघीय संसदको स्वीकृति आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 118 states that charged expenditures do not require parliamentary approval.

English Question: Which constitutional office holders' remuneration is charged on the Federal Consolidated Fund under Article 118(a)?
Nepali Question: धारा ११८(क) अनुसार संघीय सञ्चित कोषमा भारित हुने पारिश्रमिक कुन पदाधिकारीहरूको हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The President and the Vice-President.
Explanation: Article 118(a) specifies these constitutional offices.

English Question: Are administrative expenses of the Supreme Court charged on the Federal Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतका प्रशासनिक खर्चहरू संघीय सञ्चित कोषमा भारित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 118(f) includes administrative expenses of the Supreme Court.

English Question: Which Minister presents the annual estimates of revenues and expenditures before the joint sitting of the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसदको संयुक्त बैठकमा वार्षिक आय–व्ययको अनुमान कसले पेश गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Minister for Finance.
Explanation: Article 119(1) assigns this responsibility to the Minister for Finance.

English Question: Before which parliamentary body are the annual estimates of revenues and expenditures presented?
Nepali Question: वार्षिक आय–व्ययको अनुमान संघीय संसदको कुन निकायसमक्ष पेश गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The joint sitting of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनको संयुक्त बैठकसमक्ष।
Explanation: Article 119(1) specifies a joint sitting of both Houses.

English Question: On which date must the Minister for Finance present the annual estimates of revenues and expenditures?
Nepali Question: अर्थमन्त्रीले वार्षिक आय–व्ययको अनुमान प्रत्येक वर्ष कुन मितिमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): On the 15th day of Jesta (mid-May).
Explanation: Article 119(3) fixes the constitutional budget presentation date.

English Question: Besides revenue and expenditure estimates, what additional information must accompany the annual estimate?
Nepali Question: आय–व्ययको अनुमानसँगै थप कुन विवरण अनिवार्य रूपमा प्रस्तुत गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A statement of the previous year's ministry-wise expenses and whether the objectives of those expenditures were achieved.
Gold Answer (NE): अघिल्लो आर्थिक वर्षका मन्त्रालयगत खर्च र तिनका उद्देश्य पूरा भए वा नभएको विवरण।
Explanation: Article 119(2) requires performance information alongside budget estimates.

English Question: In which Bill are expenditures under an Appropriation Act specified?
Nepali Question: विनियोजन ऐनअन्तर्गतका खर्च कुन विधेयकमा उल्लेख गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Appropriation Bill.
Explanation: Article 120 provides this requirement.

English Question: Mention one constitutional circumstance in which the Minister for Finance may present a supplementary estimate.
Nepali Question: अर्थमन्त्रीले कुन अवस्थामा पूरक अनुमान पेश गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): For example, when the amount authorized for a service is insufficient.
Gold Answer (NE): उदाहरणका लागि, कुनै सेवाका लागि स्वीकृत रकम अपर्याप्त भएमा।
Explanation: Article 121(1) lists the circumstances permitting supplementary estimates.

English Question: What is the maximum amount that may be authorized through a Vote on Account?
Nepali Question: लेखानुदानमार्फत अधिकतम कति रकम स्वीकृत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It shall not exceed one-third of the estimated expenditure for the financial year.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्षको अनुमानित खर्चको एक-तिहाइभन्दा बढी हुन सक्दैन।
Explanation: Article 122(2) sets the constitutional limit.

English Question: Which constitutional document must be presented before a Vote on Account Bill can be introduced?
Nepali Question: लेखानुदान विधेयक पेश गर्नुअघि कुन संवैधानिक दस्तावेज अनिवार्य रूपमा पेश गरिएको हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The annual estimates of revenues and expenditures under Article 119.
Explanation: Article 122(2) links the Vote on Account to Article 119.

English Question: Under what type of circumstances may a Vote of Credit Bill be introduced?
Nepali Question: कस्ता परिस्थितिमा Vote of Credit विधेयक पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): During emergencies when it is impractical or inexpedient to specify expenditure details.
Gold Answer (NE): खर्चको विस्तृत विवरण दिन व्यावहारिक वा उपयुक्त नहुने आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा।
Explanation: Article 123 defines the purpose of a Vote of Credit Bill.

English Question: Who controls the Federal Contingency Fund?
Nepali Question: संघीय आकस्मिक कोषको नियन्त्रण कसको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 124(2) vests control of the fund in the Government of Nepal.

English Question: What must happen after money is spent from the Federal Contingency Fund?
Nepali Question: संघीय आकस्मिक कोषबाट खर्च भएपछि त्यस रकमबारे के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The amount must be reimbursed as soon as possible in accordance with Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय कानुनबमोजिम सकेसम्म चाँडो प्रतिपूर्ति गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 124(3) requires reimbursement of contingency expenditures.

English Question: According to the Constitution, which three courts constitute Nepal's judiciary?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपालको न्यायपालिकामा कुन तीन तहका अदालतहरू छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Supreme Court, High Court, and District Court.
Gold Answer (NE): सर्वोच्च अदालत, उच्च अदालत र जिल्ला अदालत।
Explanation: Article 127 defines the three levels of courts.

English Question: Does the Constitution allow judicial bodies at the local level?
Nepali Question: के संविधानले स्थानीय तहमा न्यायिक निकाय गठन गर्न अनुमति दिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes, judicial bodies may be formed at the local level as provided by law.
Gold Answer (NE): हो, कानुनबमोजिम स्थानीय तहमा न्यायिक निकाय गठन गर्न सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 127(2).

English Question: Which court has the final authority to interpret the Constitution and laws?
Nepali Question: संविधान र कानुनको अन्तिम व्याख्या गर्ने अधिकार कुन अदालतलाई छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Supreme Court.
Explanation: Article 128(2).

English Question: Excluding the Chief Justice, what is the maximum number of Supreme Court Judges?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीशबाहेक सर्वोच्च अदालतमा अधिकतम कति न्यायाधीश हुन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty.
Explanation: Article 129(1).

English Question: Who appoints the Chief Justice?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीशलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 129(2).

English Question: Which body recommends the appointment of the Chief Justice, and which body recommends Supreme Court Judges?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीश र सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्ने निकाय फरक–फरक कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Constitutional Council recommends the Chief Justice, while the Judicial Council recommends Supreme Court Judges.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रधानन्यायाधीशका लागि संवैधानिक परिषद् र सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशका लागि न्याय परिषद्।
Explanation: Article 129(2).

English Question: How many years must a Supreme Court Judge have served before becoming eligible for appointment as Chief Justice?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीश बन्न सर्वोच्च अदालतको न्यायाधीशले कम्तीमा कति वर्ष सेवा गरेको हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least three years.
Explanation: Article 129(3).

English Question: Name any three alternative qualifications for appointment as a Supreme Court Judge.
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतको न्यायाधीश बन्नका लागि वैकल्पिक योग्यतामध्ये कुनै तीन उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Any three among: High Court Judge for 5 years, advocate/senior advocate for 15 years, distinguished jurist for 15 years, Judicial Service first-class officer for 12 years.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानमा उल्लेखित चार वैकल्पिक योग्यतामध्ये कुनै तीन।
Explanation: Article 129(5).

English Question: Who acts as Chief Justice if the Chief Justice is absent or the office is vacant?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीश अनुपस्थित वा पद रिक्त भए कसले कार्यवाहक प्रधानन्यायाधीशको रूपमा काम गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The senior-most Judge of the Supreme Court.
Explanation: Article 129(6).

English Question: At what age does a Supreme Court Judge retire?
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशको अनिवार्य अवकाश उमेर कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty-five years.
Explanation: Article 131(b).

English Question: Can the Supreme Court declare a law void if it is inconsistent with the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानसँग बाझिने कानुनलाई सर्वोच्च अदालतले बदर गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 133(1).

English Question: Name any three writs that the Supreme Court may issue.
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतले जारी गर्न सक्ने कुनै तीन रिटको नाम लेख्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Any three of: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Certiorari, Prohibition, Quo Warranto.
Gold Answer (NE): हेबियस कर्पस, परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, निषेधाज्ञा, अधिकार पृच्छामध्ये कुनै तीन।
Explanation: Article 133(3).

English Question: How many judges constitute the Constitutional Bench?
Nepali Question: संवैधानिक इजलासमा कति जना न्यायाधीश हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five judges including the Chief Justice.
Explanation: Article 137(1).

English Question: Which bench settles disputes relating to jurisdiction between the Federation and States?
Nepali Question: संघ र प्रदेशबीचको अधिकारक्षेत्रसम्बन्धी विवाद कुन इजलासले टुंग्याउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court.
Explanation: Article 137(2).

English Question: How many High Courts are established under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कति उच्च अदालत रहने व्यवस्था छ?
Gold Answer (EN): One in each State.
Explanation: Article 139(1).

English Question: Who appoints the Chief Judge of a High Court?
Nepali Question: उच्च अदालतका मुख्य न्यायाधीशलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Justice on the recommendation of the Judicial Council.
Explanation: Article 140(1).

English Question: Compare the retirement ages of Supreme Court Judges and High Court Judges.
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालत र उच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशको अनिवार्य अवकाश उमेर तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Supreme Court Judges retire at 65 years; High Court Judges retire at 63 years.
Explanation: Articles 131 and 142.

English Question: How many District Courts are provided under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कति जिल्ला अदालत रहने व्यवस्था छ?
Gold Answer (EN): One in each district.
Explanation: Article 148.

English Question: What percentage of District Judge vacancies are filled through open competition from advocates and other eligible legal professionals?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला न्यायाधीशको रिक्त पदमध्ये वकिल तथा अन्य योग्य कानुनी पेशाकर्मीका लागि खुला प्रतिस्पर्धाबाट कति प्रतिशत पद पूर्ति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Forty percent.
Explanation: Article 149(2)(c).

English Question: Can a specialized court be created for a specific individual case?
Nepali Question: कुनै विशेष मुद्दाका लागि मात्र विशेष अदालत गठन गर्न मिल्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 152(1) expressly prohibits it.

English Question: Who chairs the Judicial Council?
Nepali Question: न्याय परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Justice.
Explanation: Article 153.

English Question: How long is the term of the nominated members of the Judicial Council?
Nepali Question: न्याय परिषद्का मनोनीत सदस्यहरूको कार्यकाल कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Four years.
Explanation: Article 153(2).

English Question: Who chairs the Judicial Service Commission?
Nepali Question: न्याय सेवा आयोगको अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Justice.
Explanation: Article 154.

English Question: A Supreme Court Judge and a High Court Judge are both 64 years old. According to the Constitution, which judge must retire first?
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतका एक न्यायाधीश र उच्च अदालतका एक न्यायाधीश दुवै ६४ वर्षका छन्। संविधानअनुसार पहिले कसले अवकाश लिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The High Court Judge must retire first because the retirement age is 63 years, whereas Supreme Court Judges retire at 65 years.
Gold Answer (NE): उच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशले पहिले अवकाश लिनुपर्छ, किनकि उच्च अदालतको अवकाश उमेर ६३ वर्ष हो भने सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशको ६५ वर्ष हो।
Explanation: Tests reasoning using the different retirement ages prescribed in Articles 131 and 142 instead of simple fact recall.

English Question: Although both the Supreme Court and High Courts may issue constitutional writs, which court has the final authority to interpret the Constitution?
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालत र उच्च अदालत दुवैले संवैधानिक रिट जारी गर्न सक्ने भए पनि संविधानको अन्तिम व्याख्या गर्ने अधिकार कुन अदालतलाई छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Supreme Court has the final authority to interpret the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानको अन्तिम व्याख्या गर्ने अधिकार सर्वोच्च अदालतलाई छ।
Explanation: Both courts possess writ jurisdiction, but only the Supreme Court has final constitutional interpretative authority under Article 128.

English Question: Are all courts and judicial bodies in Nepal subordinate to the Supreme Court? If not, what constitutional qualification applies?
Nepali Question: के नेपालका सबै अदालत तथा न्यायिक निकाय सर्वोच्च अदालतअन्तर्गत हुन्छन्? यदि होइन भने संविधानले के अपवाद राखेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes, except where otherwise provided by the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): हो, तर संविधानले अन्यथा व्यवस्था गरेको अवस्थामा अपवाद लागू हुन्छ।
Explanation: Tests understanding of the constitutional qualification in Article 128(2), not absolute recall.

English Question: Can the Supreme Court declare a law void from the beginning of its existence, or only from the date of its judgment?
Nepali Question: के सर्वोच्च अदालतले कुनै कानुनलाई प्रारम्भदेखि नै बदर गर्न सक्छ, वा निर्णय भएको मितिदेखि मात्र?
Gold Answer (EN): It may declare the law void either ab initio or from the date of its decision.
Gold Answer (NE): सर्वोच्च अदालतले कानुनलाई प्रारम्भदेखि नै वा आफ्नो निर्णय भएको मितिदेखि बदर गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Tests understanding of Article 133(1).

English Question: Which body settles disputes regarding the disqualification of members of the Federal Parliament: the full Supreme Court or the Constitutional Bench?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसदका सदस्यको अयोग्यतासम्बन्धी विवाद सर्वोच्च अदालतको पूर्ण इजलासले टुंग्याउँछ वा संवैधानिक इजलासले?
Gold Answer (EN): The Constitutional Bench.
Explanation: Article 137 specifically assigns this jurisdiction.

English Question: Can a specialized court be established to hear only one specific case?
Nepali Question: कुनै एउटा विशेष मुद्दा सुनुवाइ गर्न मात्रै विशेष अदालत स्थापना गर्न मिल्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. The Constitution expressly prohibits creating a specialized court for a specific case.
Gold Answer (NE): मिल्दैन। संविधानले कुनै विशेष मुद्दाका लागि मात्र विशेष अदालत गठन गर्न निषेध गरेको छ।
Explanation: Article 152(1).

English Question: Which member of the Judicial Council is nominated on the recommendation of the Nepal Bar Association?
Nepali Question: न्याय परिषद्मा नेपाल बार एसोसिएसनको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुने सदस्य को हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): A senior advocate or advocate with at least twenty years of experience.
Gold Answer (NE): कम्तीमा बीस वर्ष अनुभव भएका वरिष्ठ अधिवक्ता वा अधिवक्ता।
Explanation: This is an easily hallucinated constitutional detail.

English Question: What proportion of vacant District Judge posts is filled through seniority, and what proportion through open competitive examination?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला न्यायाधीशका रिक्त पदमध्ये कति प्रतिशत वरिष्ठताका आधारमा र कति प्रतिशत खुला प्रतिस्पर्धाबाट पूर्ति गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): 20% through seniority, 80% through open competitive examination (40% Judicial Service officers and 40% advocates/other eligible candidates).
Gold Answer (NE): २०% वरिष्ठताका आधारमा र ८०% खुला प्रतिस्पर्धाबाट (४०% न्याय सेवा र ४०% अन्य योग्य उम्मेदवार)।
Explanation: Requires combining all three categories in Article 149(2).

English Question: After retirement, may a former Supreme Court Judge and a former High Court Judge both practice law? Compare their constitutional positions.
Nepali Question: अवकाशपछि पूर्व सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश र पूर्व उच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश दुवैले वकालत गर्न पाउँछन्? उनीहरूको संवैधानिक व्यवस्था तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): A retired Supreme Court Judge may not practice law, mediation, or arbitration before any office or court, whereas a retired High Court Judge may practice before the Supreme Court and other High Courts except the High Court where they served.
Gold Answer (NE): पूर्व सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशले कुनै अदालत वा निकायमा वकालत, मध्यस्थता वा मध्यनिर्णय गर्न पाउँदैनन्, तर पूर्व उच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशले आफू कार्यरत रहेको उच्च अदालतबाहेक सर्वोच्च तथा अन्य उच्च अदालतमा वकालत गर्न सक्छन्।
Explanation: Excellent comparison between Articles 135 and 146.

English Question: Who appoints the Attorney General of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको महान्यायाधिवक्तालाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President appoints the Attorney General on the recommendation of the Prime Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रधानमन्त्रीको सिफारिसमा राष्ट्रपतिले महान्यायाधिवक्ता नियुक्त गर्छन्।
Explanation: Article 157(2).

English Question: Compare the appointment process of the Attorney General and the Chief Attorney.
Nepali Question: महान्यायाधिवक्ता र मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ताको नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General is appointed by the President on the recommendation of the Prime Minister, whereas the Chief Attorney is appointed by the Chief of State on the recommendation of the concerned Chief Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): महान्यायाधिवक्ता प्रधानमन्त्रीको सिफारिसमा राष्ट्रपतिले नियुक्त गर्छन् भने मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्तालाई सम्बन्धित मुख्यमन्त्रीको सिफारिसमा प्रदेश प्रमुखले नियुक्त गर्छन्।
Explanation: Compares Articles 157 and 160.

English Question: What qualifications are required for appointment as the Attorney General and the Chief Attorney?
Nepali Question: महान्यायाधिवक्ता र मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ता बन्न कस्तो योग्यता आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General must be qualified to become a Supreme Court Judge, while the Chief Attorney must be qualified to become a High Court Judge.
Gold Answer (NE): महान्यायाधिवक्ता सर्वोच्च अदालतको न्यायाधीश बन्न योग्य हुनुपर्छ भने मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ता उच्च अदालतको न्यायाधीश बन्न योग्य हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Compares Articles 157(3) and 160(3).

English Question: During whose pleasure does the Attorney General hold office?
Nepali Question: महान्यायाधिवक्ता कसको इच्छासम्म पदमा रहन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): During the pleasure of the Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 157(2).

English Question: Who is the chief legal advisor to the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारको प्रमुख कानुनी सल्लाहकार को हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General.
Explanation: Article 158(1).

English Question: Before a case filed on behalf of the Government of Nepal can be withdrawn, whose opinion must be obtained?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारको तर्फबाट दायर गरिएको मुद्दा फिर्ता लिनुअघि कसको राय लिन अनिवार्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The opinion of the Attorney General.
Explanation: Article 158(3).

English Question: Who represents the Government of Nepal in lawsuits involving its rights, interests, or concerns?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारको हक, हित वा सरोकार भएका मुद्दामा सरकारको प्रतिनिधित्व कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General or government attorneys subordinate to the Attorney General.
Explanation: Article 158(2).

English Question: Does the Attorney General have the constitutional right to appear before any court, office, or authority in Nepal while performing official duties?
Nepali Question: आफ्नो कर्तव्य निर्वाह गर्ने क्रममा महान्यायाधिवक्तालाई नेपालका कुनै पनि अदालत, कार्यालय वा निकायमा उपस्थित हुने संवैधानिक अधिकार छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes. While performing official duties, the Attorney General has the right to appear before any court, office, or authority in Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): छ। आफ्नो कर्तव्य निर्वाह गर्ने क्रममा महान्यायाधिवक्तालाई नेपालका कुनै पनि अदालत, कार्यालय वा निकायमा उपस्थित हुने अधिकार हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 158(5).

English Question: What action may the Attorney General take if a complaint alleges that a person in custody has not been treated humanely?
Nepali Question: हिरासतमा रहेको व्यक्तिलाई मानवीय व्यवहार नगरिएको भन्ने उजुरी आएमा महान्यायाधिवक्ताले के गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General may inquire into the matter and issue necessary directions to the concerned authority to prevent such acts.
Gold Answer (NE): महान्यायाधिवक्ताले अनुसन्धान गरी त्यस्ता कार्य रोक्न सम्बन्धित निकायलाई आवश्यक निर्देशन दिन सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 158(6)(c).

English Question: To whom does the Attorney General submit the annual report?
Nepali Question: महान्यायाधिवक्ताले वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन कसलाई बुझाउँछन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President, who lays it before the Federal Parliament through the Prime Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिलाई, जसले प्रधानमन्त्रीमार्फत संघीय संसदमा पेश गराउँछन्।
Explanation: Article 159(1).

English Question: Compare the chief legal advisors of the Federal Government and the State Government.
Nepali Question: संघीय सरकार र प्रदेश सरकारका प्रमुख कानुनी सल्लाहकारको तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): The Attorney General is the chief legal advisor to the Government of Nepal, whereas the Chief Attorney is the chief legal advisor to the State Government.
Gold Answer (NE): महान्यायाधिवक्ता नेपाल सरकारका प्रमुख कानुनी सल्लाहकार हुन् भने मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ता प्रदेश सरकारका प्रमुख कानुनी सल्लाहकार हुन्।
Explanation: Compares Articles 158 and 160.

English Question: Is the Office of the Chief Attorney administratively independent of the Office of the Attorney General?
Nepali Question: के मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ताको कार्यालय प्रशासनिक रूपमा महान्यायाधिवक्ताको कार्यालयबाट स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. The Office of the Attorney General manages the employees under the Office of the Chief Attorney.
Gold Answer (NE): हुँदैन। मुख्य न्यायाधिवक्ताको कार्यालयका कर्मचारीको व्यवस्थापन महान्यायाधिवक्ताको कार्यालयले गर्छ।
Explanation: Article 160(6).

English Question: In whom is the executive power of a State vested?
Nepali Question: राज्यको कार्यकारी शक्ति कसमा निहित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The State Council of Ministers.
Explanation: Article 162(1).

English Question: In whose name are all State executive functions performed?
Nepali Question: सबै प्रदेश कार्यकारी कार्यहरू कसको नाममा सम्पन्न गरिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): In the name of the State Government.
Explanation: Article 162(3).

English Question: Who appoints the Chief of State?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखको नियुक्ति कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 163(2).

English Question: What is the normal term of office of a Chief of State?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखको सामान्य कार्यकाल कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 163(3).

English Question: What is the minimum age required to become a Chief of State?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुख हुन न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Thirty-five years.
Explanation: Article 164(b).

English Question: Before whom does the Chief of State take the oath of office and secrecy?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ कसको समक्ष लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 167.

English Question: Who is appointed Chief Minister when one party commands a majority in the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा कुनै दलको स्पष्ट बहुमत भएमा कसलाई मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्त गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The leader of the parliamentary party commanding the majority.
Explanation: Article 168(1).

English Question: Who may be appointed Chief Minister if no party has a clear majority in the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा कुनै दलको स्पष्ट बहुमत नभएमा कसलाई मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A member who can command a majority with the support of two or more parties.
Gold Answer (NE): दुई वा दुईभन्दा बढी दलको समर्थनबाट बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने प्रदेश सभा सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 168(2).

English Question: Within how many days must a Chief Minister appointed under Article 168(2) or 168(3) obtain a vote of confidence?
Nepali Question: धारा १६८(२) वा (३) अन्तर्गत नियुक्त मुख्यमन्त्रीले कति दिनभित्र विश्वासको मत लिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within thirty days of appointment.
Explanation: Article 168(4).

English Question: Within how many days must the Chief Minister appointment process be completed after the final election results?
Nepali Question: अन्तिम निर्वाचन परिणाम घोषणा भएपछि मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया कति दिनभित्र पूरा हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within thirty-five days.
Explanation: Article 168(8).

English Question: What is the maximum size of the State Council of Ministers?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्को अधिकतम आकार कति हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty percent of the total number of members of the State Assembly.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेश सभाका कुल सदस्य संख्याको बीस प्रतिशत।
Explanation: Article 168(9).

English Question: Under Article 168, what does the term "Minister" include?
Nepali Question: धारा १६८ अनुसार "मन्त्री" भन्नाले कसलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Minister, Minister of State, and Assistant Minister.
Explanation: Explanation to Article 168.

English Question: To whom is the State Council of Ministers collectively responsible?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद् सामूहिक रूपमा कसप्रति उत्तरदायी हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The State Assembly.
Explanation: Article 168(10).

English Question: To whom does the Chief Minister submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: मुख्यमन्त्रीले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई दिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of State.
Explanation: Article 169(1)(a).

English Question: To whom does a Minister submit a written resignation?
Nepali Question: मन्त्रीले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई दिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Minister.
Explanation: Article 169(2)(a).

English Question: Who acts as Chief Minister if the Chief Minister dies before a new one is appointed?
Nepali Question: नयाँ मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्त नभएसम्म मुख्यमन्त्रीको मृत्यु भए कसले कार्यवाहक मुख्यमन्त्रीको रूपमा काम गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The senior-most Minister.
Explanation: Proviso to Article 169(3).

English Question: Within how many months must a non-member appointed as Minister become a member of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको सदस्य नभएको मन्त्री नियुक्त भएको व्यक्तिले कति महिनाभित्र प्रदेश सभा सदस्य बन्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within six months.
Explanation: Article 170(2).

English Question: Can a person defeated in the current State Assembly election be appointed as a Minister under Article 170(1)?
Nepali Question: वर्तमान प्रदेश सभा निर्वाचनमा पराजित व्यक्ति धारा १७०(१) अन्तर्गत मन्त्री नियुक्त हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. A defeated candidate is not eligible during the term of that State Assembly.
Gold Answer (NE): हुँदैन। त्यस्तो व्यक्ति उक्त प्रदेश सभाको कार्यकालभर मन्त्री नियुक्त हुन योग्य हुँदैन।
Explanation: Article 170(4).

English Question: Before whom do the Chief Minister and Ministers take the oath, and before whom do Ministers of State and Assistant Ministers take the oath?
Nepali Question: मुख्यमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रीहरूले कसको समक्ष शपथ लिन्छन् र राज्यमन्त्री तथा सहायक मन्त्रीहरूले कसको समक्ष शपथ लिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Minister and Ministers take the oath before the Chief of State, while Ministers of State and Assistant Ministers take the oath before the Chief Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): मुख्यमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रीहरूले प्रदेश प्रमुखसमक्ष शपथ लिन्छन् भने राज्यमन्त्री तथा सहायक मन्त्रीहरूले मुख्यमन्त्रीसमक्ष शपथ लिन्छन्।
Explanation: Article 172.

English Question: Which constitutional authority must the Chief Minister keep informed about resolutions of the State Council of Ministers?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्का निर्णयबारे मुख्यमन्त्रीले कसलाई जानकारी गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of State.
Explanation: Article 173(a).

English Question: Name any two matters that the Chief Minister must inform the Chief of State about.
Nepali Question: मुख्यमन्त्रीले प्रदेश प्रमुखलाई जानकारी गराउनुपर्ने कुनै दुई विषय उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Any two of: resolutions of the State Council of Ministers, Bills to be introduced in the State Assembly, information requested by the Chief of State, or the current general state of affairs of the State.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्का निर्णय, प्रदेश सभामा पेश हुने विधेयक, प्रदेश प्रमुखले मागेको जानकारी, वा प्रदेशको वर्तमान सामान्य अवस्था मध्ये कुनै दुई।
Explanation: Article 173.

English Question: According to the Constitution, who approves the rules governing the allocation and transaction of business of the State Government?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सरकारको कार्य विभाजन तथा सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी नियम कसले स्वीकृत गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The State Government.
Explanation: Article 174(1).

English Question: Can a court question whether the rules regarding the transaction of business of the State Government have been observed?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सरकारको कार्य सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी नियम पालना भए वा नभएको विषयमा अदालतले प्रश्न उठाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. Courts cannot question whether those rules have been observed.
Gold Answer (NE): सक्दैन। अदालतले त्यस्ता नियम पालना भए वा नभएको विषयमा प्रश्न उठाउन सक्दैन।
Explanation: Article 174(2).

English Question: If the office of the Chief of State becomes vacant, who may be designated to act for that State?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखको पद रिक्त भए कसलाई सो प्रदेशको कार्यवाहक प्रदेश प्रमुख तोकिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of State of another State may be designated by the President.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले अर्को प्रदेशका प्रदेश प्रमुखलाई कार्यवाहकका रूपमा तोक्न सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 165(2).

English Question: Who appoints the Chief of State, and on whose recommendation are most of the Chief of State's constitutional functions exercised?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखको नियुक्ति कसले गर्छ र प्रदेश प्रमुखका अधिकांश संवैधानिक कार्य कसको सिफारिसमा गरिन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The President appoints the Chief of State, and most functions are exercised on the recommendation and with the consent of the State Council of Ministers submitted through the Chief Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले प्रदेश प्रमुख नियुक्त गर्छन्, र अधिकांश कार्य मुख्यमन्त्रीमार्फत आएको प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिस तथा सहमतिमा गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Articles 163 and 166.

English Question: What is the structure of the legislature of a State under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार राज्यको व्यवस्थापिका कस्तो हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Unicameral.
Explanation: Article 175 provides that the legislature of a State shall be unicameral and called the State Assembly.

English Question: What is the unicameral legislature of a State called?
Nepali Question: राज्यको एक सदनीय व्यवस्थापिकालाई के भनिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State Assembly.
Explanation: Article 175 names the unicameral legislature as the State Assembly.

English Question: What percentage of State Assembly members are elected through the first-past-the-post electoral system?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाका कति प्रतिशत सदस्य प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट निर्वाचित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty percent.
Explanation: Articles 176(1)(b) and 176(3) provide that sixty percent are elected through the first-past-the-post system.

English Question: What percentage of State Assembly members are elected through the proportional electoral system?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाका कति प्रतिशत सदस्य समानुपातिक निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट निर्वाचित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Forty percent.
Explanation: Article 176(3) provides that forty percent are elected through the proportional electoral system.

English Question: On what basis are election constituencies determined for members elected through the first-past-the-post system?
Nepali Question: प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट निर्वाचित हुने सदस्यका लागि निर्वाचन क्षेत्र कुन आधारमा निर्धारण गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Geography and population.
Explanation: Article 176(2) requires constituencies to be determined on the basis of geography and population.

English Question: What is the minimum age required to vote in an election to the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको निर्वाचनमा मतदान गर्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Eighteen years.
Explanation: Article 176(5) grants voting rights to citizens who have completed eighteen years of age.

English Question: Which community does the Constitution define as "Khas Arya" for the purposes of proportional representation?
Nepali Question: समानुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्वका प्रयोजनका लागि संविधानले "खस आर्य" भन्नाले कुन समुदायलाई बुझाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Kshetri, Brahmin, Thakuri, and Sanyasi (Dashnami).
Gold Answer (NE): क्षेत्री, ब्राह्मण, ठाकुरी र सन्यासी (दशनामी) समुदाय।
Explanation: The explanation to Article 176(6) defines "Khas Arya."

English Question: Besides the specified social groups, representation of which additional group must political parties also provide when fielding proportional representation candidates?
Nepali Question: समानुपातिक निर्वाचनमा उम्मेदवारी दिँदा राजनीतिक दलले उल्लेखित समुदायबाहेक कुन थप समूहको प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Persons with disabilities.
Explanation: Article 176(7) requires representation of persons with disabilities.

English Question: If a State Assembly seat becomes vacant with more than six months of the term remaining, how must it be filled?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको कार्यकाल छ महिनाभन्दा बढी बाँकी रहँदा कुनै स्थान रिक्त भए कसरी पूर्ति गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Through the same electoral system by which the seat was originally filled.
Gold Answer (NE): उक्त स्थान जुन निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट भरिएको थियो, सोही प्रणालीबाट।
Explanation: Article 176(8) requires vacancies to be filled through the same electoral system.

English Question: What is the minimum proportion of members elected from each political party to the State Assembly that must be women?
Nepali Question: प्रत्येक राजनीतिक दलबाट प्रदेश सभामा निर्वाचित कुल सदस्यमध्ये महिलाको न्यूनतम अनुपात कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one-third.
Explanation: Article 176(9) requires at least one-third women representation.

English Question: Can a qualified person contest the State Assembly election from more than one constituency at the same time?
Nepali Question: योग्य व्यक्तिले एकै समयमा एकभन्दा बढी निर्वाचन क्षेत्रबाट प्रदेश सभा सदस्यको उम्मेदवार बन्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 176(10) prohibits candidacy in more than one constituency simultaneously.

English Question: What is the normal term of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको सामान्य कार्यकाल कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 177(1) fixes the normal term at five years.

English Question: During a state of emergency, for how long may the term of the State Assembly be extended?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल लागू भएको अवस्थामा प्रदेश सभाको कार्यकाल बढीमा कति अवधिसम्म थप्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Not exceeding one year.
Explanation: Article 177(2) permits extension for a period not exceeding one year.

English Question: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको सदस्य बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty-five years.
Explanation: Article 178(1)(c) sets the minimum age at twenty-five years.

English Question: What does "office of profit" mean for the purpose of qualification for membership of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभा सदस्यको योग्यताका सन्दर्भमा "लाभको पद" भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A position, other than an elected or nominated political position, for which remuneration or economic benefit is paid from a government fund.
Gold Answer (NE): निर्वाचन वा मनोनयनबाट पूर्ति हुने राजनीतिक पद बाहेक सरकारको कोषबाट पारिश्रमिक वा आर्थिक लाभ प्राप्त हुने पद।
Explanation: The explanation to Article 178(1) defines "office of profit."

English Question: Before participating for the first time in the meeting of the State Assembly or its committees, what must every member do?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभा वा यसको समितिको बैठकमा पहिलो पटक सहभागी हुनुअघि प्रत्येक सदस्यले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Take an oath as provided by State law.
Explanation: Article 179 requires every member to take an oath before first participation.

English Question: How many consecutive meetings may a member of the State Assembly miss without notice before the seat becomes vacant?
Nepali Question: सूचना नदिई लगातार कति बैठकमा अनुपस्थित रहेमा प्रदेश सभा सदस्यको स्थान रिक्त हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Ten consecutive meetings.
Explanation: Article 180(d) provides this ground for vacancy.

English Question: Which body makes the final decision on whether a member of the State Assembly is disqualified?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभा सदस्य अयोग्य भएको हो वा होइन भन्ने अन्तिम निर्णय कुन निकायले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court.
Explanation: Article 181 gives this authority to the Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court.

English Question: Within how many days from the first meeting of the State Assembly must the Speaker and Deputy Speaker be elected?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको पहिलो बैठक बसेको कति दिनभित्र सभामुख र उपसभामुखको निर्वाचन हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 182(1) prescribes the fifteen-day deadline.

English Question: If both the offices of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker are vacant, who chairs the meeting of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: सभामुख र उपसभामुख दुवै पद रिक्त भए प्रदेश सभाको बैठक कसले अध्यक्षता गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The attending member who is the senior-most by age.
Gold Answer (NE): उपस्थित सदस्यमध्ये उमेरका आधारमा सबैभन्दा ज्येष्ठ सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 182(5) provides that the senior-most attending member by age chairs the meeting.

English Question: In which Schedules are the legislative powers of the State Assembly enumerated?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाका विधायिकी अधिकारहरू कुन-कुन अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख गरिएका छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedules 6, 7, and 9.
Explanation: Article 197 provides that the legislative powers of the State Assembly are contained in Schedules 6, 7, and 9.

English Question: Subject to the Constitution, where may a Bill be introduced?
Nepali Question: संविधानको अधीनमा रही विधेयक कहाँ प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In the State Assembly.
Explanation: Article 198(1) states that a Bill may be introduced in the State Assembly.

English Question: Which two types of Bills may be introduced only as Government Bills in the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा कुन दुई प्रकारका विधेयक सरकारका विधेयकका रूपमा मात्र प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A Money Bill and a Bill concerning peace and security.
Gold Answer (NE): धन विधेयक र शान्ति तथा सुरक्षासम्बन्धी विधेयक।
Explanation: Article 198(2) limits these Bills to Government Bills.

English Question: Does a Bill concerning the imposition or regulation of State taxes fall within the definition of a Money Bill?
Nepali Question: राज्यस्तरीय कर लगाउने वा नियमन गर्ने सम्बन्धी विधेयक धन विधेयकको परिभाषाभित्र पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 198(3)(a) includes taxation matters within a Money Bill.

English Question: Does a Bill concerning borrowing money or giving guarantees by the State Government qualify as a Money Bill?
Nepali Question: राज्य सरकारले ऋण लिने वा जमानत दिने सम्बन्धी विधेयक धन विधेयक मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 198(3)(c) includes borrowing and guarantees by the State Government.

English Question: Is a Bill deemed to be a Money Bill solely because it imposes licence fees, application fees, renewal fees, fines, or imprisonment?
Nepali Question: इजाजतपत्र शुल्क, निवेदन शुल्क, नवीकरण शुल्क, जरिवाना वा कैद सजायको व्यवस्था भएकै कारण कुनै विधेयक धन विधेयक मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 198(3) expressly excludes such Bills from being treated as Money Bills solely on that basis.

English Question: Who makes the final decision on whether a Bill is a Money Bill in the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा कुनै विधेयक धन विधेयक हो वा होइन भन्ने अन्तिम निर्णय कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker of the State Assembly.
Explanation: Article 198(4) makes the Speaker's decision final.

English Question: After a Bill is passed by the State Assembly, to whom is it presented for assent?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाबाट विधेयक पारित भएपछि स्वीकृतिका लागि कससमक्ष पेश गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of State.
Explanation: Article 199(1) provides that a passed Bill is presented to the Chief of State.

English Question: What happens if the session of the State Assembly ends while a Bill is under consideration?
Nepali Question: विधेयक विचाराधीन रहँदा प्रदेश सभाको अधिवेशन अन्त्य भए के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Deliberations may continue in the succeeding session.
Gold Answer (NE): अर्को अधिवेशनमा त्यसको विचार जारी रहन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 199(2) allows deliberations to continue in the succeeding session.

English Question: What happens to a Bill under consideration if the State Assembly is dissolved or its term expires?
Nepali Question: विधेयक विचाराधीन रहँदा प्रदेश सभा विघटन भए वा यसको कार्यकाल समाप्त भए के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Bill lapses.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 199(2) states that such a Bill lapses.

English Question: Who may withdraw a Bill with the approval of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको स्वीकृतिसहित विधेयक कसले फिर्ता लिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The member who introduced the Bill.
Explanation: Article 200 authorizes the member introducing the Bill to withdraw it with approval.

English Question: Who presents a Bill to the Chief of State for assent after certifying it?
Nepali Question: प्रमाणीकरण गरेपछि प्रदेश प्रमुखसमक्ष स्वीकृतिका लागि विधेयक कसले पेश गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker of the State Assembly.
Explanation: Article 201(1) assigns this responsibility to the Speaker.

English Question: Within how many days must the Chief of State give assent to a Bill presented for assent?
Nepali Question: स्वीकृतिका लागि पेश गरिएको विधेयकमा प्रदेश प्रमुखले कति दिनभित्र स्वीकृति दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 201(2) requires assent within fifteen days.

English Question: Can the Chief of State return a Money Bill to the State Assembly for further deliberation?
Nepali Question: के प्रदेश प्रमुखले धन विधेयकलाई थप विचारका लागि प्रदेश सभामा फिर्ता पठाउन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 201(3) excludes Money Bills from reconsideration.

English Question: If a Bill returned by the Chief of State is reconsidered and passed again, within how many days must the Chief of State give assent?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखले फिर्ता पठाएको विधेयक पुनः पारित भएपछि प्रदेश प्रमुखले कति दिनभित्र स्वीकृति दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 201(4) requires assent within fifteen days after the Bill is presented again.

English Question: When does a Bill become an Act?
Nepali Question: विधेयक कहिले ऐन बन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): After the Chief of State gives assent.
Explanation: Article 201(5) states that a Bill becomes an Act after assent.

English Question: Under what circumstances may the Chief of State promulgate an Ordinance?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश प्रमुखले कुन अवस्थामा अध्यादेश जारी गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): When the State Assembly is not in session and immediate action is necessary, on the recommendation of the State Council of Ministers.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेश सभा अधिवेशनमा नरहेको र तत्काल कार्य आवश्यक भएको अवस्थामा, प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिसमा।
Explanation: Article 202(1) specifies the constitutional conditions.

English Question: What legal effect does an Ordinance have after promulgation?
Nepali Question: जारी भएपछि अध्यादेशको कानुनी प्रभाव के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It has the same force and effect as an Act.
Explanation: Article 202(2) gives an Ordinance the same force and effect as an Act.

English Question: What happens to an Ordinance if it is not passed by the State Assembly after being tabled?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा पेश गरिएपछि अध्यादेश पारित नभए के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It automatically ceases to be effective.
Explanation: Article 202(2)(a) provides that the Ordinance ipso facto ceases to be effective if not passed.

English Question: Unless earlier repealed or rendered ineffective, after how many days from the meeting of the State Assembly does an Ordinance automatically cease to be effective?
Nepali Question: पहिले नै खारेज वा निष्प्रभावी नगरिएमा प्रदेश सभाको बैठक बसेको कति दिनपछि अध्यादेश स्वतः निष्प्रभावी हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty days.
Explanation: Article 202(2)(c) provides that an Ordinance automatically ceases to be effective after sixty days from the meeting of the State Assembly.

English Question: Under what condition may a tax be levied and collected in a State?
Nepali Question: प्रदेशमा कुन अवस्थामा मात्र कर लगाउन र उठाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Only in accordance with law.
Explanation: Article 203(1) provides that no tax shall be levied and collected except in accordance with law.

English Question: Under what condition may a State Government raise a loan or give a guarantee?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सरकारले कुन अवस्थामा ऋण उठाउन वा जमानत दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Only as provided for in Federal law.
Explanation: Article 203(2) states that State Government loans and guarantees require provision in Federal law.

English Question: Which revenues are excluded from the State Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा जम्मा नगरिने राजस्व कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Revenues of trusts (Guthi).
Explanation: Article 204 excludes revenues of trusts (Guthi) from the State Consolidated Fund.

English Question: What is the name of the State Government Fund into which specified revenues and receipts are credited?
Nepali Question: तोकिएका राजस्व तथा रकम जम्मा गरिने प्रदेश सरकारको कोषको नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): State Consolidated Fund.
Explanation: Article 204 establishes the State Consolidated Fund.

English Question: Besides revenues, what other receipts of the State Government are credited to the State Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: राजस्व बाहेक प्रदेश सरकारबाट प्राप्त कुन-कुन रकम प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा जम्मा गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Loans, loan repayments, and grants or loans received from the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): ऋण, ऋण फिर्ताबाट प्राप्त रकम तथा नेपाल सरकारबाट प्राप्त अनुदान वा ऋण।
Explanation: Article 204 includes these receipts unless otherwise provided by State law.

English Question: Can expenditure be incurred from the State Consolidated Fund or other State Government Funds without constitutional authorization?
Nepali Question: संवैधानिक व्यवस्था बिना प्रदेश सञ्चित कोष वा अन्य प्रदेश सरकारी कोषबाट खर्च गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 205 restricts expenditure from these funds except in specified cases.

English Question: Which Act authorizes expenditure required when an Appropriation Bill is under consideration?
Nepali Question: विनियोजन विधेयक विचाराधीन हुँदा आवश्यक खर्च कुन ऐनले अधिकार दिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): An Act.
Explanation: Article 205(c) allows advance money authorized by an Act.

English Question: Which Article governs matters relating to the State Contingency Fund?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश आकस्मिक कोषसम्बन्धी विषय कुन धाराले व्यवस्था गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 212.
Explanation: The proviso to Article 205 refers to Article 212 for the State Contingency Fund.

English Question: Is approval of the State Assembly required for expenditures charged on the State Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा भारित खर्चका लागि प्रदेश सभाको स्वीकृति आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 206 states that approval of the State Assembly is not required.

English Question: Which officials' remuneration and facilities are charged on the State Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: कुन पदाधिकारीहरूको पारिश्रमिक र सुविधा प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा भारित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State Speaker and State Deputy Speaker.
Explanation: Article 206(a) includes remuneration and facilities of the State Speaker and Deputy Speaker.

English Question: Are sums required to satisfy a court judgment or decree against the State Government charged on the State Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सरकारविरुद्ध अदालतको फैसला वा डिक्री पूरा गर्न आवश्यक रकम प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा भारित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 206(d) includes such sums as chargeable expenditures.

English Question: Who lays the annual estimate of revenues and expenditures before the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभासमक्ष वार्षिक आय–व्ययको अनुमान कसले पेश गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State Minister for Finance.
Explanation: Article 207(1) assigns this duty to the State Minister for Finance.

English Question: What three matters must be included in the annual estimate presented before the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभामा पेश गरिने वार्षिक अनुमानमा कुन तीन विषय समावेश हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Revenue estimates, charges on the State Consolidated Fund, and expenditure provided by a State Appropriation Act.
Gold Answer (NE): राजस्व अनुमान, प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषमा भारित रकम, र प्रदेश विनियोजन ऐनबाट गरिने खर्च।
Explanation: Article 207(1)(a)-(c) specifies these matters.

English Question: What additional statement must accompany the annual estimate regarding Ministries?
Nepali Question: वार्षिक अनुमानसँगै मन्त्रालयसम्बन्धी कुन थप विवरण पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Previous year's allocated expenses and whether their objectives were achieved.
Gold Answer (NE): अघिल्लो वर्षको विनियोजित खर्च र खर्चका उद्देश्य पूरा भए वा भएनन् भन्ने विवरण।
Explanation: Article 207(2) requires this statement.

English Question: Where must the money required under a State Appropriation Act be specified?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश विनियोजन ऐनअन्तर्गत आवश्यक रकम कहाँ उल्लेख गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Under appropriate heads in an Appropriation Bill.
Explanation: Article 208 requires specification under appropriate heads in an Appropriation Bill.

English Question: When may the State Minister for Finance present a supplementary estimate?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश अर्थमन्त्रीले कुन अवस्थामा पूरक अनुमान पेश गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): When authorized expenditure is insufficient, a new service requires expenditure, or expenditure exceeds the authorized amount.
Gold Answer (NE): स्वीकृत खर्च अपुग भएमा, नयाँ सेवामा खर्च आवश्यक भएमा, वा स्वीकृत रकमभन्दा बढी खर्च भएमा।
Explanation: Article 209(1) provides these conditions.

English Question: What is the maximum amount that may be included in a State Vote on Account?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश लेखानुदानमा समावेश गर्न सकिने अधिकतम रकम कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Not more than one-third of the estimated expenditure for the financial year.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक वर्षको अनुमानित खर्चको एक-तिहाइभन्दा बढी होइन।
Explanation: Article 210(2) limits the amount to one-third of estimated expenditure.

English Question: Can a State Vote on Account Bill be introduced before the revenue and expenditure estimates are presented under Article 207?
Nepali Question: धारा २०७ बमोजिम आय–व्यय अनुमान पेश गर्नुअघि प्रदेश लेखानुदान विधेयक प्रस्तुत गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 210(2) prohibits introduction before estimates are laid.

English Question: When may the State Minister for Finance present a Vote of Credit Bill containing only a statement of expenditures?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश अर्थमन्त्रीले खर्चको विवरण मात्र भएको मत–ऋण विधेयक कहिले पेश गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): During an emergency when specifying details is impractical or inexpedient due to State security or interest.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेशको सुरक्षा वा हितका कारण विस्तृत विवरण दिन अव्यावहारिक वा अनुपयुक्त हुने आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा।
Explanation: Article 211 provides this authority.

English Question: Who controls the State Contingency Fund and what type of expenditure may be met from it?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश आकस्मिक कोषको नियन्त्रण कसले गर्छ र कुन प्रकारको खर्च यसबाट व्यहोर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The State Government; unforeseen expenditure.
Explanation: Article 212(2) provides State Government control and use for unforeseen expenditure.

English Question: In whom is the executive power of the Local Level vested?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहको कार्यकारी शक्ति कसमा निहित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Executive or Municipal Executive.
Explanation: Article 214(1) states that the executive power of the Local Level is vested in the Village Executive or Municipal Executive.

English Question: Which Schedules contain the local executive powers of the Local Level?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहको कार्यकारी शक्ति कुन अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.
Explanation: Article 214(2) specifies that local executive powers are mentioned in Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.

English Question: Which bodies are responsible for issuing general directives and regulating governance of Village Bodies and Municipalities?
Nepali Question: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको शासन सञ्चालनका लागि सामान्य निर्देशन दिने र नियमन गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कुन निकायको हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Executive and Municipal Executive.
Explanation: Article 214(3) assigns these responsibilities to the respective executives.

English Question: Who chairs the Village Executive?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिकाको अध्यक्षता कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Chairperson of Village Executive.
Explanation: Article 215(1) provides that each Village Body has a Chairperson under whose chairpersonship the Village Executive is formed.

English Question: How many women members are elected to the Village Executive from among Village Assembly members?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभाका सदस्यहरूमध्येबाट गाउँ कार्यपालिकामा कति महिला सदस्य निर्वाचित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Four women members.
Explanation: Article 215(4) requires four women members to be elected to the Village Executive.

English Question: How many members from Dalit or minority communities are elected to the Village Executive?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिकामा दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक समुदायबाट कति सदस्य निर्वाचित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Two members.
Explanation: Article 215(4) provides for two members from Dalit or minority communities.

English Question: What is the minimum age qualification to become Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, Ward Chairperson, or member of a Village Executive?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिकाको अध्यक्ष, उपाध्यक्ष, वडा अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty-one years.
Explanation: Article 215(5)(b) requires completion of twenty-one years of age.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, Ward Chairperson, and members of the Village Executive?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिकाका अध्यक्ष, उपाध्यक्ष, वडा अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूको कार्यकाल कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 215(6) specifies a five-year term after election.

English Question: Can a person elected as Chairperson of a Village Executive for two terms become a candidate again?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिकाको अध्यक्ष दुई कार्यकाल निर्वाचित भएको व्यक्ति पुनः उम्मेदवार बन्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 215(7) prohibits a person elected as Chairperson for two terms from being a candidate again.

English Question: Who chairs the Municipal Executive?
Nepali Question: नगर कार्यपालिकाको अध्यक्षता कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Mayor.
Explanation: Article 216(1) states that the Municipal Executive is formed under the chairpersonship of the Mayor.

English Question: How many women members and how many Dalit or minority members are included in the Municipal Executive?
Nepali Question: नगर कार्यपालिकामा कति महिला सदस्य र कति दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five women members and three Dalit or minority members.
Gold Answer (NE): पाँच महिला सदस्य र तीन दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 216(4) specifies five women members and three members from Dalit or minority communities.

English Question: What electoral system is used to elect the Mayor and Deputy Mayor?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख र उपप्रमुख निर्वाचन गर्न कुन निर्वाचन प्रणाली प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): First past the post electoral system.
Gold Answer (NE): पहिलो हुने निर्वाचित हुने निर्वाचन प्रणाली।
Explanation: Article 216(3) provides election through secret ballot using the first past the post system.

English Question: Who coordinates the Judicial Committee in a Village Body?
Nepali Question: गाउँपालिकाको न्यायिक समितिको संयोजक को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Vice-Chairperson.
Explanation: Article 217(1) states that the Judicial Committee is coordinated by the Vice-Chairperson in a Village Body.

English Question: Who coordinates the Judicial Committee in a Municipality?
Nepali Question: नगरपालिकाको न्यायिक समितिको संयोजक को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Deputy Mayor.
Explanation: Article 217(1) assigns coordination of the Municipal Judicial Committee to the Deputy Mayor.

English Question: What is the purpose of establishing the District Assembly?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला सभा गठन गर्नुको उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To make coordination between Village Bodies and Municipalities within the district.
Gold Answer (NE): जिल्लाभित्रका गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाबीच समन्वय गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 220(1) states the District Assembly exists for coordination between local bodies.

English Question: What is the maximum number of members in the District Coordination Committee?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला समन्वय समितिमा अधिकतम कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Nine members.
Explanation: Article 220(3) provides that the District Coordination Committee consists of a maximum of nine members.

English Question: What minimum representation requirements apply to the District Coordination Committee?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला समन्वय समितिमा न्यूनतम कस्तो प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least three women and at least one Dalit or minority member.
Gold Answer (NE): कम्तीमा तीन महिला र कम्तीमा एक दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 220(3) establishes these representation requirements.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chief, Deputy Chief, and members of the District Coordination Committee?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला समन्वय समितिका प्रमुख, उपप्रमुख र सदस्यहरूको कार्यकाल कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 220(5) provides a five-year term after election.

English Question: What happens to a Village Assembly or Municipal Assembly member's office if they are elected as Chief, Deputy Chief, or Member of the District Coordination Committee?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा वा नगर सभाको सदस्य जिल्ला समन्वय समितिको प्रमुख, उपप्रमुख वा सदस्य निर्वाचित भएमा उसको पदमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The office of Village Assembly or Municipal Assembly member automatically lapses.
Gold Answer (NE): गाउँ सभा वा नगर सभाको सदस्य पद स्वतः समाप्त हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 220(4) states that the previous office lapses ipso facto upon election.

English Question: Which government law provides for other functions of the District Assembly?
Nepali Question: जिल्ला सभाका अन्य कार्यहरू कुन कानुनले व्यवस्था गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State law.
Explanation: Article 220(7)(d) states that other functions are as provided by State law.

English Question: In which bodies is the legislative power of the Local Level vested?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहको विधायिकी शक्ति कुन निकायमा निहित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly.
Explanation: Article 221(1) states that legislative powers of the Local Level are vested in the Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly.

English Question: Which Schedules contain the legislative powers of the Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा र नगर सभाको विधायिकी शक्ति कुन अनुसूचीमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.
Explanation: Article 221(2) provides that these legislative powers are mentioned in Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.

English Question: What is the legislative body established in each Village Body called?
Nepali Question: प्रत्येक गाउँपालिकामा स्थापना हुने विधायिकी निकायलाई के भनिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Assembly.
Explanation: Article 222(1) states that each Village Body shall have a Village Assembly.

English Question: Who are the members of the Village Assembly?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभाका सदस्यहरू को-को हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, Ward Chairpersons, four members from each ward, and Dalit or minority members of the Village Executive.
Gold Answer (NE): अध्यक्ष, उपाध्यक्ष, वडा अध्यक्षहरू, प्रत्येक वडाबाट चार सदस्य र गाउँ कार्यपालिकाका दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक सदस्यहरू।
Explanation: Article 222(2) defines the composition of the Village Assembly.

English Question: How many women must be represented from each ward in a Village Assembly?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभामा प्रत्येक वडाबाट कति जना महिला प्रतिनिधित्व हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two women.
Explanation: Article 222(3) requires representation of at least two women from each ward.

English Question: What is the composition of a Ward Committee of a Village Body?
Nepali Question: गाउँपालिकाको वडा समितिको संरचना कस्तो हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): One Ward Chairperson and four members.
Gold Answer (NE): एक वडा अध्यक्ष र चार सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 222(4) provides that each Ward Committee consists of the Ward Chairperson and four members.

English Question: What is the minimum age required to vote in Village Assembly elections?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा निर्वाचनमा मतदान गर्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Eighteen years.
Explanation: Article 222(5) grants voting rights to persons who have completed eighteen years and are included in electoral rolls.

English Question: What is the minimum age qualification to become a candidate for Village Assembly membership?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा सदस्यको उम्मेदवार बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty-one years.
Explanation: Article 222(6)(b) requires completion of twenty-one years of age.

English Question: Besides citizenship and age, what electoral requirement must a Village Assembly candidate fulfill?
Nepali Question: नागरिकता र उमेर बाहेक गाउँ सभा सदस्यको उम्मेदवारले कुन निर्वाचनसम्बन्धी योग्यता पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Name included in the electoral rolls of the Village Body.
Gold Answer (NE): गाउँपालिकाको मतदाता नामावलीमा नाम समावेश भएको।
Explanation: Article 222(6)(c) requires the candidate's name to be included in the Village Body electoral rolls.

English Question: What legislative body exists in each Municipality?
Nepali Question: प्रत्येक नगरपालिकामा कुन विधायिकी निकाय हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Municipal Assembly.
Explanation: Article 223(1) states that each Municipality shall have a Municipal Assembly.

English Question: Who are the members of the Municipal Assembly?
Nepali Question: नगर सभाका सदस्यहरू को-को हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Ward Chairpersons, four members from each Ward, and Dalit or minority members of the Municipal Executive.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रमुख, उपप्रमुख, वडा अध्यक्षहरू, प्रत्येक वडाबाट चार सदस्य र नगर कार्यपालिकाका दलित वा अल्पसंख्यक सदस्यहरू।
Explanation: Article 223(2) defines the composition of the Municipal Assembly.

English Question: How many women must be represented from each Ward in a Municipal Assembly?
Nepali Question: नगर सभामा प्रत्येक वडाबाट कति जना महिला प्रतिनिधित्व हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two women.
Explanation: Article 223(3) requires at least two women from each Ward.

English Question: What is the same required composition of Ward Committees in Village Bodies and Municipalities?
Nepali Question: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाका वडा समितिको समान संरचना के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): One Ward Chairperson and four members.
Gold Answer (NE): एक वडा अध्यक्ष र चार सदस्य।
Explanation: Articles 222(4) and 223(4) provide the same Ward Committee structure.

English Question: What is the minimum age required to vote in Municipal Assembly elections?
Nepali Question: नगर सभा निर्वाचनमा मतदान गर्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Eighteen years.
Explanation: Article 223(5) provides voting rights for persons who have completed eighteen years and are included in electoral rolls.

English Question: What qualifications are required to become a candidate for Municipal Assembly membership?
Nepali Question: नगर सभा सदस्यको उम्मेदवार बन्न के-कस्ता योग्यता आवश्यक हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepali citizenship, twenty-one years of age, name in Municipality electoral rolls, and not disqualified by law.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको नागरिकता, २१ वर्ष उमेर, नगरपालिकाको मतदाता नामावलीमा नाम, र कानुनद्वारा अयोग्य नभएको।
Explanation: Article 223(6) specifies these qualifications.

English Question: Who automatically becomes the Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson of the Village Assembly?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभाको अध्यक्ष र उपाध्यक्ष स्वतः को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson of the Village Executive.
Explanation: Article 224 provides that Village Executive Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson become Village Assembly Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson.

English Question: Who automatically becomes the Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson of the Municipal Assembly?
Nepali Question: नगर सभाको अध्यक्ष र उपाध्यक्ष स्वतः को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Mayor and Deputy Mayor of the Municipal Executive.
Explanation: Article 224 provides this arrangement for Municipal Assembly leadership.

English Question: What is the term of the Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा र नगर सभाको कार्यकाल कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Article 225 states that both assemblies have a five-year term from the date of election.

English Question: When must another Village Assembly or Municipal Assembly be elected after expiration of the current term?
Nepali Question: हालको गाउँ सभा वा नगर सभाको कार्यकाल समाप्त भएपछि अर्को सभा कहिलेसम्म निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Not later than six months after expiration of the term.
Explanation: Article 225 requires another assembly to be elected within six months of expiry.

English Question: On which matters may a Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly make laws?
Nepali Question: गाउँ सभा र नगर सभाले कुन विषयमा कानुन बनाउन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Matters contained in Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुसूची–८ र अनुसूची–९ मा रहेका विषयहरू।
Explanation: Article 226(1) grants law-making power on matters listed in Schedule-8 and Schedule-9.

English Question: Under what condition may taxes be levied and collected and loans be raised at the Local Level?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहमा कर लगाउन र उठाउन तथा ऋण उठाउन कुन अवस्थामा पाइन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Only in accordance with law.
Explanation: Article 228(1) states that no tax shall be levied and collected and no loan raised except in accordance with law.

English Question: On what matters may the Local Level levy taxes by law?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहले कानुन बनाएर कुन विषयमा कर लगाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Matters falling within its domain.
Explanation: Article 228(2) allows the Local Level to levy taxes on matters within its domain while respecting national economic policies and other limitations.

English Question: What factors must the Local Level consider while levying taxes within its domain?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहले आफ्नो अधिकार क्षेत्रमा कर लगाउँदा कुन-कुन विषयलाई ध्यान दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National economic policies, carriage of goods and services, capital and labour market, and neighbouring State or Local Level.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रिय आर्थिक नीति, वस्तु तथा सेवाको ओसारपसार, पुँजी तथा श्रम बजार, र छिमेकी प्रदेश वा स्थानीय तह।
Explanation: Article 228(2) specifies these limitations on Local Level taxation.

English Question: What fund shall each Village Body and Municipality have under the Local Level?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहअन्तर्गत प्रत्येक गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकासँग कुन कोष हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Local Consolidated Fund.
Explanation: Article 229(1) provides that each Village Body and Municipality shall have one Local Consolidated Fund.

English Question: Which sources of money are credited to the Local Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय सञ्चित कोषमा कुन-कुन रकम जम्मा गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Revenues, grants from the Government of Nepal and State Government, loans raised by the Local Level, and amounts received from other sources.
Gold Answer (NE): राजस्व, नेपाल सरकार र प्रदेश सरकारबाट प्राप्त अनुदान, स्थानीय तहले उठाएका ऋण तथा अन्य स्रोतबाट प्राप्त रकम।
Explanation: Article 229(1) lists the sources credited to the Local Consolidated Fund.

English Question: Which law provides for expenditures from the Local Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय सञ्चित कोषबाट हुने खर्चसम्बन्धी विषय कुन कानुनले व्यवस्था गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Local law.
Explanation: Article 229(2) states that matters relating to expenditures from the Local Consolidated Fund shall be provided for in Local law.

English Question: Which bodies prepare and pass the annual revenue and expenditure estimates at the Local Level?
Nepali Question: स्थानीय तहमा वार्षिक आय–व्यय अनुमान कसले पेश गर्छ र कसले पारित गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Village Executive and Municipal Executive prepare; Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly pass them.
Gold Answer (NE): गाउँ कार्यपालिका र नगर कार्यपालिकाले पेश गर्छन्; गाउँ सभा र नगर सभाले पारित गर्छन्।
Explanation: Article 230(1) assigns preparation to executives and approval to respective assemblies.

English Question: What must a Village Executive or Municipal Executive propose if it presents a deficit budget?
Nepali Question: गाउँ कार्यपालिका वा नगर कार्यपालिकाले घाटा बजेट पेश गरेमा के प्रस्ताव गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sources to meet the deficit.
Explanation: Article 230(2) requires proposing sources to meet the deficit according to Federal and State law.

English Question: To what extent may Federal Law be made applicable according to Article 231?
Nepali Question: धारा २३१ अनुसार संघीय कानून कुन क्षेत्रमा लागू गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The whole of Nepal or any part of its territory.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको सम्पूर्ण भूभाग वा आवश्यक परे कुनै भागमा।
Explanation: Article 231(1) states that Federal Law may apply to the whole territory of Nepal or any required part.

English Question: What is the difference between the applicability of Federal Law and State Law under Article 231?
Nepali Question: धारा २३१ अनुसार संघीय कानून र प्रदेश कानूनको लागू हुने क्षेत्रबीच के फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal Law applies to Nepal or any part of Nepal; State Law applies to the whole or any part of that State.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय कानून नेपालभर वा कुनै भागमा लागू हुन्छ; प्रदेश कानून सम्बन्धित प्रदेशभर वा त्यसको कुनै भागमा लागू हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 231(1) and 231(2) distinguish the territorial scope of Federal and State laws.

English Question: When may the Federal Parliament make laws on matters listed in Schedule-6 for States?
Nepali Question: अनुसूची-६ मा रहेका विषयमा संघीय संसदले कहिले कानून बनाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): When two or more States request the Government of Nepal to make such laws.
Gold Answer (NE): दुई वा दुईभन्दा बढी प्रदेशले नेपाल सरकारलाई कानून बनाउन अनुरोध गरेमा।
Explanation: Article 231(3) allows Federal Parliament to make laws on Schedule-6 matters upon request from two or more States.

English Question: What principles form the basis of relations between the Federation, States, and Local levels?
Nepali Question: संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहबीचको सम्बन्ध कुन सिद्धान्तमा आधारित हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Cooperation, co-existence and coordination.
Explanation: Article 232(1) states that relations between the three levels are based on these principles.

English Question: Who may give necessary directions to a State Council of Ministers on matters of national importance?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महत्वका विषयमा प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्लाई आवश्यक निर्देशन कसले दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 232(2) provides that the Government of Nepal may give directions to State Councils of Ministers.

English Question: For how long may the President suspend or dissolve a State Council of Ministers and State Assembly under Article 232(3)?
Nepali Question: धारा २३२(३) अनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद् र प्रदेश सभा कति समयसम्म निलम्बन वा विघटन गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Not exceeding six months.
Explanation: Article 232(3) limits such suspension or dissolution to a period not exceeding six months.

English Question: What majority of the Federal Parliament is required to ratify suspension or dissolution of a State Council of Ministers and State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद् र प्रदेश सभा निलम्बन वा विघटनको अनुमोदन गर्न संघीय संसदमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Two-thirds majority of the total number of existing members.
Gold Answer (NE): तत्काल कायम रहेका सदस्यहरूको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 232(4) requires ratification by a two-thirds majority within thirty-five days.

English Question: Within how many days must the Federal Parliament ratify a suspension or dissolution made under Article 232(3)?
Nepali Question: धारा २३२(३) अन्तर्गत गरिएको निलम्बन वा विघटनलाई संघीय संसदले कति दिनभित्र अनुमोदन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within thirty-five days.
Explanation: Article 232(4) specifies that ratification must occur within thirty-five days.

English Question: If dissolution of a State Assembly is ratified, within what period must an election be held?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभा विघटन अनुमोदन भएमा कति समयभित्र निर्वाचन गरिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within six months.
Explanation: Article 232(5) requires election to the State Assembly within six months.

English Question: During Federal rule in a State, which body may make laws on Schedule-6 matters?
Nepali Question: प्रदेशमा संघीय शासन कायम रहेको समयमा अनुसूची-६ का विषयमा कानून कसले बनाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federal Parliament.
Explanation: Article 232(7) provides that the Federal Parliament may make such laws during Federal rule.

English Question: What must one State do regarding legal provisions or judicial and administrative decisions of another State?
Nepali Question: एउटा प्रदेशले अर्को प्रदेशको कानूनी व्यवस्था वा न्यायिक तथा प्रशासनिक निर्णय सम्बन्धमा के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Render assistance in execution.
Explanation: Article 233(1) requires one State to assist another State in execution of legal and administrative matters.

English Question: Who chairs the Inter-State Council?
Nepali Question: अन्तरप्रदेश परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 234(1)(a) identifies the Prime Minister as Chairperson of the Inter-State Council.

English Question: Which ministers of the Government of Nepal are members of the Inter-State Council?
Nepali Question: अन्तरप्रदेश परिषद्को सदस्यको रूपमा नेपाल सरकारका कुन मन्त्रीहरू रहने व्यवस्था छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Minister for Home Affairs and Minister for Finance.
Explanation: Article 234(1)(b) and 234(1)(c) list these ministers as members.

English Question: What is the purpose of establishing the Inter-State Council?
Nepali Question: अन्तरप्रदेश परिषद् स्थापना गर्नुको उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To settle political disputes between the Federation and a State and between States.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ र प्रदेश तथा प्रदेशहरूबीच उत्पन्न राजनीतिक विवाद समाधान गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 234(1) establishes the Inter-State Council for settling political disputes.

English Question: What is prohibited regarding carriage of goods and extension of services between States and Local levels?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहबीच वस्तु तथा सेवाको आवतजावत सम्बन्धमा के निषेध गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Obstruction, taxation, fees, charges, or discrimination.
Gold Answer (NE): अवरोध, कर, शुल्क, दस्तुर वा भेदभाव।
Explanation: Article 236 prohibits obstruction, taxation, charges, or discrimination on inter-State trade.

English Question: Does Part-20 affect the jurisdiction of the Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court?
Nepali Question: भाग-२० ले सर्वोच्च अदालतको संवैधानिक इजलासको अधिकारक्षेत्रलाई असर गर्छ कि गर्दैन?
Gold Answer (EN): No, it does not affect it.
Explanation: Article 237 states that nothing in this Part affects the jurisdiction of the Constitutional Bench under Article 137.

Subdomain: Commission for Investigation of Abuse of Authority
English Question: What is the constitutional name of the anti-corruption commission established under Article 238?
Nepali Question: धारा २३८ अनुसार स्थापना गरिएको भ्रष्टाचार अनुसन्धान गर्ने आयोगको संवैधानिक नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 238(1) establishes the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority of Nepal.

Subdomain: Commission for Investigation of Abuse of Authority
English Question: How many members are included in the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority?
Nepali Question: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगमा कति जना सदस्य रहने व्यवस्था छ?
