Gold Answer (EN): Five members including one Chief Commissioner and four Commissioners.
Gold Answer (NE): एक जना प्रमुख आयुक्त र चार जना आयुक्त गरी पाँच जना।
Explanation: Article 238(1) states that the Commission consists of the Chief Commissioner and four other Commissioners.

Subdomain: Commission for Investigation of Abuse of Authority
English Question: Who acts as the Chairperson of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority?
Nepali Question: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगको अध्यक्षको रूपमा कसले काम गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Commissioner.
Explanation: Article 238(1) provides that the Chief Commissioner acts as the Chairperson of the Commission.

English Question: Who appoints the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority?
Nepali Question: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगका प्रमुख आयुक्त र आयुक्तलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 238(2) states that the President appoints them on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: On whose recommendation does the President appoint the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिले प्रमुख आयुक्त र आयुक्तलाई कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 238(2) requires appointment by the President based on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख आयुक्त र आयुक्तहरूको पदावधि कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 238(3) specifies a six-year term from the date of appointment.

English Question: At what age does the office of the Chief Commissioner or Commissioner become vacant?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्तको पद कुन उमेर पुगेपछि रिक्त हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty-five years.
Explanation: Article 238(4)(b) states that the office becomes vacant upon attaining the age of sixty-five years.

English Question: What minimum age is required to be appointed as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्त बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Forty-five years.
Explanation: Article 238(6)(d) requires a candidate to have attained the age of forty-five years.

English Question: What minimum educational qualification is required for appointment as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्त नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम शैक्षिक योग्यता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
Explanation: Article 238(6)(a) specifies the educational qualification requirement.

English Question: How many years of experience must a person have in specified fields to qualify as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्त बन्न सम्बन्धित क्षेत्रमा कति वर्षको अनुभव आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least twenty years.
Explanation: Article 238(6)(c) requires at least twenty years of experience in specified fields.

English Question: Can a member of a political party at the time of appointment become Chief Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: नियुक्तिको समयमा राजनीतिक दलको सदस्य रहेको व्यक्ति प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्त बन्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 238(6)(b) requires that the person must not be a member of any political party at the time of appointment.

English Question: Is a person once appointed as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner eligible for another government service?
Nepali Question: एक पटक प्रमुख आयुक्त वा आयुक्त नियुक्त भएको व्यक्ति अन्य सरकारी सेवामा नियुक्त हुन योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 238(8) prohibits appointment to other government service after serving as Chief Commissioner or Commissioner.

English Question: What type of abuse may the Commission investigate under Article 239?
Nepali Question: धारा २३९ अनुसार आयोगले कस्तो दुरुपयोगको अनुसन्धान गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Abuse of authority committed through corruption by a person holding public office.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेको व्यक्तिले भ्रष्टाचारमार्फत गरेको अख्तियार दुरुपयोग।
Explanation: Article 239(1) grants authority to investigate corruption-related abuse of authority by public officials.

English Question: Does the Commission investigate every public official involved in abuse of authority?
Nepali Question: के आयोगले अख्तियार दुरुपयोग गर्ने सबै सार्वजनिक अधिकारीको अनुसन्धान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No, exceptions apply where the Constitution or other law provides separate provisions.
Gold Answer (NE): गर्दैन, संविधान वा अन्य कानूनले छुट्टै व्यवस्था गरेको अवस्थामा अपवाद हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 239(1) excludes officials for whom the Constitution or other laws provide separate special procedures.

English Question: When may the Commission investigate persons removable by impeachment or Judicial Council action?
Nepali Question: महाभियोग वा न्याय परिषद्बाट हटाउन सकिने व्यक्तिको अनुसन्धान आयोगले कहिले गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): After they have been removed from office.
Explanation: Article 239(2) allows investigation of such persons after removal from office.

English Question: Where may the Commission file a case if corruption is established through investigation?
Nepali Question: अनुसन्धानबाट भ्रष्टाचार प्रमाणित भएमा आयोगले कहाँ मुद्दा दायर गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In the competent court.
Explanation: Article 239(3) states that the Commission may file cases in the competent court.

English Question: To whom may the Commission delegate its functions, duties and powers?
Nepali Question: आयोगले आफ्नो कार्य, कर्तव्य र अधिकार कसलाई प्रत्यायोजन गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Chief Commissioner, Commissioner, or officer employee of the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रमुख आयुक्त, आयुक्त वा नेपाल सरकारको अधिकृत कर्मचारीलाई।
Explanation: Article 239(5) provides authority for delegation under specified conditions.

English Question: What action may the Commission take if an investigated matter falls under another official body's jurisdiction?
Nepali Question: अनुसन्धान गरिएको विषय अर्को निकायको अधिकारक्षेत्रमा पर्ने देखिएमा आयोगले के गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Write to the concerned official or body for necessary action.
Gold Answer (NE): आवश्यक कारबाहीका लागि सम्बन्धित अधिकारी वा निकायलाई लेखी पठाउन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 239(4) allows the Commission to refer such matters to the concerned authority.

English Question: Which constitutional office shall exist as the Auditor General of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानमा कुन संवैधानिक पदको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Auditor General of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 240(1) provides that there shall be an Auditor General of Nepal.

English Question: Who appoints the Auditor General of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको महालेखा परीक्षकलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 240(2) states that the President appoints the Auditor General.

English Question: On whose recommendation does the President appoint the Auditor General?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिले महालेखा परीक्षकलाई कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 240(2) requires the recommendation of the Constitutional Council for appointment.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Auditor General from the date of appointment?
Nepali Question: नियुक्तिको मितिदेखि महालेखा परीक्षकको पदावधि कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years.
Explanation: Article 240(3) specifies a six-year term from the date of appointment.

English Question: To whom must the Auditor General submit a written resignation to vacate the office?
Nepali Question: पद रिक्त गराउन महालेखा परीक्षकले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई बुझाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 240(4)(a) states that resignation submitted in writing to the President creates vacancy.

English Question: At what age does the office of Auditor General become vacant?
Nepali Question: कुन उमेर पुगेपछि महालेखा परीक्षकको पद रिक्त हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty-five years.
Explanation: Article 240(4)(b) states that the office becomes vacant after attaining sixty-five years of age.

English Question: Which constitutional process can remove the Auditor General from office before completion of the term?
Nepali Question: पदावधि पूरा हुनुअघि कुन संवैधानिक प्रक्रियाबाट महालेखा परीक्षक पदमुक्त हुन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Impeachment under Article 101.
Explanation: Article 240(4)(c) mentions vacancy if a motion of impeachment is passed under Article 101.

English Question: Who recommends removal of the Auditor General due to physical or mental illness causing inability to perform duties?
Nepali Question: शारीरिक वा मानसिक रोगका कारण कार्य गर्न असमर्थ भएमा महालेखा परीक्षकलाई हटाउन कसले सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 240(4)(d) states removal by the President on recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What happens to the office of the Auditor General if the Auditor General dies?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षकको मृत्यु भएमा पदको अवस्था के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The office becomes vacant.
Explanation: Article 240(4)(e) lists death as a circumstance creating vacancy.

English Question: Is the Auditor General appointed under Article 240(2) eligible for reappointment?
Nepali Question: धारा २४०(२) बमोजिम नियुक्त महालेखा परीक्षक पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No, not eligible.
Explanation: Article 240(5) prohibits reappointment of the Auditor General appointed under clause (2).

English Question: What type of qualification is required regarding audit experience for appointment as Auditor General?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षक नियुक्तिका लागि लेखापरीक्षण अनुभवसम्बन्धी कस्तो योग्यता आवश्यक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Twenty years of audit-related experience or equivalent specified qualification.
Gold Answer (NE): बीस वर्ष लेखापरीक्षणसम्बन्धी अनुभव वा तोकिएको समकक्ष योग्यता।
Explanation: Article 240(6)(a) provides the experience and education requirements.

English Question: Which academic fields are mentioned for a bachelor's degree qualification for Auditor General appointment?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षक नियुक्तिका लागि स्नातक तहको कुन-कुन विषय उल्लेख गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Management, commerce, or accounting.
Explanation: Article 240(6)(a) mentions these fields of bachelor's degree.

English Question: Can a person who is a member of a political party at the time of appointment become Auditor General?
Nepali Question: नियुक्तिको समयमा राजनीतिक दलको सदस्य रहेको व्यक्ति महालेखा परीक्षक बन्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 240(6)(b) requires the person not to be a member of any political party at appointment.

English Question: What minimum age is required for appointment as Auditor General?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षक नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम उमेर कति आवश्यक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Forty-five years.
Explanation: Article 240(6)(c) requires attainment of forty-five years of age.

English Question: What moral requirement is specified for appointment as Auditor General?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षक नियुक्तिका लागि कस्तो नैतिक आवश्यकता तोकिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): High moral character.
Explanation: Article 240(6)(d) requires the person to have high moral character.

English Question: Can the remuneration and conditions of service of the Auditor General be changed to their disadvantage while holding office?
Nepali Question: पदमा रहँदा महालेखा परीक्षकको पारिश्रमिक र सेवाका सर्तहरू निजको प्रतिकूल परिवर्तन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 240(7) protects remuneration and conditions of service from disadvantageous alteration.

English Question: What is the exception to the protection against disadvantageous alteration of the Auditor General's remuneration and service conditions?
Nepali Question: महालेखा परीक्षकको सेवाका सर्तहरू प्रतिकूल परिवर्तन गर्न नपाइने व्यवस्थाको अपवाद के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Emergency declared due to extreme economic disarrays.
Gold Answer (NE): चरम आर्थिक अव्यवस्थाका कारण संकटकाल घोषणा भएको अवस्था।
Explanation: The proviso of Article 240(7) provides this exception.

English Question: Is a person once appointed as Auditor General eligible for another government service?
Nepali Question: एक पटक महालेखा परीक्षक नियुक्त भएको व्यक्ति अर्को सरकारी सेवामा नियुक्त हुन योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 240(8) restricts appointment in another government service after serving as Auditor General.

English Question: Which authority audits the accounts of Federal and State Government Offices and constitutional bodies?
Nepali Question: संघीय तथा प्रदेश सरकारी कार्यालय र संवैधानिक निकायहरूको लेखा कसले परीक्षण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Auditor General.
Explanation: Article 241(1) assigns these audits to the Auditor General.

English Question: Besides the offices listed in Article 241(1), who may require audits of other offices or bodies by the Auditor General?
Nepali Question: धारा २४१(१) मा उल्लिखित कार्यालय बाहेक अन्य कार्यालय वा निकायको लेखापरीक्षण कसले आवश्यक बनाउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal law.
Explanation: Article 241(5) allows Federal law to require audits of other offices or bodies.

English Question: What is the constitutional name of the commission established under Article 242?
Nepali Question: धारा २४२ अन्तर्गत स्थापना गरिएको आयोगको संवैधानिक नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Public Service Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 242(1) establishes the Public Service Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many members, including the Chairperson, constitute the Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: अध्यक्षसहित लोक सेवा आयोगमा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 242(1) states that the commission consists of the Chairperson and four other Members.

English Question: Who appoints the Chairperson and Members of the Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 242(2) provides that the President appoints the Chairperson and Members.

English Question: On whose recommendation are the Chairperson and Members of the Public Service Commission appointed?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 242(2) requires the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What minimum percentage of Public Service Commission Members must be appointed from persons with twenty or more years of government service experience?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगका सदस्यहरूमध्ये कम्तीमा कति प्रतिशत सदस्य २० वर्ष वा सोभन्दा बढी सरकारी सेवामा काम गरेका व्यक्तिबाट नियुक्त हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Fifty percent.
Explanation: Article 242(3) requires at least fifty percent of Members to be appointed from such persons.

English Question: Besides government service experience, from which fields may the remaining Members of the Public Service Commission be appointed?
Nepali Question: सरकारी सेवा अनुभव बाहेक बाँकी सदस्यहरू कुन-कुन क्षेत्रमा प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त व्यक्तिहरूमध्येबाट नियुक्त हुन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Science, technology, art, literature, law, public administration, sociology, or other spheres of national life.
Gold Answer (NE): विज्ञान, प्रविधि, कला, साहित्य, कानून, सार्वजनिक प्रशासन, समाजशास्त्र वा राष्ट्रिय जीवनका अन्य क्षेत्र।
Explanation: Article 242(3) specifies these fields for remaining Members.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chairperson and Members of the Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 242(4) provides a six-year term.

English Question: Can a Member of the Public Service Commission be appointed as Chairperson after serving as a Member?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगको सदस्य अध्यक्ष पदमा नियुक्त हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 242(5) allows a Member to be appointed as Chairperson, with the term calculated including the Member term.

English Question: To whom must a Chairperson or Member submit a written resignation to vacate office?
Nepali Question: अध्यक्ष वा सदस्यले पद रिक्त गराउन लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 242(6)(a) provides resignation in writing to the President as a vacancy condition.

English Question: At what age does the office of the Chairperson or Member of the Public Service Commission become vacant?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगका अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य कुन उमेर पुगेपछि पद रिक्त हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty-five years.
Explanation: Article 242(6)(b) specifies vacancy upon attaining sixty-five years.

English Question: What educational qualification is required for appointment as Chairperson or Member of the Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य नियुक्तिका लागि कस्तो शैक्षिक योग्यता आवश्यक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Master's degree from a recognized university.
Explanation: Article 242(7)(a) requires a master's degree from a recognized university.

English Question: Is a person who is a member of a political party at the time of appointment eligible to become Chairperson or Member of the Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: नियुक्तिको समयमा राजनीतिक दलको सदस्य रहेको व्यक्ति लोक सेवा आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य बन्न योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 242(7)(b) prohibits appointment of a political party member at the time of appointment.

English Question: What is the main duty of the Public Service Commission regarding Civil Service positions?
Nepali Question: लोक सेवा आयोगको निजामती सेवाका पद सम्बन्धी मुख्य कर्तव्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Conduct examinations for selection of suitable candidates.
Gold Answer (NE): उपयुक्त उम्मेदवार छनोटका लागि परीक्षा सञ्चालन गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 243(1) assigns the duty of conducting examinations for Civil Service positions.

English Question: Under Article 243, do positions in the Army, Nepal Police, and Armed Police Force fall under the definition of Civil Service positions?
Nepali Question: धारा २४३ अनुसार सेना, नेपाल प्रहरी र सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलका पदहरू निजामती सेवाको पदभित्र पर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: The explanation under Article 243(1) excludes these positions from Civil Service positions.

English Question: What type of examinations does the Public Service Commission conduct for Nepal Army, Nepal Police, Armed Police Force, and other Federal governmental services?
Nepali Question: नेपाली सेना, नेपाल प्रहरी, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल र अन्य संघीय सरकारी सेवाका लागि लोक सेवा आयोगले कस्तो परीक्षा सञ्चालन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Written examinations.
Explanation: Article 243(2) states that the Commission conducts written examinations for these positions.

English Question: For what employment decisions in Nepal Army, Nepal Police, Armed Police Force, and other Federal services must the Public Service Commission be consulted?
Nepali Question: नेपाली सेना, नेपाल प्रहरी, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल र अन्य संघीय सेवामा कुन-कुन निर्णयका लागि लोक सेवा आयोगसँग परामर्श गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): General principles of appointment and promotion.
Explanation: Article 243(3) requires consultation on general principles for appointment and promotion.

English Question: For how long must a Federal Civil Service appointment candidate be considered before consultation regarding suitability is required?
Nepali Question: संघीय निजामती सेवाको उम्मेदवारको उपयुक्ततासम्बन्धी परामर्श कहिले आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): For appointment for a period of more than six months.
Gold Answer (NE): छ महिनाभन्दा बढी अवधिको नियुक्तिका लागि।
Explanation: Article 243(6)(c) specifies candidates appointed for more than six months.

English Question: Does each State have a State Public Service Commission under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 244(1) provides that each State shall have a State Public Service Commission.

English Question: What determines the functions, duties, and powers of the State Public Service Commission?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोगको काम, कर्तव्य र अधिकार केद्वारा निर्धारण हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State law.
Explanation: Article 244(2) states that functions, duties, and powers are provided by State law.

English Question: Who determines the grounds and standards for the functions, duties, and powers of State Public Service Commissions?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोगको काम, कर्तव्य र अधिकारका लागि आधार र मापदण्ड कसले निर्धारण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal Parliament by law.
Explanation: Article 244(3) states that Federal Parliament shall determine grounds and standards by law.

English Question: What constitutional body is established under Article 245?
Nepali Question: धारा २४५ अन्तर्गत कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Election Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 245(1) establishes the Election Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many Commissioners, including the Chief Election Commissioner, constitute the Election Commission?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्तसहित निर्वाचन आयोगमा कति जना आयुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five Commissioners.
Explanation: Article 245(1) states that the Election Commission consists of a Chief Commissioner and four other Commissioners.

English Question: Who acts as the chairperson of the Election Commission?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगको अध्यक्षको रूपमा कसले कार्य गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Chief Election Commissioner.
Explanation: Article 245(1) provides that the Chief Commissioner acts as the chairperson of the Election Commission.

English Question: Who appoints the Chief Election Commissioner and Commissioners?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त र निर्वाचन आयुक्तहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 245(2) provides that the President appoints them.

English Question: On whose recommendation are the Chief Election Commissioner and Commissioners appointed?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त र निर्वाचन आयुक्तहरू कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 245(2) requires recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chief Election Commissioner and Commissioners?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त र निर्वाचन आयुक्तहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 245(3) provides a six-year term.

English Question: To whom must the Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner submit a written resignation to vacate office?
Nepali Question: पद रिक्त गराउन प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा निर्वाचन आयुक्तले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 245(4)(a) states resignation must be submitted in writing to the President.

English Question: At what age does the office of the Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner become vacant?
Nepali Question: कुन उमेर पुगेपछि प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा निर्वाचन आयुक्तको पद रिक्त हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Sixty-five years.
Explanation: Article 245(4)(b) specifies vacancy upon attaining sixty-five years.

English Question: Which constitutional process can remove the Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner before completion of tenure?
Nepali Question: पदावधि पूरा हुनुअघि प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा निर्वाचन आयुक्तलाई कुन संवैधानिक प्रक्रियाबाट हटाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Impeachment under Article 101.
Explanation: Article 245(4)(c) mentions vacancy if impeachment motion is passed under Article 101.

English Question: Who recommends removal of an Election Commissioner due to physical or mental illness preventing performance of duties?
Nepali Question: शारीरिक वा मानसिक रोगका कारण कार्य गर्न असमर्थ भएमा निर्वाचन आयुक्त हटाउन कसले सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 245(4)(d) states removal by President on Constitutional Council recommendation.

English Question: Is a Commissioner appointed under Article 245(2) eligible for reappointment?
Nepali Question: धारा २४५(२) बमोजिम नियुक्त निर्वाचन आयुक्त पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No, not eligible.
Explanation: Article 245(5) prohibits reappointment.

English Question: Can a Commissioner later be appointed as the Chief Election Commissioner?
Nepali Question: के निर्वाचन आयुक्त पछि प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त नियुक्त हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 245(5) provides an exception allowing appointment of a Commissioner as Chief Election Commissioner.

English Question: What minimum educational qualification is required for appointment as Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा निर्वाचन आयुक्त नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम शैक्षिक योग्यता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
Explanation: Article 245(6)(a) specifies this qualification.

English Question: Can a member of a political party at the time of appointment become Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: नियुक्तिको समयमा राजनीतिक दलको सदस्य रहेको व्यक्ति प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा आयुक्त बन्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 245(6)(b) requires that the person is not a member of any political party.

English Question: What minimum age is required for appointment as Chief Election Commissioner or Commissioner?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त वा निर्वाचन आयुक्त नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम उमेर कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Forty-five years.
Explanation: Article 245(6)(c) requires attainment of forty-five years.

English Question: Which elections does the Election Commission conduct, supervise, direct, and control?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगले कुन-कुन निर्वाचन सञ्चालन, अनुगमन, निर्देशन र नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): President, Vice-President, Federal Parliament, State Assembly, and Local level elections.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपति, उपराष्ट्रपति, संघीय संसद, प्रदेश सभा र स्थानीय तहका निर्वाचन।
Explanation: Article 246(1) lists these elections.

English Question: What electoral document does the Election Commission prepare for election purposes?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगले निर्वाचन प्रयोजनका लागि कुन अभिलेख तयार गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Electoral rolls.
Explanation: Article 246(1) states that the Election Commission prepares electoral rolls.

English Question: Can the Election Commission conduct a referendum on matters of national importance?
Nepali Question: के निर्वाचन आयोगले राष्ट्रिय महत्वको विषयमा जनमत संग्रह गराउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 246(2) empowers the Election Commission to hold referendums according to Constitution and Federal law.

English Question: Who decides a candidate qualification dispute arising after nomination but before declaration of election results?
Nepali Question: उम्मेदवारी दर्तापछि तर निर्वाचन परिणाम घोषणा हुनुअघि उम्मेदवारको योग्यतासम्बन्धी प्रश्न उठेमा निर्णय कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Election Commission.
Explanation: Article 246(3) assigns this decision to the Election Commission.

English Question: Can the Election Commission delegate its functions, duties, and powers?
Nepali Question: के निर्वाचन आयोगले आफ्नो काम, कर्तव्य र अधिकार प्रत्यायोजन गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes, subject to specified conditions.
Explanation: Article 246(4) allows delegation to specified persons or employees.

English Question: Which levels of government must provide assistance required by the Election Commission?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगलाई आवश्यक सहयोग कुन-कुन तहका सरकारले उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal Government, State Governments, and Local Governments.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ सरकार, प्रदेश सरकार र स्थानीय सरकार।
Explanation: Article 247 requires all three levels to provide assistance.

English Question: Who provides employees and other assistance required for Election Commission functions?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगको कार्यका लागि आवश्यक कर्मचारी र अन्य सहयोग कसले उपलब्ध गराउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Government of Nepal, State Government, and Local Government.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकार, प्रदेश सरकार र स्थानीय सरकार।
Explanation: Article 247 specifies these governments shall provide assistance.

English Question: Is the Election Commission responsible only for Federal elections, or also State Assembly and Local level elections?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोग संघीय निर्वाचन मात्र वा प्रदेश सभा र स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन पनि जिम्मेवार हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It is responsible for Federal, State Assembly, and Local level elections.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय, प्रदेश सभा र स्थानीय तहका निर्वाचनका लागि जिम्मेवार हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 246(1) includes all these election categories.

English Question: Under what two legal sources does the Election Commission conduct elections and referendums?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन आयोगले निर्वाचन र जनमत संग्रह कुन दुई कानुनी आधारमा सञ्चालन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitution and Federal law.
Explanation: Articles 246(1) and 246(2) require compliance with Constitution and Federal law.

English Question: Who decides candidate qualification disputes after nomination but before election results: Election Commission or courts?
Nepali Question: उम्मेदवारीपछि निर्वाचन परिणाम घोषणा हुनुअघि उम्मेदवारको योग्यतासम्बन्धी विवादको निर्णय निर्वाचन आयोगले गर्छ वा अदालतले?
Gold Answer (EN): Election Commission.
Explanation: Article 246(3) specifically assigns this authority to the Election Commission.

English Question: What constitutional body is established under Article 248 of the Constitution of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा २४८ अन्तर्गत कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Human Rights Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 248(1) establishes the National Human Rights Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many members, including the Chairperson, constitute the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: अध्यक्षसहित राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगमा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 248(1) states that the Commission consists of a Chairperson and four other members.

English Question: Who appoints the Chairperson and members of the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 248(2) provides that the President appoints the Chairperson and members.

English Question: On whose recommendation are the Chairperson and members of the National Human Rights Commission appointed?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 248(2) requires the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chairperson and members of the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 248(3) specifies a six-year term from the date of appointment.

English Question: Are the Chairperson and members of the National Human Rights Commission eligible for reappointment after completing their term?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू आफ्नो पदावधि पूरा गरेपछि पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No, they are not eligible for reappointment.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन, पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुँदैनन्।
Explanation: Article 248(4) states that the Chairperson and members appointed under clause (2) shall not be eligible for reappointment.

English Question: Can a member of the National Human Rights Commission be appointed as the Chairperson after serving as a member?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको सदस्य पदमा रहेको व्यक्ति पछि अध्यक्ष नियुक्त हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Article 248(4) provides an exception allowing a member to be appointed as Chairperson, with the term including the member's term.

English Question: To whom must the Chairperson or member submit a written resignation to vacate office?
Nepali Question: पद रिक्त गराउन राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष वा सदस्यले लिखित राजीनामा कसलाई दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 248(5)(a) states that resignation submitted in writing to the President creates vacancy.

English Question: Which constitutional process can cause the office of the Chairperson or member of the National Human Rights Commission to become vacant?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष वा सदस्यको पद कुन संवैधानिक प्रक्रियाबाट रिक्त हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Impeachment under Article 101.
Explanation: Article 248(5)(b) provides vacancy if a motion of impeachment is passed under Article 101.

English Question: Who recommends removal of the Chairperson or member of the National Human Rights Commission due to physical or mental illness preventing performance of duties?
Nepali Question: शारीरिक वा मानसिक रोगका कारण कार्य गर्न असमर्थ भएमा राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगका अध्यक्ष वा सदस्यलाई हटाउन कसले सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 248(5)(c) states that removal is done by the President on recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What qualification is required for a person to be appointed as Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission if the person is a former Chief Justice or Supreme Court Judge?
Nepali Question: सर्वोच्च अदालतको पूर्व प्रधान न्यायाधीश वा न्यायाधीश रहेको व्यक्तिलाई राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष नियुक्त हुन के योग्यता आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Outstanding contribution to the protection and promotion of human rights.
Gold Answer (NE): मानव अधिकारको संरक्षण र प्रवर्द्धनमा उत्कृष्ट योगदान।
Explanation: Article 248(6)(a) requires a retired Chief Justice or Supreme Court Judge to have rendered outstanding contribution to protection and promotion of human rights.

English Question: How many years of active involvement and contribution are required for a renowned person to qualify as Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission through the human rights contribution route?
Nepali Question: मानव अधिकार क्षेत्रमा सक्रिय रहेको प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तिलाई राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष बन्न कति वर्षको सक्रियता र योगदान आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least twenty years.
Explanation: Article 248(6)(a) requires a renowned person to have been active for at least twenty years and rendered outstanding contribution.

English Question: What is the difference between the qualification requirement for the Chairperson and a member of the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष र सदस्यको योग्यता आवश्यकतामा के फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chairperson requires specific senior judicial or outstanding human rights contribution qualifications, while a member requires involvement in human rights, child rights, or significant national contribution.
Gold Answer (NE): अध्यक्षका लागि विशिष्ट न्यायिक वा मानव अधिकार योगदानसम्बन्धी योग्यता चाहिन्छ भने सदस्यका लागि मानव अधिकार, बाल अधिकार वा राष्ट्रिय जीवनका क्षेत्रमा योगदान आवश्यक हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 248(6)(a) and 248(6)(b) provide different qualification criteria for Chairperson and members.

English Question: What area of involvement is specifically mentioned for a person to qualify as a member of the National Human Rights Commission?

Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम शैक्षिक योग्यता के हो?

English Question: What minimum age is required for appointment as Chairperson or member of the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य नियुक्तिका लागि न्यूनतम उमेर कति हो?

English Question: What moral requirement is required for appointment as Chairperson or member of the National Human Rights Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य नियुक्तिका लागि कस्तो नैतिक आवश्यकता छ?

Explanation: Article 248(6)(f) requires the person to be of high moral character.

English Question: What is the primary duty of the National Human Rights Commission?

Gold Answer (EN): A victim or any person on behalf of the victim.

Gold Answer (EN): Departmental action against the official.

Nepali Question: के राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोगसँग व्यक्तिलाई उपस्थित गराउने र बयान लिने विषयमा अदालतसरह अधिकार हुन्छ?

English Question: What is the responsibility of the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission regarding revenue distribution from the Federal Consolidated Fund?
Nepali Question: संघीय सञ्चित कोषबाट हुने राजस्व वितरण सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगको जिम्मेवारी के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To determine detailed basis and modality for distribution of revenues between Federal, State and Local Governments.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारबीच राजस्व वितरणको विस्तृत आधार र ढाँचा निर्धारण गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(a) assigns this function to the Commission.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Functions
English Question: From which fund does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission recommend equalization grants to State and Local Governments?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारलाई समानीकरण अनुदान कुन कोषबाट उपलब्ध गराउन सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal Consolidated Fund.
Explanation: Article 251(1)(b) states that the Commission recommends equalization grants from the Federal Consolidated Fund.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Functions
English Question: What type of grants does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission study and prepare parameters for based on national policies and programs?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय नीति तथा कार्यक्रमका आधारमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले कुन प्रकारका अनुदानका लागि मापदण्ड तयार गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Conditional grants.
Explanation: Article 251(1)(c) provides the Commission's role in studying and preparing parameters for conditional grants.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Revenue Distribution
English Question: What is the difference between revenue distribution from the Federal Consolidated Fund and revenue distribution from the State Consolidated Fund under the functions of the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगको कार्यअन्तर्गत संघीय सञ्चित कोष र प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषबाट हुने राजस्व वितरणमा के फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal Consolidated Fund distribution is between Federal, State and Local Governments, while State Consolidated Fund distribution is between State and Local Governments.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय सञ्चित कोषबाट हुने वितरण संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारबीच हुन्छ भने प्रदेश सञ्चित कोषबाट हुने वितरण प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारबीच हुन्छ।
Explanation: Articles 251(1)(a) and 251(1)(d) specify these separate responsibilities.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Functions
English Question: What does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission recommend regarding government expenditures and revenue collection?
Nepali Question: सरकारी खर्च र राजस्व सङ्कलन सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले के सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Measures to meet expenditures of Federal, State and Local Governments and reforms in revenue collection.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारको खर्च पूरा गर्ने उपाय र राजस्व सङ्कलन सुधारका उपाय।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(e) provides this function.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Fiscal Management
English Question: What does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission recommend after analyzing macro-economic indicators?
Nepali Question: समष्टिगत आर्थिक सूचकहरूको विश्लेषण गरेपछि राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले के सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Ceiling of internal loans that governments can borrow.
Gold Answer (NE): सरकारले लिन सक्ने आन्तरिक ऋणको सीमा।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(f) provides this function regarding internal borrowing limits.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Revenue Review
English Question: What does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission do regarding the basis of revenue distribution between the Federal and State Governments?
Nepali Question: संघ र प्रदेश सरकारबीच राजस्व बाँडफाँडको आधार सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले के गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Reviews the basis and recommends revision.
Gold Answer (NE): आधारको पुनरावलोकन गरी संशोधनको सिफारिस गर्छ।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(g) provides this review and recommendation function.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Natural Resources
English Question: What does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission determine regarding investments and returns from natural resource mobilization?
Nepali Question: प्राकृतिक स्रोतको परिचालनबाट हुने लगानी र प्रतिफलमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले के निर्धारण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Bases for determining shares of Federal, State and Local Governments.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारको हिस्साको निर्धारण गर्ने आधार।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(h) assigns this responsibility to the Commission.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Dispute Resolution
English Question: What type of disputes does the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission study and research to provide suggestions for coordinated prevention?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले समन्वयात्मक रोकथामका लागि कस्ता विवादमा अध्ययन तथा अनुसन्धान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Possible disputes between Federation and States, between States, between State and Local level, and between Local levels.
Gold Answer (NE): संघ र प्रदेशबीच, प्रदेशहरूबीच, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहबीच तथा स्थानीय तहहरूबीच हुन सक्ने विवाद।
Explanation: Article 251(1)(i) lists these categories of possible disputes.

Subdomain: National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission Environmental Assessment
English Question: What study must the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission conduct regarding distribution of natural resources?
Nepali Question: प्राकृतिक स्रोतको वितरण सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगले कस्तो अध्ययन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Study and research on required environmental impact assessment.
Gold Answer (NE): आवश्यक वातावरणीय प्रभाव मूल्याङ्कनसम्बन्धी अध्ययन तथा अनुसन्धान।
Explanation: Article 251(2) requires the Commission to conduct study and research on environmental impact assessment and make recommendations.

English Question: What constitutional body is established under Article 252 of the Constitution of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा २५२ अन्तर्गत कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Women Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 252(1) establishes the National Women Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many members, including the Chairperson, constitute the National Women Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगमा अध्यक्षसहित कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 252(1) states that the Commission consists of a Chairperson and four other members.

English Question: Who appoints the Chairperson and members of the National Women Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 252(2) provides that the President appoints the Chairperson and members.

English Question: On whose recommendation are the Chairperson and members of the National Women Commission appointed?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 252(2) requires appointment on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chairperson and members of the National Women Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 252(3) specifies a six-year term from the date of appointment.

English Question: Are the Chairperson and members of the National Women Commission eligible for reappointment after completing their term?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू पदावधि पूरा भएपछि पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No, they are not eligible for reappointment.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन, पुनः नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुँदैनन्।
Explanation: Article 252(5) states that the Chairperson and members appointed under clause (2) shall not be eligible for reappointment.

English Question: How many years of contribution in the relevant fields are required for a person to qualify for appointment as Chairperson or member of the National Women Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य बन्न सम्बन्धित क्षेत्रमा कति वर्षको योगदान आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least ten years.
Explanation: Article 252(6)(a) requires at least ten years of contribution in women’s rights, gender justice, women development, human rights, or law.

English Question: In which fields must a woman have made outstanding contributions to qualify for appointment to the National Women Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगमा नियुक्तिका लागि महिलाले कुन-कुन क्षेत्रमा उत्कृष्ट योगदान गरेको हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Rights and interests of women, gender justice, women development, human rights, or law.
Gold Answer (NE): महिलाको अधिकार तथा हित, लैङ्गिक न्याय, महिला विकास, मानव अधिकार वा कानून।
Explanation: Article 252(6)(a) specifies these fields of contribution.

English Question: What additional qualification is specifically required for the Chairperson of the National Women Commission compared to other members?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगका अन्य सदस्यको तुलनामा अध्यक्षका लागि थप कुन योग्यता आवश्यक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Holding a bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
Explanation: Article 252(6)(b) specifically mentions bachelor's degree requirement in the case of the Chairperson.

English Question: What is the responsibility of the National Women Commission regarding policies and programs related to women's rights and interests?
Nepali Question: महिलाको अधिकार र हितसम्बन्धी नीति तथा कार्यक्रमका सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगको जिम्मेवारी के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To formulate policies and programs and submit them to the Government of Nepal for implementation.
Gold Answer (NE): नीति तथा कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा गरी कार्यान्वयनका लागि नेपाल सरकारसमक्ष पेश गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 253(1)(a) provides this function.

English Question: How does the National Women Commission monitor Nepal's obligations under international treaties related to women's rights?
Nepali Question: महिलाको अधिकारसम्बन्धी अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सन्धिअन्तर्गत नेपालको दायित्वलाई राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगले कसरी अनुगमन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): By monitoring implementation and suggesting measures for effective compliance to the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): कार्यान्वयनको अनुगमन गरी प्रभावकारी पालना र कार्यान्वयनका उपायसहित नेपाल सरकारलाई सुझाव दिने।
Explanation: Article 253(1)(b) assigns this monitoring and recommendation role.

English Question: What recommendation can the National Women Commission make when cases need to be filed regarding violence against women or deprivation of women's rights?
Nepali Question: महिला हिंसा वा महिलाको अधिकारबाट वञ्चित गरिएका विषयमा मुद्दा दायर गर्न आवश्यक भए राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोगले के सिफारिस गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Recommendation to concerned bodies to file cases in courts according to law.
Gold Answer (NE): कानून बमोजिम सम्बन्धित निकायलाई अदालतमा मुद्दा दायर गर्न सिफारिस।
Explanation: Article 253(1)(f) provides the Commission's power to recommend filing cases regarding violations of women's rights.

English Question: What constitutional body is established under Article 255 of the Constitution of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा २५५ अन्तर्गत कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Dalit Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 255(1) establishes the National Dalit Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many members, including the Chairperson, constitute the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगमा अध्यक्षसहित कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 255(1) states that the Commission consists of a Chairperson and four other members.

English Question: Who appoints the Chairperson and members of the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 255(2) provides that the President appoints the Chairperson and members.

English Question: On whose recommendation are the Chairperson and members of the National Dalit Commission appointed?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरू कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 255(2) requires appointment on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: What is the term of office of the Chairperson and members of the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Six years from the date of appointment.
Explanation: Article 255(3) specifies the six-year term of office.

English Question: How many years of outstanding contribution in the field of Dalit rights, human rights, or law are required for appointment to the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगमा नियुक्तिका लागि दलित अधिकार, मानव अधिकार वा कानूनको क्षेत्रमा कति वर्षको उत्कृष्ट योगदान आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least ten years.
Explanation: Article 255(6)(a) requires at least ten years of outstanding contribution in relevant fields.

English Question: In which fields must a person have rendered outstanding contribution to qualify as Chairperson or member of the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगको अध्यक्ष वा सदस्य बन्न व्यक्तिले कुन क्षेत्रमा उत्कृष्ट योगदान गरेको हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Rights and interests of the Dalit community, or human rights and law.
Gold Answer (NE): दलित समुदायको अधिकार तथा हित वा मानव अधिकार र कानून।
Explanation: Article 255(6)(a) specifies the required areas of contribution.

English Question: What educational qualification is specifically required for the Chairperson of the National Dalit Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगका अध्यक्षका लागि विशेष रूपमा कुन शैक्षिक योग्यता आवश्यक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least a bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
Gold Answer (NE): मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालयबाट कम्तीमा स्नातक उपाधि।
Explanation: Article 255(6)(b) requires the Chairperson to hold at least a bachelor's degree.

English Question: What is the responsibility of the National Dalit Commission regarding the overall situation of the Dalit community?
Nepali Question: दलित समुदायको समग्र अवस्थासम्बन्धी राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगको जिम्मेवारी के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To conduct study and exploration, identify areas for reform, and make recommendations to the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): अध्ययन तथा खोज गरी सुधारका क्षेत्र पहिचान गर्ने र नेपाल सरकारलाई सिफारिस गर्ने।
Explanation: Article 256(1)(a) provides this function.

English Question: What type of policies and programs does the National Dalit Commission formulate and submit to the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगले कस्ता नीति तथा कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा गरी नेपाल सरकारलाई पेश गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National policies and programs for the upliftment and development of Dalit communities and ending caste-based discrimination.
Gold Answer (NE): दलित समुदायको उत्थान तथा विकास र जातीय भेदभाव अन्त्य गर्न राष्ट्रिय नीति तथा कार्यक्रम।
Explanation: Article 256(1)(b) assigns this responsibility to the Commission.

English Question: What does the National Dalit Commission monitor regarding laws and special provisions for the Dalit community?
Nepali Question: दलित समुदायसम्बन्धी कानून र विशेष व्यवस्थाका सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोगले के अनुगमन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Whether they have been effectively implemented.
Gold Answer (NE): ती प्रभावकारी रूपमा कार्यान्वयन भएका छन् वा छैनन्।
Explanation: Article 256(1)(c) provides monitoring of implementation and suggestions when not observed.

English Question: What constitutional body is established under Article 258 of the Constitution of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा २५८ अन्तर्गत कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Inclusion Commission of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 258(1) establishes the National Inclusion Commission of Nepal.

English Question: How many members, including the Chairperson, constitute the National Inclusion Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगमा अध्यक्षसहित कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 258(1) states that the Commission consists of a Chairperson and four other members.

English Question: Which groups and communities are included within the scope of study and research of the National Inclusion Commission?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगको अध्ययन तथा अनुसन्धानको दायरामा कुन-कुन समुदाय र वर्ग पर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Khas Arya, Pichhada class, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, labourers, peasants, minorities, marginalized communities, backward classes, people of Karnali and indigent classes.
Gold Answer (NE): खस आर्य, पिछडा वर्ग, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति, ज्येष्ठ नागरिक, श्रमिक, किसान, अल्पसंख्यक, सीमान्तकृत समुदाय, पिछडा वर्ग, कर्णालीका जनता र विपन्न वर्ग।
Explanation: Article 259(1)(a) lists the communities and groups covered by the Commission's study and research.

English Question: What does the National Inclusion Commission study regarding government policies and laws for inclusion?
Nepali Question: समावेशीकरणका लागि नेपाल सरकारले अपनाएका नीति तथा कानून सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगले के अध्ययन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The status of implementation and makes suggestions for reforms.
Gold Answer (NE): कार्यान्वयनको अवस्था अध्ययन गरी सुधारका लागि सुझाव दिन्छ।
Explanation: Article 259(1)(b) provides this function.

English Question: What does the National Inclusion Commission study regarding representation of specified communities, classes, and regions in State organs?
Nepali Question: तोकिएका समुदाय, वर्ग र क्षेत्रको राज्यका अंगहरूमा प्रतिनिधित्व सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगले के अध्ययन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Whether there has been appropriate representation and recommends review of special provisions.
Gold Answer (NE): उचित प्रतिनिधित्व भएको छ वा छैन अध्ययन गरी विशेष व्यवस्थाको पुनरावलोकन गर्न सिफारिस गर्छ।
Explanation: Article 259(1)(c) provides this responsibility.

English Question: What does the National Inclusion Commission recommend regarding the development and prosperity of Karnali and backward regions?
Nepali Question: कर्णाली र पिछडिएका क्षेत्रको विकास र समृद्धिका सम्बन्धमा राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगले के सिफारिस गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Policies and programs to be pursued for their development and prosperity.
Gold Answer (NE): तिनको विकास र समृद्धिका लागि अवलम्बन गरिने नीति तथा कार्यक्रम।
Explanation: Article 259(1)(e) assigns this function to the Commission.

English Question: On what basis does the National Inclusion Commission monitor the implementation of rights and interests of minority and marginalized communities and recommend revisions?
Nepali Question: अल्पसंख्यक तथा सीमान्तकृत समुदायको अधिकार र हितको कार्यान्वयन अनुगमन गर्दा राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोगले कुन आधार प्रयोग गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Periodic national census and human development index.
Gold Answer (NE): आवधिक राष्ट्रिय जनगणना र मानव विकास सूचकांक।
Explanation: Article 259(1)(g) specifies these bases for review and recommendations.

English Question: What is the maximum number of members in the Indigenous Nationalities Commission, including the Chairperson?
Nepali Question: आदिवासी जनजाति आयोगमा अध्यक्षसहित अधिकतम कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Five members.
Explanation: Article 261(1) provides that the Commission consists of a Chairperson and a maximum of four other members.

English Question: Who appoints the Chairperson and members of the Madhesi Commission?
Nepali Question: मधेसी आयोगका अध्यक्ष र सदस्यहरूलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council.
Explanation: Article 262(2) provides the appointment mechanism.

English Question: What common constitutional feature is shared by the Tharu Commission and Muslim Commission regarding their composition?
Nepali Question: थारू आयोग र मुस्लिम आयोगको संरचनासम्बन्धी साझा संवैधानिक व्यवस्था के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Each consists of a Chairperson and a maximum of four other members.
Gold Answer (NE): दुवैमा अध्यक्ष र अधिकतम चार अन्य सदस्य हुन्छन्।
Explanation: Articles 263(1) and 264(1) provide the same composition structure.

English Question: After how many years from the commencement of the Constitution must the Federal Parliament review the commissions formed under Part 27?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको कति वर्षपछि संघीय संसदले भाग २७ अन्तर्गत गठन भएका आयोगहरूको पुनरावलोकन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Ten years.
Explanation: Article 265 requires the Federal Parliament to review the commissions after ten years from the commencement of the Constitution.

English Question: What constitutional body is established for making recommendations on Nepal's overall national interest, security, and defence policy?
Nepali Question: नेपालको समग्र राष्ट्रिय हित, सुरक्षा र रक्षा नीतिसम्बन्धी सिफारिस गर्न कुन संवैधानिक निकायको स्थापना गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): National Security Council.
Explanation: Article 266(1) establishes the National Security Council for making recommendations on overall national interest, security, and defence policy.

English Question: What are the two major purposes of the National Security Council mentioned in the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानमा उल्लेख भएअनुसार राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्का दुई प्रमुख उद्देश्य के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): To recommend policies on overall national interest, security and defence, and to mobilize and control the Nepal Army.
Gold Answer (NE): समग्र राष्ट्रिय हित, सुरक्षा र रक्षा नीतिका लागि सिफारिस गर्नु तथा नेपाली सेनाको परिचालन र नियन्त्रण गर्नु।
Explanation: Article 266(1) specifies both purposes of the Council.

English Question: Who is the Chairperson of the National Security Council?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 266(1)(a) identifies the Prime Minister as the Chairperson.

English Question: Which government minister is included as a member of the National Security Council responsible for defence matters?
Nepali Question: रक्षा सम्बन्धी जिम्मेवारी भएको कुन सरकारी मन्त्री राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को सदस्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Minister for Defence.
Explanation: Article 266(1)(b) lists the Minister for Defence as a member of the Council.

English Question: Which positions from the Government of Nepal and Nepal Army are included as members of the National Security Council besides ministers?
Nepali Question: मन्त्रीहरू बाहेक नेपाल सरकार र नेपाली सेनाका कुन पदहरू राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्का सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Chief Secretary of Government of Nepal and Commander-in-Chief of Nepal Army.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारका मुख्य सचिव र नेपाली सेनाका प्रधान सेनापति।
Explanation: Article 266(1)(f) and 266(1)(g) include these two positions as members.

English Question: Who acts as the member secretary of the National Security Council?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को सदस्य सचिवको रूपमा कसले काम गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Secretary at the Ministry of Defence.
Explanation: Article 266(2) provides that the Secretary at the Ministry of Defence acts as the member secretary.

English Question: To whom does the National Security Council submit its annual report?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्ले आफ्नो वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन कसलाई बुझाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 266(3) states that the Council submits its annual report to the President.

English Question: How is the annual report of the National Security Council presented before the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन संघीय संसदसमक्ष कसरी पेश गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President causes it to be laid before the Federal Parliament through the Prime Minister.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीमार्फत संघीय संसदमा पेश गराउँछन्।
Explanation: Article 266(3) specifies the reporting process involving the President and Prime Minister.

English Question: Which member of the National Security Council represents Nepal's foreign affairs sector?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्मा नेपालको परराष्ट्र मामिला क्षेत्रको प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने सदस्य को हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Minister for Foreign Affairs.
Explanation: Article 266(1)(d) includes the Minister for Foreign Affairs as a member.

English Question: Which finance-related government position is included as a member of the National Security Council?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्मा वित्तसम्बन्धी कुन सरकारी पद सदस्यको रूपमा समावेश गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Minister for Finance.
Explanation: Article 266(1)(e) lists the Minister for Finance as a member of the Council.

English Question: What organization shall exist in Nepal for safeguarding independence, sovereignty, territorial integrity, and national unity?
Nepali Question: नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता र राष्ट्रिय एकताको रक्षा गर्न नेपालमा कुन संगठन रहनेछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Nepal Army.
Explanation: Article 267(1) provides for the Nepal Army as an organization committed to safeguarding these national interests.

English Question: Who is the Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the Nepal Army?
Nepali Question: नेपाली सेनाको परमाधिपति को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 267(2) states that the President shall be the supreme commander-in-chief of the Nepal Army.

English Question: Which groups are specifically mentioned for ensuring inclusive entry into the Nepal Army under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार नेपाली सेनामा समावेशी प्रवेश सुनिश्चित गरिने कुन-कुन समूहहरू उल्लेख गरिएका छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Women, Dalit, indigenous people, indigenous nationalities, Khas Arya, Madhesi, Tharu, Pichhada class, and backward region citizens.
Gold Answer (NE): महिला, दलित, आदिवासी, आदिवासी जनजाति, खस आर्य, मधेसी, थारू, पिछडा वर्ग र पिछडिएको क्षेत्रका नागरिक।
Explanation: Article 267(3) lists these groups for ensuring inclusive entry into the Nepal Army.

English Question: For what additional works may the Government of Nepal mobilize the Nepal Army according to federal law?
Nepali Question: संघीय कानूनबमोजिम नेपाल सरकारले नेपाली सेनालाई थप कुन-कुन कार्यमा परिचालन गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Development, construction, and disaster management works.
Gold Answer (NE): विकास, निर्माण र विपद् व्यवस्थापन कार्य।
Explanation: Article 267(4) permits mobilization of the Nepal Army for these additional works.

English Question: Who appoints and removes the Commander-in-Chief of the Nepal Army?
Nepali Question: नेपाली सेनाका प्रधान सेनापतिको नियुक्ति र पदमुक्ति कसले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President on the recommendation of the Council of Ministers.
Explanation: Article 267(5) provides this appointment and removal procedure.

English Question: What conditions must exist for the mobilization of the Nepal Army in cases of grave emergency?
Nepali Question: गम्भीर आपतकालीन अवस्थामा नेपाली सेनाको परिचालन गर्न कुन अवस्थाहरू हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): War, external aggression, armed rebellion, or extreme economic disarray affecting sovereignty, territorial integrity, or security.
Gold Answer (NE): युद्ध, बाह्य आक्रमण, सशस्त्र विद्रोह वा चरम आर्थिक विशृंखलताका कारण सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता वा सुरक्षामा गम्भीर संकट।
Explanation: Article 267(6) specifies the circumstances requiring Army mobilization.

English Question: Within what period must the declaration of Nepal Army mobilization be ratified by the House of Representatives?
Nepali Question: नेपाली सेनाको परिचालन घोषणालाई प्रतिनिधि सभाले कति अवधिभित्र अनुमोदन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within one month after the declaration.
Explanation: Article 267(6) requires ratification by the House of Representatives within one month after declaration.

English Question: Which police organizations and investigation body shall exist under the Federation, and what police organization shall each State have?
Nepali Question: संघअन्तर्गत कुन-कुन प्रहरी संगठन र अनुसन्धान निकाय रहनेछन्, र प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा कुन प्रहरी संगठन रहनेछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federation shall have Nepal Police, Armed Police Force, Nepal and National Investigation Department; each State shall have a State police organization.
Gold Answer (NE): संघमा नेपाल प्रहरी, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल र राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभाग रहनेछन्; प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा प्रदेश प्रहरी संगठन रहनेछ।
Explanation: Article 268(1) and 268(2) establish federal security organizations and State police organizations.

English Question: Who may form and operate political parties according to the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कसले राजनीतिक दल गठन र सञ्चालन गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Persons committed to common political ideology, philosophy and program.
Gold Answer (NE): साझा राजनीतिक विचारधारा, दर्शन र कार्यक्रमप्रति प्रतिबद्ध व्यक्तिहरू।
Explanation: Article 269(1) allows persons committed to common political ideology, philosophy and program to form and operate political parties.

English Question: What must persons share in order to form and operate a political party under Article 269?
Nepali Question: धारा २६९ अनुसार राजनीतिक दल गठन र सञ्चालन गर्न व्यक्तिहरूबीच के समान हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Common political ideology, philosophy and program.
Gold Answer (NE): साझा राजनीतिक विचारधारा, दर्शन र कार्यक्रम।
Explanation: Article 269(1) specifies these as the basis for forming political parties.

English Question: Which constitutional body must a political party register with after being formed?
Nepali Question: गठन भएपछि राजनीतिक दलले कुन संवैधानिक निकायमा दर्ता हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Election Commission.
Explanation: Article 269(2) requires a political party formed under clause (1) to register with the Election Commission.

English Question: Which documents must accompany an application for registration of a political party?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक दल दर्ताको निवेदनसँग कुन-कुन कागजात संलग्न गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The party constitution, manifesto, and other documents required by Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): दलको विधान, घोषणापत्र र संघीय कानूनले माग गरेका अन्य कागजातहरू।
Explanation: Article 269(3) specifies the required documents for registration.

English Question: What type of constitution and rules must a political party have to qualify for registration?
Nepali Question: दर्ताका लागि राजनीतिक दलको विधान र नियम कस्तो हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Democratic.
Explanation: Article 269(4)(a) requires the party constitution and rules to be democratic.

English Question: How often must a political party's office-bearers at Federal and State levels be elected according to its constitution?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक दलको संघीय र प्रदेश तहका पदाधिकारीहरू कति अवधिमा एक पटक निर्वाचित हुनुपर्ने व्यवस्था हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least once every five years.
Gold Answer (NE): कम्तीमा प्रत्येक पाँच वर्षमा एक पटक।
Explanation: Article 269(4)(b) requires election of office-bearers at least once every five years.

English Question: What is the maximum additional period allowed for holding office-bearer elections if a political party fails to do so within five years due to a special circumstance?
Nepali Question: विशेष परिस्थितिका कारण पाँच वर्षभित्र पदाधिकारी निर्वाचन हुन नसकेमा थप कति अवधिभित्र निर्वाचन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within six months.
Explanation: Article 269(4)(b) provides an exception allowing elections within six months in special circumstances.

English Question: What type of representation must a political party provide in its executive committees at various levels?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक दलका विभिन्न तहका कार्यकारी समितिमा कस्तो प्रतिनिधित्वको व्यवस्था हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Inclusive representation reflecting Nepal's diversity.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको विविधता प्रतिबिम्बित गर्ने समावेशी प्रतिनिधित्व।
Explanation: Article 269(4)(c) requires inclusive representation in executive committees.

English Question: Under what circumstances shall a political party not be registered?
Nepali Question: कुन अवस्थामा राजनीतिक दल दर्ता गरिने छैन?
Gold Answer (EN): If its name, objective, insignia or flag jeopardizes religious and communal unity or fragments the country.
Gold Answer (NE): यदि यसको नाम, उद्देश्य, चिन्ह वा झण्डाले धार्मिक तथा साम्प्रदायिक एकता खल्बल्याउँछ वा देश विखण्डन गर्छ भने।
Explanation: Article 269(5) prohibits registration of parties with such characteristics.

English Question: A political party has a democratic constitution, holds elections every five years, and has inclusive representation. Which constitutional requirement does this satisfy?
Nepali Question: लोकतान्त्रिक विधान भएको, प्रत्येक पाँच वर्षमा निर्वाचन गर्ने र समावेशी प्रतिनिधित्व भएको राजनीतिक दलले कुन संवैधानिक आवश्यकता पूरा गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Conditions required for political party registration under Article 269(4).
Gold Answer (NE): धारा २६९(४) अन्तर्गत राजनीतिक दल दर्ताका लागि आवश्यक शर्तहरू।
Explanation: Article 269(4) lists these conditions that must be fulfilled for party registration.

English Question: What happens to any law, arrangement, or decision that restricts the formation and operation of political parties contrary to Article 269?
Nepali Question: धारा २६९ विपरीत राजनीतिक दलको गठन र सञ्चालनमा प्रतिबन्ध लगाउने कानून, व्यवस्था वा निर्णयको अवस्था के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It is inconsistent with the Constitution and void.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यो संविधानसँग बाझिने र स्वतः अमान्य हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 270(1) states that such restrictions are inconsistent with the Constitution and shall be void.

English Question: What type of political system participation restriction is prohibited by Article 270?
Nepali Question: धारा २७० अनुसार कस्तो राजनीतिक प्रणाली सहभाग

English Question: What type of political party participation or involvement arrangement is declared void by Article 270?
Nepali Question: धारा २७० अनुसार कस्तो राजनीतिक दलको सहभागिता वा संलग्नताको व्यवस्था अमान्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): An arrangement allowing only a single political party or persons with similar ideology, philosophy, or program to participate in elections or governance.
Gold Answer (NE): केवल एक राजनीतिक दल वा समान विचारधारा, दर्शन वा कार्यक्रम भएका व्यक्तिलाई मात्र निर्वाचन वा शासन प्रणालीमा सहभागी हुन दिने व्यवस्था।
Explanation: Article 270(2) prohibits arrangements that allow only a single political party or similar ideology group to participate in the political system.

English Question: Why is a law allowing only one political party to participate in elections considered invalid under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचनमा केवल एउटा राजनीतिक दललाई मात्र सहभागी हुन दिने कानून किन संविधानविपरीत मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Because it restricts participation to only a single political party or similar ideology, philosophy, or program.
Gold Answer (NE): किनकि यसले केवल एउटा राजनीतिक दल वा समान विचारधारा, दर्शन वा कार्यक्रम भएका व्यक्तिको मात्र सहभागिता सुनिश्चित गर्छ।
Explanation: Article 270(2) declares such arrangements inconsistent with the Constitution and void.

English Question: What must a registered political party do to obtain recognition from the Election Commission for contesting elections?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचनमा प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्न निर्वाचन आयोगबाट मान्यता प्राप्त गर्न दर्ता भएको राजनीतिक दलले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Register with the Election Commission according to procedures set by Federal law.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय कानूनले तोकेको प्रक्रिया पूरा गरी निर्वाचन आयोगमा दर्ता हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 271(1) requires registered political parties seeking election recognition to register with the Election Commission.

English Question: What is the difference between registration under Article 269 and recognition for election purposes under Article 271?
Nepali Question: धारा २६९ अन्तर्गतको दर्ता र धारा २७१ अन्तर्गत निर्वाचन प्रयोजनको मान्यताबीच के फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Article 269 concerns party registration after formation, while Article 271 concerns recognition for contesting elections.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा २६९ गठनपछि दल दर्तासँग सम्बन्धित छ भने धारा २७१ निर्वाचनमा भाग लिन मान्यतासँग सम्बन्धित छ।
Explanation: Articles 269 and 271 establish separate registration-related requirements for parties.

English Question: What additional report must a political party submit along with an application for election recognition?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन प्रयोजनको मान्यताका लागि आवेदन दिँदा राजनीतिक दलले थप कुन प्रतिवेदन बुझाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yearly audit report.
Explanation: Article 271(2) requires submission of a yearly audit report along with the application.

English Question: Besides submitting a yearly audit report, which other constitutional requirements must a political party fulfill to obtain election recognition?
Nepali Question: वार्षिक लेखापरीक्षण प्रतिवेदन बाहेक निर्वाचन मान्यता प्राप्त गर्न राजनीतिक दलले अन्य कुन संवैधानिक शर्त पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The requirements under Article 269(3) and Article 269(4).
Explanation: Article 271(2) refers to the matters in Article 269(3) and conditions in Article 269(4).

English Question: A political party submits its constitution, manifesto, yearly audit report, and proves democratic internal rules. Which constitutional processes is it satisfying?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक दलले आफ्नो विधान, घोषणापत्र, वार्षिक लेखापरीक्षण प्रतिवेदन बुझाई लोकतान्त्रिक आन्तरिक नियम प्रमाणित गरेमा कुन संवैधानिक प्रक्रियाहरू पूरा गरिरहेको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Party registration and election recognition requirements.
Gold Answer (NE): दल दर्ता र निर्वाचन मान्यता सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू।
Explanation: Articles 269 and 271 together establish these requirements.

English Question: Which law provides detailed provisions regarding formation, registration, operation, facilities, and other matters of political parties?
Nepali Question: राजनीतिक दलको गठन, दर्ता, सञ्चालन, सुविधा तथा अन्य विषयसम्बन्धी विस्तृत व्यवस्था कुन कानूनले गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Federal law.
Explanation: Article 272 states that such provisions shall be as provided for in Federal law.

English Question: Who has the authority to declare or order a state of emergency under Article 273?
Nepali Question: धारा २७३ अनुसार संकटकाल घोषणा वा आदेश गर्ने अधिकार कसलाई हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 273(1) provides that the President may declare or order a state of emergency.

English Question: What situations may lead to the declaration of a state of emergency under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअनुसार कुन-कुन अवस्थामा संकटकाल घोषणा गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): War, external aggression, armed rebellion, extreme economic disarray, natural calamity, or epidemic.
Gold Answer (NE): युद्ध, बाह्य आक्रमण, सशस्त्र विद्रोह, चरम आर्थिक विशृंखलता, प्राकृतिक विपद् वा महामारी।
Explanation: Article 273(1) lists the circumstances that may create a grave emergency.

English Question: Can a state of emergency be declared only for the whole country, or can it apply to a specific part of Nepal?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल केवल सम्पूर्ण नेपालमा मात्र लागू हुन्छ वा नेपालको कुनै निश्चित भागमा पनि लागू हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may apply to the whole of Nepal or any specified part thereof.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्पूर्ण नेपाल वा नेपालको कुनै निश्चित भागमा लागू हुन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 273(1) allows emergency declaration for the whole country or a specified part.

English Question: In what situation may a State Government request the Government of Nepal to declare a state of emergency?
Nepali Question: कुन अवस्थामा प्रदेश सरकारले नेपाल सरकारलाई संकटकाल घोषणा गर्न अनुरोध गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): When a grave emergency arises in a State due to natural calamity or epidemic.
Gold Answer (NE): प्राकृतिक विपद् वा महामारीका कारण प्रदेशमा गम्भीर आपतकालीन अवस्था उत्पन्न हुँदा।
Explanation: Article 273(2) provides this special provision for States.

English Question: Within what period must an emergency declaration be presented before both Houses of the Federal Parliament for approval?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणालाई संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनमा अनुमोदनका लागि कति अवधिभित्र पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within one month after the date of issuance.
Explanation: Article 273(3) requires presentation before both Houses within one month.

English Question: Which legislative bodies must approve a declaration or order of emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा वा आदेशलाई कुन-कुन व्यवस्थापिकाले अनुमोदन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Explanation: Article 273(3) requires approval by both Houses of the Federal Parliament.

English Question: What majority is required in both Houses of the Federal Parliament to approve a state of emergency declaration?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा अनुमोदन गर्न संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses.
Gold Answer (NE): तत्काल कायम रहेका दुवै सदनका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 273(4) specifies the required approval threshold.

English Question: For how long does an approved state of emergency declaration remain in force from the date of issuance?
Nepali Question: अनुमोदन भएको संकटकाल घोषणा जारी भएको मितिबाट कति समयसम्म कायम रहन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Three months.
Explanation: Article 273(4) states that an approved declaration continues for three months from issuance.

English Question: What happens if a state of emergency declaration is not approved according to the constitutional requirement?
Nepali Question: संवैधानिक आवश्यकता अनुसार संकटकाल घोषणा अनुमोदन नभएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It becomes inoperative automatically.
Explanation: Article 273(5) states that a declaration not approved becomes ipso facto inoperative.

English Question: A state of emergency is declared and presented to both Houses within one month. What additional condition is required for it to continue in force?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा गरी एक महिनाभित्र दुवै सदनमा पेश गरिएपछि कायम रहन थप कुन शर्त आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Approval by at least a two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses.
Gold Answer (NE): तत्काल कायम रहेका दुवै सदनका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन।
Explanation: Article 273(3) and 273(4) together establish the approval process.

English Question: What is the difference between the approval deadline and the validity period of an approved emergency declaration?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल अनुमोदनको समयसीमा र अनुमोदनपछि कायम रहने अवधिबीच के फरक छ?
