Gold Answer (EN): Approval must occur within one month, while an approved declaration remains for three months from issuance.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुमोदन एक महिनाभित्र हुनुपर्छ भने अनुमोदन भएको घोषणा जारी भएको मितिबाट तीन महिनासम्म कायम रहन्छ।
Explanation: Article 273(3) and 273(4) establish different time periods for approval and operation.

English Question: Before the expiry of an emergency declaration, for how long can a motion be submitted to extend the emergency period?
Nepali Question: संकटकालको अवधि समाप्त हुनुअघि कति अवधिसम्म थप गर्न प्रस्ताव पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Another period not exceeding three months.
Gold Answer (NE): थप तीन महिनाभन्दा बढी नहुने अवधि।
Explanation: Article 273(6) allows submission of a motion to extend the emergency period for another period not exceeding three months.

English Question: What majority is required for the Federal Parliament to extend the period of a state of emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालको अवधि थप गर्न संघीय संसदमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses.
Gold Answer (NE): तत्काल कायम रहेका दुवै सदनका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 273(7) requires a two-thirds majority for extension.

English Question: If the House of Representatives has been dissolved during an emergency, which body exercises the Federal Parliament’s emergency-related powers?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल कायम रहेको अवस्थामा प्रतिनिधि सभा विघटन भए संघीय संसदको संकटकालसम्बन्धी अधिकार कसले प्रयोग गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The National Assembly.
Explanation: Article 273(8) provides that the National Assembly exercises these powers during dissolution of the House of Representatives.

English Question: What authority does the President have after declaring a state of emergency to address emergency situations?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा भएपछि आपतकालीन अवस्था समाधान गर्न राष्ट्रपतिसँग कस्तो अधिकार हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President may issue necessary orders to meet the exigencies.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले आवश्यक आदेश जारी गर्न सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 273(9) grants the President authority to issue necessary orders during emergency.

English Question: During a state of emergency, what is the legal status of orders issued by the President under Article 273(9)?
Nepali Question: धारा २७३(९) अनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले जारी गरेका आदेशहरूको कानुनी स्थिति के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They apply as law while the state of emergency is in operation.
Gold Answer (NE): संकटकाल कायम रहँदासम्म ती आदेश कानुनसरह लागू हुन्छन्।
Explanation: Article 273(9) states that such orders apply as law during the emergency period.

English Question: Which category of rights may be suspended during a state of emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालको समयमा कुन प्रकारका अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Fundamental rights provided in Part-3, subject to constitutional exceptions.
Gold Answer (NE): भाग–३ मा प्रदान गरिएका मौलिक हकहरू, संविधानमा तोकिएका अपवाद बाहेक।
Explanation: Article 273(10) permits suspension of fundamental rights with listed exceptions.

English Question: Are all fundamental rights suspended during a state of emergency?
Nepali Question: के संकटकालमा सबै मौलिक हकहरू निलम्बन हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No, specified rights and remedies cannot be suspended.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन, तोकिएका मौलिक हक र उपचारका अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिँदैन।
Explanation: Article 273(10) lists rights that remain protected during emergency.

English Question: Which constitutional remedy specifically remains protected and cannot be suspended during an emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालमा कुन संवैधानिक उपचारको अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): The remedy of habeas corpus.
Explanation: Article 273(10) explicitly protects the remedy of habeas corpus.

English Question: Can a petition be filed in court to enforce a suspended fundamental right during an emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालमा निलम्बित मौलिक हक कार्यान्वयनका लागि अदालतमा निवेदन दिन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No, no petition may lie for enforcement of that suspended right.
Gold Answer (NE): सकिँदैन, त्यस्तो निलम्बित हक कार्यान्वयनका लागि निवेदन लाग्दैन।
Explanation: Article 273(11) restricts petitions relating to suspended rights.

English Question: If a person suffers injury due to an official’s bad faith action during emergency, within what period may compensation be claimed after termination of the emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालमा अधिकारीको बदनियतपूर्ण कार्यबाट क्षति भएमा संकटकाल समाप्त भएपछि कति अवधिभित्र क्षतिपूर्तिको माग गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within three months from the date of termination.
Explanation: Article 273(12) provides a three-month period for filing a compensation petition.

English Question: Who may order compensation or punishment when a valid petition is filed for injury caused during an emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकालको समयमा भएको क्षतिका लागि निवेदन परेमा क्षतिपूर्ति वा सजायको आदेश कसले दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The court.
Explanation: Article 273(12) provides that the court may order compensation and punishment.

English Question: Who may withdraw a declaration or order of a state of emergency?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा वा आदेश फिर्ता गर्ने अधिकार कसलाई हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 273(13) grants the President power to withdraw the emergency declaration or order at any time.

English Question: What is the difference between approval of an emergency declaration and extension of an emergency period?
Nepali Question: संकटकाल घोषणा अनुमोदन र संकटकाल अवधि थप गर्ने प्रक्रियाबीच के फरक छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Approval requires two-thirds majority after issuance, while extension requires a separate two-thirds majority motion before expiry.
Gold Answer (NE): घोषणा अनुमोदनका लागि जारी भएपछि दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ भने अवधि थपका लागि समाप्त हुनुअघि छुट्टै दुई तिहाइ बहुमतको प्रस्ताव आवश्यक हुन्छ।
Explanation: Articles 273(4), 273(6), and 273(7) establish separate procedures.

English Question: Arrange the correct constitutional sequence after a state of emergency is declared by the President.
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिले संकटकाल घोषणा गरेपछि संविधानअनुसार सही प्रक्रिया क्रम मिलाउनुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): Declaration → submission to both Houses within one month → approval by two-thirds majority → continuation for specified period.
Gold Answer (NE): घोषणा → एक महिनाभित्र दुवै सदनमा पेश → दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन → तोकिएको अवधिसम्म कायम।
Explanation: Articles 273(1), 273(3), and 273(4) together establish the emergency procedure sequence.

English Question: What limitation does the Constitution impose on the amendment of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधान संशोधन गर्दा संविधानले कुन सीमाना तोकेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): An amendment must not prejudice sovereignty, territorial integrity, independence of Nepal, or sovereignty vested in the people.
Gold Answer (NE): संशोधनले नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, स्वतन्त्रता वा जनतामा निहित सार्वभौमसत्तामा प्रतिकूल असर पार्नु हुँदैन।
Explanation: Article 274(1) prohibits amendments that harm these fundamental principles.

English Question: Can the Constitution be amended in a manner that affects the sovereignty vested in the people?
Nepali Question: के जनतामा निहित सार्वभौमसत्तामा असर पर्ने गरी संविधान संशोधन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: Article 274(1) prohibits amendments prejudicial to sovereignty vested in the people.

English Question: Which body may introduce a bill to amend or repeal any Article of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानको कुनै धारा संशोधन वा खारेज गर्ने विधेयक कुन निकायमा पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Either House of the Federal Parliament.
Explanation: Article 274(2) allows an amendment bill to be introduced in either House of the Federal Parliament.

English Question: Which clause of Article 274 itself cannot be amended?
Nepali Question: धारा २७४ को कुन उपधारा आफैं संशोधन गर्न सकिँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Clause (1).
Explanation: Article 274(2) provides that clause (1) shall not be amended.

English Question: What type of legislative proposal may be introduced under Article 274(2)?
Nepali Question: धारा २७४(२) अनुसार कस्तो विधेयक पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A bill to amend or repeal any Article of the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानको कुनै पनि धारा संशोधन वा खारेज गर्ने विधेयक।
Explanation: Article 274(2) specifies the scope of amendment bills.

English Question: Within how many days must an introduced constitutional amendment bill be publicly published for information?
Nepali Question: पेश गरिएको संविधान संशोधन विधेयक सार्वजनिक जानकारीका लागि कति दिनभित्र प्रकाशित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within thirty days of introduction.
Explanation: Article 274(3) requires public publication within thirty days.

English Question: What is the purpose of publishing an amendment bill within thirty days?
Nepali Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक तीस दिनभित्र प्रकाशित गर्नुको उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To provide information to the general public.
Explanation: Article 274(3) states that publication is for public information.

English Question: When must an amendment bill be sent to the State Assembly for consent?
Nepali Question: कुन अवस्थामा संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रदेश सभाको सहमतिका लागि पठाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): When it relates to alteration of State borders or matters in Schedule-6.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेशको सीमाना परिवर्तन वा अनुसूची–६ का विषयसँग सम्बन्धित भएमा।
Explanation: Article 274(4) requires State Assembly consent in these cases.

English Question: Who sends an amendment bill to the State Assembly for consent?
Nepali Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रदेश सभाको सहमतिका लागि कसले पठाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker or Chairperson of the concerned House.
Explanation: Article 274(4) assigns this responsibility to the Speaker or Chairperson.

English Question: Within how many days after introduction in the Federal Parliament must a relevant amendment bill be sent to the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: सम्बन्धित संविधान संशोधन विधेयक संघीय संसदमा पेश भएपछि कति दिनभित्र प्रदेश सभामा पठाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within thirty days after its introduction.
Explanation: Article 274(4) provides the thirty-day period for sending the bill.

English Question: What majority is required for a State Assembly to accept or reject an amendment bill sent for consent?
Nepali Question: सहमतिका लागि पठाइएको संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गर्न प्रदेश सभामा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Majority of the total number of its then members.
Gold Answer (NE): तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 274(5) specifies the required majority.

English Question: Within what period must the State Assembly provide information about acceptance or rejection of an amendment bill?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गरेको जानकारी कति अवधिभित्र दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within three months.
Explanation: Article 274(5) requires information to be provided within three months.

English Question: What happens if a State Assembly does not provide information of acceptance or rejection of an amendment bill within the prescribed period?
Nepali Question: तोकिएको अवधिभित्र प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गरेको जानकारी नदिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federal Parliament may proceed with the bill.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदले विधेयकमाथि प्रक्रिया अगाडि बढाउन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 274(6) allows the originating House of the Federal Parliament to proceed if no information is provided within the period.

English Question: What is the consequence if a State Assembly rejects an amendment bill by majority and informs the Federal Parliament within the required period?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाले बहुमतबाट संशोधन विधेयक अस्वीकार गरी समयभित्र संघीय संसदलाई जानकारी दिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The bill becomes inoperative.
Explanation: Article 274(7) states that such a rejected bill becomes inoperative.

English Question: What majority is required to pass an amendment bill that does not require State Assembly consent?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक नपर्ने संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 274(8) establishes the required majority for passing amendment bills.

English Question: What majority is required to pass an amendment bill that has been accepted by a majority of the State Assembly?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको बहुमतबाट स्वीकार गरिएको संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न संघीय संसदमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 274(8) applies the two-thirds requirement to accepted bills as well.

English Question: Which amendment bills require State Assembly consent before being passed by the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: कुन संविधान संशोधन विधेयकलाई संघीय संसदबाट पारित गर्नुअघि प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Bills related to State border alteration or matters in Schedule-6.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदेशको सीमाना परिवर्तन वा अनुसूची–६ का विषयसँग सम्बन्धित विधेयक।
Explanation: Article 274(4) specifies when State Assembly consent is required.

English Question: If a State Assembly rejects an amendment bill, can the Federal Parliament continue processing that bill?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक अस्वीकार गरेपछि संघीय संसदले सो विधेयकमाथि प्रक्रिया जारी राख्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No, the bill becomes inoperative.
Explanation: Article 274(7) prevents further proceedings after valid rejection by the State Assembly.

English Question: To whom is a constitutional amendment bill passed under Article 274(8) presented for assent?
Nepali Question: धारा २७४(८) अनुसार पारित संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकृतिका लागि कससमक्ष पेश गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 274(9) provides that a passed bill shall be presented to the President for assent.

English Question: Within how many days must the President give assent to a constitutional amendment bill after receiving it?
Nepali Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्राप्त भएपछि राष्ट्रपतिले कति दिनभित्र स्वीकृति दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days.
Explanation: Article 274(10) requires presidential assent within fifteen days of receipt.

English Question: From which date does the Constitution become amended after an amendment bill receives presidential assent?
Nepali Question: संशोधन विधेयकमा राष्ट्रपतिको स्वीकृति पाएपछि संविधान कुन मितिबाट संशोधन भएको मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): From the date of assent.
Explanation: Article 274(10) states that the Constitution gets amended from the date of assent.

English Question: What is the correct sequence for an amendment bill requiring State Assembly consent?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक पर्ने संशोधन विधेयकको सही प्रक्रिया क्रम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Introduction in Federal Parliament → publication within thirty days → State Assembly consent process → two-thirds approval by both Houses → President’s assent.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदमा पेश → तीस दिनभित्र प्रकाशन → प्रदेश सभाको सहमति प्रक्रिया → दुवै सदनको दुई तिहाइ स्वीकृति → राष्ट्रपतिको स्वीकृति।
Explanation: Articles 274(2)–274(10) establish the complete amendment procedure.

English Question: If a State Assembly fails to communicate acceptance or rejection within three months, what constitutional option remains available?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभाले तीन महिनाभित्र स्वीकार वा अस्वीकारको जानकारी नदिएमा संविधानले के विकल्प दिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The originating House of the Federal Parliament may proceed with the bill.
Gold Answer (NE): विधेयक उत्पत्ति भएको संघीय संसदको सदनले प्रक्रिया अगाडि बढाउन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 274(6) provides this exception to the State Assembly response requirement.

English Question: What is the highest voting requirement specified in Article 274 for passing a constitutional amendment bill?
Nepali Question: धारा २७४ अनुसार संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न तोकिएको सबैभन्दा उच्च मतदान आवश्यकता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Article 274(8) establishes the two-thirds majority requirement.

English Question: What majority of the total number of the then members of the Federal Parliament is required to decide that a referendum is necessary on a matter of national importance?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय महत्वको विषयमा जनमतसंग्रह आवश्यक छ भनी निर्णय गर्न संघीय संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको कति बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the Federal Parliament is required.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ।
Explanation: Article 275(1) requires a two-thirds majority to decide that a referendum is necessary on a matter of national importance.

English Question: On what type of matter may a decision be taken through a referendum under Article 275?
Nepali Question: धारा २७५ बमोजिम कुन प्रकारको विषयमा जनमतसंग्रहमार्फत निर्णय लिन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A matter of national importance, if the Federal Parliament decides by a two-thirds majority that a referendum is necessary.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदले दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट आवश्यक ठहर गरेको राष्ट्रिय महत्वको विषयमा।
Explanation: A referendum is constitutionally permitted for a matter of national importance when the required parliamentary majority determines that it is necessary.

English Question: Who may grant pardons, suspend, commute, or remit sentences under Article 276?
Nepali Question: धारा २७६ बमोजिम कसले माफी दिन, सजाय स्थगन गर्न, घटाउन वा मिनाहा गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President may do so in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): राष्ट्रपतिले कानूनबमोजिम त्यस्तो कार्य गर्न सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 276 vests this power in the President, subject to law.

English Question: Can the President grant a pardon for a sentence imposed only by a regular court?
Nepali Question: के राष्ट्रपतिले नियमित अदालतले दिएको सजायमा मात्र माफी दिन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): No. The President may grant pardons, suspend, commute, or remit sentences passed by a court, judicial or quasi-judicial body, or administrative authority or body, in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन। राष्ट्रपतिले अदालत, न्यायिक वा अर्धन्यायिक निकाय वा प्रशासनिक अधिकारी वा निकायबाट भएको सजायलाई कानूनबमोजिम माफी, स्थगन, घटाउन वा मिनाहा गर्न सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 276 applies to sentences imposed by several types of judicial, quasi-judicial, and administrative bodies.

English Question: Who confers titles, honours, and decorations on behalf of the State?
Nepali Question: राज्यको तर्फबाट उपाधि, सम्मान र विभूषण कसले प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 277(1) assigns this function to the President.

English Question: May a citizen of Nepal accept a title, honour, or decoration from a foreign government without approval from the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: के नेपालका नागरिकले नेपाल सरकारको स्वीकृतिबिना विदेशी सरकारबाट उपाधि, सम्मान वा विभूषण स्वीकार गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. Approval from the Government of Nepal is required.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन। नेपाल सरकारको स्वीकृति आवश्यक हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 277(2) prohibits acceptance of such foreign honours without Government approval.

English Question: Which level of government has the power to make treaties or agreements under Article 278(1)?
Nepali Question: धारा २७८(१) बमोजिम सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्ने अधिकार कुन तहको सरकारसँग हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Federation.
Explanation: Article 278(1) provides that the Federation has the power to make treaties or agreements.

English Question: What must the Government of Nepal do when making a treaty or agreement concerning a matter falling within the list of State powers?
Nepali Question: प्रदेशको अधिकार सूचीमा पर्ने विषयमा सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्दा नेपाल सरकारले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must consult the concerned State.
Explanation: Article 278(2) requires consultation with the concerned State when the subject falls within the State power list.

English Question: Under what condition may a State Council of Ministers make contractual agreements on financial and industrial matters?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्ले वित्तीय तथा औद्योगिक विषयमा कुन शर्तमा करार सम्झौता गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): With the consent of the Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 278(3) requires the consent of the Government of Nepal.

English Question: Which four categories of treaties or agreements require ratification, accession, acceptance, or approval by a two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन, सम्मिलन, स्वीकृति वा समर्थन आवश्यक पर्ने सन्धि वा सम्झौताका चार विषय कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Peace and friendship; defence and strategic alliance; boundaries of Nepal; and natural resources and the distribution of their uses.
Gold Answer (NE): शान्ति तथा मैत्री; रक्षा तथा सामरिक गठबन्धन; नेपालको सीमाना; तथा प्राकृतिक स्रोत र त्यसको उपयोगको बाँडफाँड।
Explanation: Article 279(2) identifies these four categories as requiring the higher parliamentary majority.
Source Title: Ratification of, Accession to, Acceptance of, or Approval of Treaties or Agreements

English Question: Under what exception may a treaty concerning peace and friendship or natural resources be approved by a simple majority of members present in a meeting of the House of Representatives?
Nepali Question: शान्ति तथा मैत्री वा प्राकृतिक स्रोतसम्बन्धी सन्धि वा सम्झौता कुन अवस्थामा प्रतिनिधि सभाको बैठकमा उपस्थित सदस्यहरूको साधारण बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): If the treaty or agreement is of an ordinary nature and does not affect the nation extensively, seriously, or in the long term.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो सन्धि वा सम्झौता साधारण प्रकृतिको भई राष्ट्रलाई व्यापक, गम्भीर वा दीर्घकालीन रूपमा असर नगर्ने भएमा।
Explanation: Article 279(2) provides an exception for ordinary treaties under the peace and friendship and natural resources categories.

English Question: What is the constitutional consequence if a treaty or agreement is not ratified, acceded to, accepted, or approved according to Article 279?
Nepali Question: धारा २७९ बमोजिम कुनै सन्धि वा सम्झौता अनुमोदन, सम्मिलन, स्वीकृति वा समर्थन नगरिएमा त्यसको संवैधानिक परिणाम के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): After the commencement of the Constitution, the treaty or agreement does not apply to Nepal or the Government of Nepal. Additionally, no treaty or agreement may be concluded in a manner detrimental to Nepal's territorial integrity.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि त्यस्तो सन्धि वा सम्झौता नेपाल वा नेपाल सरकारमा लागू हुँदैन। साथै नेपालको क्षेत्रीय अखण्डतामा प्रतिकूल हुने गरी कुनै सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्न सकिँदैन।
Explanation: Article 279(3) establishes the effect of non-approval, while Article 279(4) independently prohibits treaties detrimental to Nepal's territorial integrity.

English Question: If both the offices of the President and Vice-President become vacant, who shall discharge the functions of the President until a new President or Vice-President is elected and assumes office?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति दुवै पद रिक्त भएमा नयाँ राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित भई पदभार ग्रहण नगरेसम्म राष्ट्रपतिको कार्य कसले सम्पादन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker of the House of Representatives.
Explanation: Article 280 provides that the Speaker of the House of Representatives shall discharge the functions required to be performed by the President during such a vacancy.
Source Title: Special Provision Relating to Discharge of Functions of President

English Question: How frequently must the Government of Nepal appraise and review the implementation and impacts of the special rights of women and the Dalit community?
Nepali Question: महिला र दलित समुदायका विशेष अधिकारको कार्यान्वयन र त्यसको प्रभावको मूल्याङ्कन तथा समीक्षा कति अवधिमा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Every ten years, concurrently with the national census.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रत्येक दस वर्षमा हुने राष्ट्रिय जनगणनासँगै।
Explanation: Article 281 requires the review to be conducted concurrently with the national census held every ten years.
Source Title: Appraisal and Review of Special Rights

English Question: On what principle may the President appoint Nepalese ambassadors and special emissaries?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपतिले नेपाली राजदूत तथा विशेष दूतहरू कुन सिद्धान्तका आधारमा नियुक्त गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The principle of inclusion.
Explanation: Article 282(1) requires appointments of Nepalese ambassadors and special emissaries to be based on inclusion.

English Question: Who receives letters of credentials from foreign ambassadors and diplomatic representatives?
Nepali Question: विदेशी राजदूत तथा कूटनीतिक प्रतिनिधिहरूको ओहोदाको प्रमाणपत्र कसले ग्रहण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President.
Explanation: Article 282(2) assigns this function to the President.

English Question: According to Article 283, what principle must be followed when making appointments to Constitutional Organs and Bodies?
Nepali Question: धारा २८३ बमोजिम संवैधानिक अंग तथा निकायमा नियुक्ति गर्दा कुन सिद्धान्तको पालना गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The inclusive principle.
Explanation: Article 283 requires appointments to Constitutional Organs and Bodies to be made in accordance with the inclusive principle.
Source Title: Appointments to be Made in Accordance with Inclusive Principle

English Question: Who serves as the Chairperson of the Constitutional Council?
Nepali Question: संवैधानिक परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Article 284(1) designates the Prime Minister as the Chairperson of the Constitutional Council.

English Question: Which of the following is NOT a regular member of the Constitutional Council under Article 284(1)? A. Chief Justice B. Speaker of the House of Representatives C. Minister for Law and Justice D. Chairperson of the National Assembly
Nepali Question: धारा २८४(१) बमोजिम निम्नमध्ये को संवैधानिक परिषद्को नियमित सदस्य होइन? क. प्रधानन्यायाधीश ख. प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख ग. कानून तथा न्यायमन्त्री घ. राष्ट्रिय सभाका अध्यक्ष
Gold Answer (EN): The Minister for Law and Justice.
Explanation: The Minister for Law and Justice is included only when the Council makes a recommendation for appointment to the office of Chief Justice under Article 284(2).

English Question: How far in advance must the Constitutional Council generally make a recommendation for the appointment of a Chief Justice or a chief or official of a Constitutional Body before the office becomes vacant?
Nepali Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीश वा संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख वा पदाधिकारीको पद रिक्त हुनुभन्दा सामान्यतया कति अगाडि संवैधानिक परिषद्ले नियुक्तिको सिफारिस गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one month before the office becomes vacant.
Gold Answer (NE): पद रिक्त हुनुभन्दा कम्तीमा एक महिना अगाडि।
Explanation: Article 284(3) requires the recommendation before one month of the expected vacancy.

English Question: On what basis must positions in the Federal civil service and other Federal government services be filled?
Nepali Question: संघीय निजामती सेवा तथा अन्य संघीय सरकारी सेवाका पदहरू कुन आधारमा पूर्ति गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Through competitive examinations based on open and proportional inclusive principles.
Gold Answer (NE): खुला तथा समानुपातिक समावेशी सिद्धान्तका आधारमा प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक परीक्षामार्फत।
Explanation: Article 285(2) requires competitive examinations and both open and proportional inclusive principles.

English Question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a member of the Election Constituency Delimitation Commission? A. A retired Judge of the Supreme Court B. A geographer C. A sociologist or demographer D. The Chief Election Commissioner
Nepali Question: निम्नमध्ये को निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण आयोगको सदस्यका रूपमा उल्लेख गरिएको छैन? क. सर्वोच्च अदालतका सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश ख. भूगोलविद् ग. समाजशास्त्री वा जनसांख्यिकीविद् घ. प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Election Commissioner.
Explanation: Article 286(1) lists a retired Supreme Court Judge, geographer, sociologist or demographer, administration expert or jurist, and a gazetted special class government officer as secretary.

English Question: What factors must the Election Constituency Delimitation Commission consider when determining election constituencies, in addition to population and geography?
Nepali Question: निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण गर्दा जनसंख्या र भूगोलका अतिरिक्त निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण आयोगले कुन-कुन पक्षलाई ध्यान दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must consider, among other things, population density, geographical specificity, administrative and transportation convenience, and the community and cultural aspects of the constituencies.
Gold Answer (NE): जनघनत्व, भौगोलिक विशिष्टता, प्रशासनिक तथा यातायात सुविधा र निर्वाचन क्षेत्रका सामुदायिक तथा सांस्कृतिक पक्षलगायतका विषयलाई ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 286(6) provides these factors to be considered during delimitation.

English Question: State three important constitutional requirements relating to the Language Commission's composition, term, and qualifications.
Nepali Question: भाषा आयोगको गठन, पदावधि र योग्यता सम्बन्धी तीनवटा महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक प्रावधान उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): The Commission must have one Chairperson and the required number of members; the term of the Chairperson and members is six years and they cannot be reappointed; and appointees must have a relevant master's degree, at least twenty years of experience in the study, teaching, and research of Nepal's languages, be at least forty-five years old, and possess high moral character.
Gold Answer (NE): आयोगमा एक जना अध्यक्ष र आवश्यक संख्यामा सदस्य हुन्छन्; अध्यक्ष तथा सदस्यको पदावधि छ वर्षको हुन्छ र पुनः नियुक्ति हुन सक्दैन; तथा नियुक्त व्यक्तिसँग सम्बन्धित विषयमा स्नातकोत्तर उपाधि, नेपालको विभिन्न भाषाको अध्ययन, अध्यापन तथा अनुसन्धानमा कम्तीमा बीस वर्षको अनुभव, कम्तीमा पैंतालीस वर्ष उमेर र उच्च नैतिक चरित्र हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 287 establishes the structure, six-year non-renewable term, and qualification requirements of the Language Commission.

English Question: Where is the capital of Nepal situated?
Nepali Question: नेपालको राजधानी कहाँ अवस्थित छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Kathmandu.
Explanation: Article 288(1) provides that the capital of Nepal shall be situated in Kathmandu.

English Question: By what majority is the capital of a State decided by the concerned State Assembly?
Nepali Question: सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाले प्रदेशको राजधानी कुन बहुमतबाट निर्धारण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the concerned State Assembly.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट।
Explanation: Article 288(2) requires a two-thirds majority of the total then membership of the concerned State Assembly.

English Question: Which type of citizenship must a person possess to be eligible for election, nomination, or appointment as President, Vice-President, Prime Minister, Chief Justice, Speaker of the House of Representatives, Chief of State, Chief Minister, Speaker of a State Assembly, or chief of a security body?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपति, उपराष्ट्रपति, प्रधानमन्त्री, प्रधानन्यायाधीश, प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख, प्रदेश प्रमुख, मुख्यमन्त्री, प्रदेश सभाका सभामुख वा सुरक्षा निकायको प्रमुख पदमा निर्वाचित, मनोनीत वा नियुक्त हुन व्यक्तिसँग कस्तो नागरिकता हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Citizenship of Nepal by descent.
Explanation: Article 289(1) requires citizenship by descent for the specified high offices.
Source Title: Special Provision Relating to Citizenship of Officials

English Question: Under what additional residence conditions may a person with naturalized citizenship or citizenship by birth be qualified for an office of a Constitutional Body other than the offices listed in Article 289(1)?
Nepali Question: धारा २८९(१) मा उल्लिखित बाहेक अन्य संवैधानिक निकायको पदमा प्राकृतिकीकृत वा जन्मको आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त व्यक्तिले कुन अतिरिक्त बसोबाससम्बन्धी शर्त पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A naturalized citizen must have resided in Nepal for at least ten years, while a person who obtained citizenship by birth must have resided in Nepal for at least five years.
Gold Answer (NE): प्राकृतिकीकृत नागरिकले कम्तीमा दस वर्ष र जन्मको आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त व्यक्तिले कम्तीमा पाँच वर्ष नेपालमा बसोबास गरेको हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 289(2) establishes different residence requirements for these citizenship categories.
Source Title: Special Provision Relating to Citizenship of Officials

English Question: What must the Federal Parliament ensure when making laws concerning the rights of trusts and farmers enjoying possessory rights over trust lands?
Nepali Question: गुठीको अधिकार तथा गुठी जग्गामा भोगाधिकार भएका किसानका अधिकारसम्बन्धी कानून बनाउँदा संघीय संसदले के सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The laws must not be prejudicial to the basic norms of the trusts.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्ता कानून गुठीका आधारभूत मान्यतामा प्रतिकूल नहुने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Article 290(1) requires legislation relating to trusts and possessory rights over trust lands to respect the basic norms of trusts.

English Question: Can a Nepali citizen holding a foreign permanent residence permit be elected, nominated, or appointed to an office under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: विदेशी स्थायी आवासीय अनुमति लिएको नेपाली नागरिक संविधानबमोजिम निर्वाचित, मनोनीत वा नियुक्त हुने पदमा योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. However, a person who has renounced the permit may become eligible after at least three months have expired from the date of renunciation.
Gold Answer (NE): हुँदैन। तर त्यस्तो अनुमति त्यागेको व्यक्तिले त्यागेको मितिले कम्तीमा तीन महिना पूरा भएपछि योग्य हुन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 291(1) creates the disqualification and provides a three-month waiting period after renunciation.
Source Title: Not to be Qualified for Appointment

English Question: For which categories of appointments are parliamentary hearings conducted under Article 292?
Nepali Question: धारा २९२ बमोजिम कुन-कुन नियुक्तिका लागि संसदीय सुनुवाइ गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Appointments to the offices of the Chief Justice and Supreme Court Judges, members of the Judicial Council, chiefs and members of Constitutional Bodies appointed on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council, and ambassadors.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रधानन्यायाधीश तथा सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश, न्याय परिषद्का सदस्य, संवैधानिक परिषद्को सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुने संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा सदस्य र राजदूतको नियुक्तिमा।
Explanation: Article 292(1) identifies these categories of appointments for parliamentary hearings.

English Question: How many members are in the joint committee formed for the purpose of parliamentary hearings?
Nepali Question: संसदीय सुनुवाइका लागि गठन हुने संयुक्त समितिमा कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Fifteen members from both Houses of the Federal Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका गरी पन्ध्र जना सदस्य।
Explanation: Article 292(2) provides for a fifteen-member joint committee consisting of members of both Houses.

English Question: What professional restriction applies to members of the parliamentary hearing joint committee during that term of the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसदको उक्त कार्यकालमा संसदीय सुनुवाइ संयुक्त समितिका सदस्यहरूलाई कुन पेशागत प्रतिबन्ध लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They may not practice law in the Supreme Court.
Gold Answer (NE): उनीहरूले सर्वोच्च अदालतमा कानून व्यवसाय गर्न पाउँदैनन्।
Explanation: Article 292(3) prohibits members of the joint committee from practicing law in the Supreme Court during that parliamentary term.

English Question: Which Constitutional Body is specifically excluded from monitoring and evaluation by committees of the House of Representatives under Article 293?
Nepali Question: धारा २९३ बमोजिम प्रतिनिधि सभाका समितिहरूले संवैधानिक निकायहरूको कामकारबाही अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन गर्दा कुन संवैधानिक निकायलाई विशेष रूपमा अपवाद गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The National Human Rights Commission.
Explanation: Article 293 allows House of Representatives committees to monitor and evaluate Constitutional Bodies other than the National Human Rights Commission.
Source Title: Monitoring of Functioning of Constitutional Bodies

English Question: What is the reporting process for Constitutional Bodies under Article 294?
Nepali Question: धारा २९४ बमोजिम संवैधानिक निकायहरूको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन पेश गर्ने प्रक्रिया के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Each Constitutional Body submits an annual report of its functioning to the President, who causes it to be laid before the Federal Parliament through the Prime Minister. A Constitutional Body may also prepare a separate report on its functioning in each State and submit it to the Chief of State.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रत्येक संवैधानिक निकायले आफ्नो कामकारबाहीको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष पेश गर्छ र राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीमार्फत संघीय संसदसमक्ष पेश गराउँछन्। संवैधानिक निकायले प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा आफ्नो कामकारबाहीसम्बन्धी छुट्टै प्रतिवेदन तयार गरी प्रदेश प्रमुखसमक्ष पेश गर्न पनि सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 294 establishes the main annual reporting chain and permits separate State-level reports.

English Question: What may the Government of Nepal constitute under Article 295(1) to make suggestions on matters relating to the boundaries of States?
Nepali Question: धारा २९५(१) बमोजिम प्रदेशको सीमासम्बन्धी विषयमा सुझाव दिन नेपाल सरकारले के गठन गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal may constitute a Federal Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारले संघीय आयोग गठन गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 295(1) authorizes the Government of Nepal to constitute a Federal Commission to make suggestions on matters relating to State boundaries.

English Question: By what majority must the names of the States be decided by the concerned State Assemblies under Article 295(2)?
Nepali Question: धारा २९५(२) बमोजिम सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाले प्रदेशको नाम निर्धारण गर्दा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A two-thirds majority of the total number of members of the concerned State Assembly is required.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ।
Explanation: Article 295(2) establishes a two-thirds majority requirement for determining the names of the States.

English Question: What commission was required to be constituted to determine the number and boundaries of Village Bodies, Municipalities, and Special, Protected, or Autonomous Regions?
Nepali Question: गाउँ निकाय, नगरपालिका तथा विशेष, संरक्षित वा स्वायत्त क्षेत्रको संख्या र सीमाना निर्धारण गर्न कुन आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal was required to constitute a commission for determining their number and boundaries.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारले तिनको संख्या र सीमाना निर्धारण गर्न आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 295(3) provides for a commission to determine the number and boundaries of these local and special regions according to criteria set by the Government of Nepal.

English Question: Within what period after the commencement of the Constitution was the commission under Article 295(3) required to be constituted, and what was its term?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको कति समयभित्र धारा २९५(३) बमोजिमको आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने थियो र यसको कार्यकाल कति थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): It had to be constituted within six months of the commencement of the Constitution, and its term was one year.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको छ महिनाभित्र आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने र यसको कार्यकाल एक वर्षको हुने थियो।
Explanation: Article 295(4) specifies both the formation deadline and the one-year term of the commission.

English Question: What happened to the Constituent Assembly existing at the commencement of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत विद्यमान संविधान सभाको के भयो?
Gold Answer (EN): It was automatically converted into the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान सभा स्वतः व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा परिणत भयो।
Explanation: Article 296(1) provides for the automatic conversion of the existing Constituent Assembly into the Legislature-Parliament.

English Question: What happened to Bills under consideration in the Legislature-Parliament when the Constitution commenced?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा विचाराधीन विधेयकहरूको के भयो?
Gold Answer (EN): They were automatically transferred to the Legislature-Parliament formed under Article 296(1).
Gold Answer (NE): ती विधेयकहरू धारा २९६(१) बमोजिमको व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा स्वतः हस्तान्तरण भए।
Explanation: Article 296(2) ensures legislative continuity by transferring pending Bills to the transitional Legislature-Parliament.

English Question: Until the election to the House of Representatives was held under the Constitution, what functions did the transitional Legislature-Parliament perform?
Nepali Question: संविधानबमोजिम प्रतिनिधि सभाको निर्वाचन नभएसम्म संक्रमणकालीन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदले कुन कार्य सम्पादन गर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): It performed the business required to be performed by the Federal Parliament under the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): यसले संविधानबमोजिम संघीय संसदले गर्नुपर्ने कार्य सम्पादन गर्थ्यो।
Explanation: Article 296(3) grants the transitional Legislature-Parliament the functions required to be performed by the Federal Parliament until the House of Representatives election.

English Question: Until a State Assembly was formed, who exercised the legislative power relating to matters listed in Schedule 6?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश सभा गठन नभएसम्म अनुसूची–६ मा उल्लिखित विषयसम्बन्धी प्रदेशको विधायिकी अधिकार कसले प्रयोग गर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Legislature-Parliament exercised that legislative power.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदले उक्त विधायिकी अधिकार प्रयोग गर्थ्यो।
Explanation: Article 296(4) temporarily vested the State Assembly's legislative power over Schedule 6 matters in the Legislature-Parliament until the State Assembly was formed.

English Question: Until when did the President and Vice-President existing at the commencement of the Constitution continue to hold office?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत पदमा रहेका राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति कहिलेसम्म पदमा कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): They continued to hold office until another President and Vice-President were elected in accordance with Article 297.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा २९७ बमोजिम अर्को राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित नभएसम्म उनीहरू पदमा कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 297(1) ensured continuity of the offices of President and Vice-President during the transitional period.

English Question: If the Legislature-Parliament failed to reach a political understanding for electing the President and Vice-President, how were they to be elected?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित गर्न व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा राजनीतिक सहमति हुन नसकेमा उनीहरू कसरी निर्वाचित हुने थिए?
Gold Answer (EN): They were to be elected by a majority of all the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यको बहुमतबाट निर्वाचित हुने थिए।
Explanation: Article 297(3) provides an alternative majority-based election mechanism when political understanding could not be reached.

English Question: What minimum proportion of the total number of then members of the Legislature-Parliament could move an impeachment motion against the transitional President or Vice-President for serious violation of the Constitution and law?
Nepali Question: संविधान र कानूनको गम्भीर उल्लङ्घन गरेको आधारमा संक्रमणकालीन राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपतिविरुद्ध महाभियोग प्रस्ताव ल्याउन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा कति भाग आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one-fourth of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा एक चौथाइ।
Explanation: Article 297(7) requires at least one-fourth of the then members to move an impeachment motion.

English Question: What majority was required for an impeachment motion against the transitional President or Vice-President to remove them from office?
Nepali Question: संक्रमणकालीन राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपतिलाई पदबाट हटाउन महाभियोग प्रस्ताव पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament was required.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो।
Explanation: Article 297(7) requires a two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members for removal through impeachment.

English Question: What happened to the Council of Ministers existing at the commencement of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत विद्यमान मन्त्रिपरिषद्को के भयो?
Gold Answer (EN): It continued to exist until the Council of Ministers under Article 298(2) was formed.
Gold Answer (NE): धारा २९८(२) बमोजिमको मन्त्रिपरिषद् गठन नभएसम्म विद्यमान मन्त्रिपरिषद् कायम रह्यो।
Explanation: Article 298(1) ensured continuity of the executive during the constitutional transition.

English Question: Within what period was the Prime Minister required to be elected after the commencement of the Constitution when the Legislature-Parliament was not in recess?
Nepali Question: व्यवस्थापिका–संसद अधिवेशनमा नरहेको अवस्थामा संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि कति समयभित्र प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister had to be elected no later than seven days after the commencement of the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको सात दिनभित्र प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो।
Explanation: Article 298(2) establishes a seven-day deadline when the Legislature-Parliament was not in recess.

English Question: If political understanding could not be reached for electing the Prime Minister, how was the Prime Minister elected?
Nepali Question: प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्न राजनीतिक सहमति हुन नसकेमा प्रधानमन्त्री कसरी निर्वाचित हुने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister was elected by a majority of all the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यको बहुमतबाट प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित हुने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 298(3) provides a majority-based alternative when political understanding fails.

English Question: What minimum composition of the Council of Ministers was expressly provided under Article 298?
Nepali Question: धारा २९८ बमोजिम गठन हुने मन्त्रिपरिषद्को न्यूनतम संरचनामा को–को रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): It consisted of the Prime Minister, a Deputy Prime Minister, and other Ministers as required.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रधानमन्त्री, एक उपप्रधानमन्त्री तथा आवश्यकताअनुसार अन्य मन्त्रीहरू रहने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 298(5) specifies the basic composition of the transitional Council of Ministers.

English Question: From whom did the Prime Minister appoint Ministers under the transitional arrangement?
Nepali Question: संक्रमणकालीन व्यवस्थाअन्तर्गत प्रधानमन्त्रीले मन्त्रीहरू कसबाट नियुक्त गर्थे?
Gold Answer (EN): Ministers were appointed from among the members of the Legislature-Parliament on the recommendation of the concerned party.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित दलको सिफारिसमा व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका सदस्यहरूमध्येबाट मन्त्री नियुक्त गरिन्थ्यो।
Explanation: Article 298(6) links ministerial appointment to membership of the Legislature-Parliament and party recommendation.

English Question: What minimum proportion of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament could table a written motion of no-confidence against the transitional Prime Minister?
Nepali Question: संक्रमणकालीन प्रधानमन्त्रीविरुद्ध लिखित अविश्वास प्रस्ताव ल्याउन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा कति भाग आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one-fourth of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा एक चौथाइ।
Explanation: Article 298(13) establishes the minimum threshold for introducing a no-confidence motion.

English Question: Within what period were the Speaker and Deputy Speaker required to be elected after the commencement of the Constitution when the Legislature-Parliament was not in recess?
Nepali Question: व्यवस्थापिका–संसद अधिवेशनमा नरहेको अवस्थामा संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि सभामुख र उपसभामुख कति समयभित्र निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): They had to be elected no later than twenty days after the commencement of the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको बीस दिनभित्र सभामुख र उपसभामुख निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो।
Explanation: Article 299(2) provides a twenty-day election deadline in this circumstance.

English Question: What requirement applied to the political-party representation of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker elected under Article 299?
Nepali Question: धारा २९९ बमोजिम निर्वाचित सभामुख र उपसभामुखको राजनीतिक दलसम्बन्धी प्रतिनिधित्वमा के व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): They had to be members representing different political parties in the Legislature-Parliament.
Gold Answer (NE): उनीहरू व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने फरक–फरक राजनीतिक दलका सदस्य हुनुपर्ने थियो।
Explanation: Article 299(4) requires the Speaker and Deputy Speaker to represent different political parties.

English Question: How were the Speaker and Deputy Speaker required to perform their functions under Article 299?
Nepali Question: धारा २९९ बमोजिम सभामुख र उपसभामुखले आफ्नो कार्य कसरी सम्पादन गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): They had to perform their functions as neutral persons without standing for or against any political party.
Gold Answer (NE): कुनै पनि राजनीतिक दलको पक्ष वा विपक्षमा नउभिई तटस्थ व्यक्तिको रूपमा कार्य सम्पादन गर्नुपर्ने थियो।
Explanation: Article 299(5) establishes the principle of neutrality in performing the functions of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker.

English Question: What majority was required for a resolution declaring that the conduct of the Speaker or Deputy Speaker was incompatible with the office?
Nepali Question: सभामुख वा उपसभामुखको आचरण निजको पदसँग अनुकूल नभएको घोषणा गर्ने प्रस्ताव पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): A majority of at least two-thirds of the total number of members of the Legislature-Parliament was required.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो।
Explanation: Article 299(6)(c) provides a two-thirds threshold for this form of removal.

English Question: Which existing courts continued to exist until the judicial structure provided for in the Constitution was established?
Nepali Question: संविधानमा व्यवस्था गरिएको न्यायपालिकाको संरचना स्थापना नभएसम्म कुन–कुन विद्यमान अदालतहरू कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Supreme Court, Constituent Assembly Court, Appellate Courts, and District Courts continued to exist.
Gold Answer (NE): सर्वोच्च अदालत, संविधान सभा अदालत, पुनरावेदन अदालत र जिल्ला अदालतहरू कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 300(1) ensures continuity of the existing judicial institutions during the transition.

English Question: What happened to cases pending in the Appellate Courts after the establishment of the High Courts?
Nepali Question: उच्च अदालत स्थापना भएपछि पुनरावेदन अदालतमा विचाराधीन मुद्दाहरूको के हुने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer (EN): They were transferred to the High Courts specified by the Government of Nepal in consultation with the Judicial Council.
Gold Answer (NE): न्याय परिषद्सँग परामर्श गरी नेपाल सरकारले तोकेका उच्च अदालतहरूमा ती मुद्दाहरू हस्तान्तरण गरिने व्यवस्था थियो।
Explanation: Article 300(4) provides for the transfer of pending Appellate Court cases to the newly established High Courts.

English Question: How are Constitutional Bodies existing at the commencement of the Constitution treated under Article 301?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायहरूलाई धारा ३०१ अन्तर्गत कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They are deemed to have been formed under the Constitution.
Explanation: Article 301(1) provides continuity by recognizing existing Constitutional Bodies as bodies formed under the new Constitution.
Source Title: Provisions relating to Constitutional Bodies and officials thereof

English Question: What happens to matters under consideration by existing Constitutional Bodies when the Constitution commences?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायहरूमा विचाराधीन विषयहरूको के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They may continue to be settled subject to the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानको अधीनमा रही तिनको निरूपण जारी रहन सक्छ।
Explanation: Article 301(1) preserves the ability of existing Constitutional Bodies to settle pending matters, subject to the Constitution.
Source Title: Provisions relating to Constitutional Bodies and officials thereof

English Question: How are chiefs and officials of Constitutional Bodies holding office at the commencement of the Constitution treated?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा पदमा रहेका संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा पदाधिकारीहरूलाई कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They are deemed to have been appointed under the Constitution.
Explanation: Article 301(2) provides legal continuity for existing chiefs and officials.
Source Title: Provisions relating to Constitutional Bodies and officials thereof

English Question: Under what conditions may existing chiefs and officials of Constitutional Bodies continue in office?
Nepali Question: विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा पदाधिकारीहरू कुन शर्तमा पदमा कायम रहन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): They continue subject to the conditions of service applicable at the time of their appointment.
Gold Answer (NE): नियुक्तिको समयमा लागू रहेका सेवाका शर्तहरूको अधीनमा रही।
Explanation: Article 301(2) preserves their existing service conditions during the transition.
Source Title: Provisions relating to Constitutional Bodies and officials thereof

English Question: What special provision applies to officials of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority and the Public Service Commission who exceed the number specified in the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानमा तोकिएको संख्याभन्दा बढी रहेका अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग र लोक सेवा आयोगका पदाधिकारीसम्बन्धी विशेष व्यवस्था के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): They may continue to hold office subject to the conditions of service applicable at the time of their appointment.
Gold Answer (NE): उनीहरू नियुक्तिको समयमा लागू रहेका सेवाका शर्तहरूको अधीनमा रही पदमा कायम रहन सक्छन्।
Explanation: Article 301(3) protects the continuity of officials who exceed the newly specified constitutional number.
Source Title: Provisions relating to Constitutional Bodies and officials thereof

English Question: Who is responsible for making necessary provisions for the delivery of services at the State and Local levels?
Nepali Question: प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा सेवा प्रवाहका लागि आवश्यक व्यवस्था गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कसको हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Article 302(1) assigns the responsibility to the Government of Nepal.
Source Title: Formation and operation of government services at State and Local levels

English Question: How may the Government of Nepal arrange for the delivery of services at the State and Local levels during the transition?
Nepali Question: संक्रमणकालमा प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा सेवा प्रवाहको व्यवस्था नेपाल सरकारले कसरी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): By adjusting employees serving in government services at the commencement of the Constitution among the Federal, State and Local levels in accordance with law.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका सरकारी सेवामा कार्यरत कर्मचारीहरूलाई कानूनबमोजिम संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा समायोजन गरेर।
Explanation: Article 302(2) permits employee adjustment among the three levels of government to support service delivery.
Source Title: Formation and operation of government services at State and Local levels

English Question: How long do the Local Bodies existing at the commencement of the Constitution continue to exist?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायहरू कति समयसम्म कायम रहन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Until the number and areas of the Local level are determined in accordance with the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानबमोजिम स्थानीय तहको संख्या र क्षेत्र निर्धारण नभएसम्म।
Explanation: Article 303(1) ensures continuity of existing Local Bodies during the transition to the constitutional Local level structure.

English Question: How are elections to officials of the existing Local Bodies conducted during the transitional period?
Nepali Question: संक्रमणकालमा विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायका पदाधिकारीहरूको निर्वाचन कसरी गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In accordance with law.
Explanation: Article 303(2) provides that elections to officials of existing Local Bodies shall be held according to law.

English Question: Until when do officials elected to the existing Local Bodies continue to hold office?
Nepali Question: विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायमा निर्वाचित पदाधिकारीहरू कहिलेसम्म पदमा कायम रहन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Until elections to the Local level are held in accordance with the Constitution.
Explanation: Article 303(3) provides continuity for elected local officials until the new Local level elections take place.

English Question: What is the general rule regarding Nepalese laws in force when the Constitution commences?
Nepali Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा प्रचलित नेपालका कानूनहरूबारे सामान्य व्यवस्था के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): They continue to remain in force until repealed or amended.
Gold Answer (NE): खारेज वा संशोधन नभएसम्म ती कानूनहरू कायम रहन्छन्।
Explanation: Article 304(1) preserves existing laws to avoid a legal vacuum during constitutional transition.
Source Title: Existing laws to remain in force

English Question: What happens to an existing law that is inconsistent with the Constitution after the specified transitional period?
Nepali Question: संविधानसँग बाझिएको विद्यमान कानूनको तोकिएको संक्रमणकालीन अवधिपछि के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It becomes invalid to the extent of its inconsistency.
Gold Answer (NE): जति हदसम्म संविधानसँग बाझिन्छ, त्यति हदसम्म अमान्य हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 304(1) establishes constitutional supremacy over inconsistent existing laws.
Source Title: Existing laws to remain in force

English Question: After what event and period does the inconsistency rule for existing laws take effect under Article 304(1)?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०४(१) अन्तर्गत विद्यमान कानूनको असंगतिसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन घटना र अवधिपछि लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): After one year from the date on which the first session of the Federal Parliament is held, an inconsistent law becomes invalid to the extent of its inconsistency.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसद्को पहिलो अधिवेशन बसेको मितिले एक वर्षपछि संविधानसँग बाझिएको कानून जति हदसम्म बाझिन्छ, त्यति हदसम्म अमान्य हुन्छ।
Explanation: The Constitution provides a transitional period before inconsistent pre-existing laws automatically become invalid to the extent of inconsistency.
Source Title: Existing laws to remain in force

English Question: How are Acts relating to the peace process under the Interim Constitution of Nepal, 2007 treated under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: नेपालको अन्तरिम संविधान, २०६३ अन्तर्गत शान्ति प्रक्रियासम्बन्धी कार्यहरूलाई संविधानअन्तर्गत कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They are deemed to have been done under the Constitution.
Explanation: Article 304(2) provides continuity and legal recognition for peace-process-related acts carried out under the Interim Constitution.
Source Title: Existing laws to remain in force

English Question: Who may issue necessary orders to remove difficulties in implementing the Constitution before the first session of the Federal Parliament?
Nepali Question: संघीय संसद्को पहिलो अधिवेशनअघि संविधान कार्यान्वयनमा उत्पन्न कठिनाइ हटाउन आवश्यक आदेश कसले जारी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The President, on the recommendation of the Government of Nepal, Council of Ministers.
Explanation: Article 305 grants this transitional power to the President, subject to a recommendation from the Council of Ministers.

English Question: What must happen to an order issued to remove difficulties under Article 305?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०५ अन्तर्गत कठिनाइ हटाउन जारी गरिएको आदेशको के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must be submitted for approval to the Legislature-Parliament or Federal Parliament that is held immediately after the order is issued.
Gold Answer (NE): आदेश जारी भएपछि तुरुन्त बस्ने व्यवस्थापिका–संसद् वा संघीय संसद्समक्ष अनुमोदनका लागि पेश गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: The power to remove difficulties is temporary and subject to legislative oversight through subsequent approval.

English Question: Under Article 306, which groups are considered “minorities”?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “अल्पसंख्यक” भन्नाले कुन समूहलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): Minorities are ethnic, linguistic, and religious groups whose population is below the percentage specified by Federal law, including groups with distinct ethnic, religious, or linguistic characteristics and aspirations to protect them that have been subjected to discrimination and oppression.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय कानूनले तोकेको प्रतिशतभन्दा कम जनसंख्या भएका जातीय, भाषिक र धार्मिक समूहहरू, साथै आफ्ना विशिष्ट जातीय, धार्मिक वा भाषिक विशेषता संरक्षण गर्ने आकांक्षा भएका र विभेद तथा उत्पीडनमा परेका समूहहरूलाई अल्पसंख्यक भनिन्छ।
Explanation: The definition includes both population-based criteria and groups with distinct characteristics that have faced discrimination or oppression.

English Question: What does the term “law” mean under Article 306 of the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानको धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “कानून” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): “Law” means Federal law, State law, and Local law.
Gold Answer (NE): “कानून” भन्नाले संघीय कानून, प्रदेश कानून र स्थानीय कानून बुझिन्छ।
Explanation: The constitutional definition recognizes laws made at all three levels of the federal structure.

English Question: What does the term “Article” refer to under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “धारा” भन्नाले के जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): It means an Article of the Constitution.
Explanation: The term “Article” is specifically defined as a provision of the Constitution itself.

English Question: What entities are included within the constitutional definition of “Municipality”?
Nepali Question: संवैधानिक रूपमा “नगरपालिका” को परिभाषाभित्र कुन निकायहरू पर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): A Municipality includes a Municipal Corporation and a Sub-municipal Corporation.
Gold Answer (NE): नगरपालिका भन्नाले महानगरपालिका र उपमहानगरपालिका समेत जनाउँछ।
Explanation: The definition gives “Municipality” a broader meaning by expressly including Municipal Corporations and Sub-municipal Corporations.

English Question: Who is considered a “citizen” under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “नागरिक” भन्नाले कसलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): A citizen means a citizen of Nepal.
Explanation: The constitutional definition limits the term to a citizen of Nepal.

English Question: How does Article 306 define the term “State”?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ ले “प्रदेश” शब्दलाई कसरी परिभाषित गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): “State” means the area and form of a federal unit of Nepal divided into federal units in accordance with the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): “प्रदेश” भन्नाले संविधानबमोजिम संघीय इकाइहरूमा विभाजित नेपालको संघीय इकाइको क्षेत्र र स्वरूपलाई जनाउँछ।
Explanation: The definition describes a State as a federal unit formed through the constitutional federal structure.

English Question: What does “remuneration” include under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “पारिश्रमिक” मा के–के समावेश हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It includes salary, allowance, pension, and any other form of emolument and facility.
Gold Answer (NE): यसमा तलब, भत्ता, निवृत्तिभरण तथा अन्य कुनै पनि प्रकारको पारिश्रमिक र सुविधा समावेश हुन्छ।
Explanation: The definition is broad and covers both direct monetary compensation and other benefits or facilities.

English Question: What powers are included within the meaning of “state power”?
Nepali Question: “राज्य शक्ति” भन्नाले कुन–कुन शक्ति समावेश भएको बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): State power includes executive, legislative, and judicial powers of the State, as well as residual power.
Gold Answer (NE): राज्य शक्तिमा प्रदेशको कार्यपालिका, व्यवस्थापिका र न्यायपालिकासम्बन्धी शक्ति तथा अवशिष्ट शक्ति समावेश हुन्छ।
Explanation: The definition expressly includes the three traditional branches of State power and residual power.

English Question: What does the term “Bill” mean under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “विधेयक” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It means a draft of an amendment to the Constitution or of an Act introduced in the Federal Parliament or a State Assembly.
Gold Answer (NE): संघीय संसद् वा प्रदेश सभामा पेश गरिएको संविधान संशोधन वा ऐनको मस्यौदालाई विधेयक भनिन्छ।
Explanation: The definition covers both constitutional amendment bills and ordinary legislative bills introduced at the Federal or State level.

English Question: What is meant by “Federation” and “Federal Units” under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “संघ” र “संघीय इकाइ” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): “Federation” means the federal level, which is the apex unit of the federal structure. “Federal Units” means the Federation, State, and Local levels.
Gold Answer (NE): “संघ” भन्नाले संघीय संरचनाको सर्वोच्च इकाइ अर्थात् संघीय तह बुझिन्छ। “संघीय इकाइ” भन्नाले संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तह बुझिन्छ।
Explanation: The Constitution distinguishes the Federation as the highest level from the broader category of all three federal units.

English Question: Which institutions are included within the definition of “Constitutional Bodies” under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “संवैधानिक निकाय” को परिभाषाभित्र कुन–कुन निकायहरू पर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): They include the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority, Auditor General, Public Service Commission, Election Commission, National Human Rights Commission, National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission, National Women Commission, National Dalit Commission, National Inclusion Commission, Indigenous Nationalities Commission, Madhesi Commission, Tharu Commission, and Muslim Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग, महालेखा परीक्षक, लोक सेवा आयोग, निर्वाचन आयोग, राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोग, राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोग, राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोग, राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोग, राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोग, आदिवासी जनजाति आयोग, मधेसी आयोग, थारू आयोग र मुस्लिम आयोग संवैधानिक निकायमा पर्छन्।
Explanation: Article 306 provides an enumerated definition of Constitutional Bodies by listing the institutions included within the term.

English Question: Who are considered “marginalized” communities under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “सीमान्तीकृत” समुदाय भन्नाले कुन समुदायलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): They are communities made politically, economically, and socially backward; unable to enjoy services and facilities because of discrimination, oppression, or geographical remoteness; or deprived of them; and having a status below the human development standards specified by Federal law. The definition also includes highly marginalized groups and groups on the verge of extinction.
Gold Answer (NE): राजनीतिक, आर्थिक र सामाजिक रूपमा पछाडि पारिएका; विभेद, उत्पीडन वा भौगोलिक विकटताका कारण सेवा तथा सुविधाको उपभोग गर्न नसकेका वा त्यस्ता सेवाबाट वञ्चित भएका; तथा संघीय कानूनमा उल्लिखित मानव विकासको मापदण्डभन्दा न्यून अवस्थामा रहेका समुदायलाई सीमान्तीकृत समुदाय भनिन्छ। यसमा अति सीमान्तीकृत र लोपोन्मुख समूहहरू समेत पर्छन्।
Explanation: The definition combines social, economic, political, geographical, and human-development factors and expressly includes highly marginalized and endangered groups.

English Question: What entities are included within the term “Local level” under Article 306?
Nepali Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “स्थानीय तह” भन्नाले कुन निकायहरूलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): It means Village Bodies, Municipalities, and District Assemblies established in accordance with the Constitution.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानबमोजिम स्थापना हुने गाउँ निकाय, नगरपालिका र जिल्ला सभालाई स्थानीय तह भनिन्छ।
Explanation: The constitutional definition identifies the entities comprising the Local level.

English Question: How are legal provisions relating to the interpretation of laws applied when interpreting the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानको व्याख्या गर्दा कानूनको व्याख्यासम्बन्धी कानूनी व्यवस्थाहरू कसरी लागू हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Subject to the provisions of the Constitution, the legal provisions relating to the interpretation of laws apply to the interpretation of the Constitution in the same manner as they apply to the interpretation of Nepalese laws.
Gold Answer (NE): संविधानका प्रावधानहरूको अधीनमा रही कानूनको व्याख्यासम्बन्धी कानूनी व्यवस्था नेपालको कानूनको व्याख्या गर्दा लागू हुने समान तरिकाले संविधानको व्याख्यामा लागू हुन्छ।
Explanation: Article 306(2) establishes the general interpretive rule while making the Constitution itself the controlling framework.

English Question: What is the short title of the Constitution, when did it commence, and which previous Constitution did it repeal?
Nepali Question: संविधानको छोटो नाम के हो, यो कहिले प्रारम्भ भयो र यसले कुन अघिल्लो संविधान खारेज गर्‍यो?
Gold Answer (EN): It may be cited as the “Constitution of Nepal”; it commenced on 20 September 2015 (3 Ashwin 2072 Bikram Sambat); and it repealed the Interim Constitution of Nepal, 2007 (2063).
Gold Answer (NE): यसको छोटो नाम “नेपालको संविधान” हो; यो २० सेप्टेम्बर २०१५ (वि.सं. २०७२ असोज ३ गते) प्रारम्भ भयो; र यसले नेपालको अन्तरिम संविधान, २०६३ खारेज गर्‍यो।
Explanation: Articles 307 and 308 establish the Constitution’s official short title, commencement date, and repeal of the Interim Constitution.

English Question: What is the short title of the Act?
Nepali Question: यस ऐनको छोटो नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Right to Information Act, 2064 B.S. (2007 A.D.).
Explanation: Section 1(1) specifies the short title of the Act.

English Question: On what day after certification does the Right to Information Act, 2064 come into force?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी ऐन, २०६४ प्रमाणीकरण भएको कति दिनपछि लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The 30th day after certification.
Explanation: Section 1(2) provides that the Act comes into force from the thirtieth day of certification.

English Question: Under the Act, what is meant by a “Public Body”?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “सार्वजनिक निकाय” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Any body or institution included in the categories listed in Section 2(a).
Gold Answer (NE): दफा २(क) मा उल्लिखित वर्गमा पर्ने कुनै निकाय वा संस्था।
Explanation: Section 2(a) defines “Public Body” through a list of specified bodies and institutions.

English Question: Which type of body is included as a Public Body because it is established under the Constitution?
Nepali Question: संविधानअन्तर्गत स्थापित कुन प्रकारको निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A body under the Constitution.
Explanation: Section 2(a)(1) includes a body under the Constitution within the definition of Public Body.

English Question: Is a body established by an Act included within the definition of a Public Body?
Nepali Question: ऐनद्वारा स्थापित निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषाभित्र पर्छ कि पर्दैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Section 2(a)(2) expressly includes a body established by an Act.

English Question: What type of body formed by the Government of Nepal is included as a Public Body?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकारद्वारा गठन गरिएको कुन प्रकारको निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A body formed by the Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Section 2(a)(3) includes a body formed by the Government of Nepal.

English Question: What is the distinction between the first three categories of Public Body under Section 2(a): a body under the Constitution, a body established by an Act, and a body formed by the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: दफा २(क) अन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायका पहिलो तीन वर्गबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): They are respectively a body under the Constitution, a body established by an Act, and a body formed by the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): ती क्रमशः संविधानअन्तर्गतको निकाय, ऐनद्वारा स्थापित निकाय र नेपाल सरकारद्वारा गठन गरिएको निकाय हुन्।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(1)–(3) separately identifies these three categories based on their constitutional, statutory, or governmental basis.

English Question: Does the definition of Public Body include an institution or foundation established by law for public service?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक सेवाका लागि कानूनद्वारा स्थापित संस्था वा प्रतिष्ठान सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषामा पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes.
Explanation: Section 2(a)(4) includes an institution or foundation established by law for public service.

English Question: Which political organizations are included within the definition of a Public Body under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार कुन राजनीतिक संगठनहरू सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषाभित्र पर्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Political parties or organizations registered under the relevant law.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित कानूनअन्तर्गत दर्ता भएका राजनीतिक दल वा संगठनहरू।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(5) includes political parties or organizations registered under the applicable law.

English Question: Under what ownership or control conditions is a body corporate included as a Public Body?
Nepali Question: कुन स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणको अवस्थामा कुनै निकायगत संस्था सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): When it is wholly or partly owned by, or under the control of, the Government of Nepal or a body receiving grants from the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारको पूर्ण वा आंशिक स्वामित्वमा वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको, वा नेपाल सरकारबाट अनुदान प्राप्त गर्ने त्यस्तो निकायको स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको अवस्थामा।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(6) covers bodies corporate under specified ownership or control conditions and bodies receiving government grants.

English Question: Can a body corporate formed by another body established by the Government of Nepal or by law be considered a Public Body, and what additional condition is specified?
Nepali Question: नेपाल सरकार वा कानूनद्वारा स्थापित निकायले सम्झौता गरी गठन गरेको निकायगत संस्था सार्वजनिक निकाय मानिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Yes, when it is formed by such a body upon entering into an agreement.
Gold Answer (NE): सक्छ, त्यस्तो निकायले सम्झौता गरी गठन गरेको अवस्थामा।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(7) includes a body corporate formed by a body established by the Government of Nepal or by law upon entering into an agreement.

English Question: What type of non-governmental organization or institution is included as a Public Body?
Nepali Question: कस्तो गैरसरकारी संस्था वा संगठन सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): One operated with money obtained directly or indirectly from the Government of Nepal, a foreign government, or an international organization or institution.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकार, विदेशी सरकार वा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संगठन वा संस्थाबाट प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा प्राप्त रकमबाट सञ्चालित संस्था वा संगठन।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(8) includes such non-governmental organizations or institutions.

English Question: What is the key difference between the Public Body categories concerning a body corporate under government ownership or control and a non-governmental organization receiving funds?
Nepali Question: सरकारी स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको निकायगत संस्था र रकम प्राप्त गर्ने गैरसरकारी संस्थाबीच सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषामा मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The former is included based on specified ownership or control, while the latter is included based on operation using money obtained from specified governments or international organizations or institutions.
Gold Answer (NE): पहिलो वर्ग निर्दिष्ट स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणका आधारमा समावेश हुन्छ भने दोस्रो वर्ग निर्दिष्ट सरकार वा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संगठन वा संस्थाबाट प्राप्त रकमबाट सञ्चालित भएको आधारमा समावेश हुन्छ।
Explanation: Sections 2(a)(6) and 2(a)(8) establish different bases for inclusion as a Public Body.

English Question: How may the Government of Nepal designate an additional body or institution as a Public Body beyond the categories expressly listed in Section 2(a)?
Nepali Question: दफा २(क) मा स्पष्ट रूपमा उल्लिखित वर्गबाहेक नेपाल सरकारले थप कुनै निकाय वा संस्थालाई कसरी सार्वजनिक निकाय तोक्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): By publishing a notice in the Gazette.
Explanation: Section 2(a)(9) allows the Government of Nepal to prescribe another body or institution as a Public Body by publishing a notice in the Gazette.

English Question: A body does not fall within any of the first eight listed categories of Public Body. Under what condition can it still be treated as a Public Body under the Act?
Nepali Question: कुनै निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायका पहिलो आठ वर्गमध्ये कुनैमा पर्दैन भने कुन अवस्थामा त्यसलाई ऐनअनुसार सार्वजनिक निकाय मान्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): If the Government of Nepal prescribes it as a Public Body by publishing a notice in the Gazette.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारले राजपत्रमा सूचना प्रकाशित गरी त्यसलाई सार्वजनिक निकायका रूपमा तोकेमा।
Explanation: Section 2(a)(9) creates an additional category allowing the Government of Nepal to designate another body or institution as a Public Body through a Gazette notice.

English Question: Under the Act, what does “Information” mean?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “सूचना” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Any written document, material, or information related to the functions, proceedings, or decisions of public importance made by a Public Body.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक निकायका कार्य, कार्यवाही वा सार्वजनिक महत्वका निर्णयसँग सम्बन्धित कुनै लिखित दस्तावेज, सामग्री वा सूचना।
Explanation: Section 2(b) defines information by reference to materials related to the functions, proceedings, or decisions of public importance of a Public Body.

English Question: What does “Public Importance” mean under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “सार्वजनिक महत्व” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A subject directly or indirectly related to the interest of citizens.
Gold Answer (NE): नागरिकको हितसँग प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा सम्बन्धित विषय।
Explanation: Section 2(c) defines Public Importance in terms of a subject related directly or indirectly to citizens’ interests.

English Question: What types of materials are included within the definition of a “Document”?
Nepali Question: “दस्तावेज” को परिभाषाभित्र कस्ता सामग्रीहरू समावेश हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Any kind of written document, including audiovisual material collected and updated through mechanical means or material that can be printed or retrieved.
Gold Answer (NE): जुनसुकै प्रकारको लिखित दस्तावेज तथा यान्त्रिक माध्यमबाट संकलन र अद्यावधिक गरिएको वा छाप्न वा पुनःप्राप्त गर्न सकिने श्रव्यदृश्य सामग्री।
