Explanation: Section 2(d) gives the definition of Document and extends it to specified audiovisual and mechanically stored or retrievable materials.

English Question: How does the Act distinguish “Information” from a “Document”?
Nepali Question: ऐनले “सूचना” र “दस्तावेज” बीच कसरी भिन्नता गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Information concerns material related to the functions, proceedings, or decisions of public importance of a Public Body, while a Document refers to written or specified audiovisual or mechanically stored or retrievable material.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना सार्वजनिक निकायका कार्य, कार्यवाही वा सार्वजनिक महत्वका निर्णयसँग सम्बन्धित सामग्री हो भने दस्तावेज लिखित वा निर्दिष्ट श्रव्यदृश्य वा यान्त्रिक रूपमा संकलित, छाप्न वा पुनःप्राप्त गर्न सकिने सामग्री हो।
Explanation: Sections 2(b) and 2(d) define the two terms using different criteria: subject matter for Information and form or medium for Document.

English Question: What is the basic right included within the definition of “Right to Information”?
Nepali Question: “सूचनाको हक” को परिभाषामा समावेश मूलभूत हक के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to ask for and obtain information of public importance held by Public Bodies.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सार्वजनिक महत्वको सूचना माग्ने र प्राप्त गर्ने हक।
Explanation: Section 2(e) defines the Right to Information as the right to request and obtain information of public importance held by Public Bodies.

English Question: Besides asking for and obtaining information, what right concerning written documents or materials held by a Public Body is included in the Right to Information?
Nepali Question: सूचना माग्ने र प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकारबाहेक सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेका लिखित दस्तावेज वा सामग्रीसम्बन्धी कुन अधिकार सूचनाको हकमा समावेश हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to study or observe them.
Gold Answer (NE): तिनको अध्ययन वा अवलोकन गर्ने हक।
Explanation: Section 2(e) includes the right to study or observe written documents and materials held by a Public Body.

English Question: What may a person obtain regarding a document under the Right to Information?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको हकअन्तर्गत कुनै दस्तावेजका सम्बन्धमा के प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A verified copy of the document.
Explanation: Section 2(e) includes the right to obtain a verified copy of a document.

English Question: What access does the Right to Information provide concerning a place where construction of public importance is taking place?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माण कार्य भइरहेको स्थानका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकले कस्तो पहुँच प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to visit or observe the place.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो स्थानमा भ्रमण वा अवलोकन गर्ने हक।
Explanation: Section 2(e) expressly includes the right to visit or observe a place where construction of public importance is going on.

English Question: What may be obtained as evidence or information about materials used in construction of public importance under the Right to Information?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माणमा प्रयोग भएका सामग्रीका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकअन्तर्गत के प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A verified sample of the material.
Explanation: Section 2(e) includes the right to obtain a verified sample of any material.

English Question: What additional access does the Right to Information provide to information held in any type of machine?
Nepali Question: कुनै पनि प्रकारको यन्त्रमा रहेको सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकले कस्तो पहुँच प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The right to obtain the information through that machine.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो यन्त्रमार्फत सूचना प्राप्त गर्ने हक।
Explanation: Section 2(e) includes the right to obtain information held in any type of machine through such machine.

English Question: Which of the following forms of access are expressly included in the statutory definition of the Right to Information: studying or observing documents, obtaining a verified copy, observing public-interest construction, obtaining a verified material sample, or obtaining machine-held information through the machine?
Nepali Question: निम्नमध्ये कुन-कुन पहुँचका स्वरूपहरू सूचनाको हकको वैधानिक परिभाषामा स्पष्ट रूपमा समावेश छन्: दस्तावेज अध्ययन वा अवलोकन गर्नु, प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि प्राप्त गर्नु, सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माण अवलोकन गर्नु, प्रमाणित सामग्रीको नमुना प्राप्त गर्नु, वा यन्त्रमा रहेको सूचना सोही यन्त्रमार्फत प्राप्त गर्नु?
Gold Answer (EN): All of them.
Explanation: Section 2(e) expressly includes each of the listed forms of access within the definition of the Right to Information.

English Question: Who is an “Information Authority” under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “सूचना अधिकारी” को हो?
Gold Answer (EN): A person appointed pursuant to Section 6.
Explanation: Section 2(f) defines Information Authority by reference to appointment under Section 6.

English Question: Who is referred to as the “Chief” under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “प्रमुख” भन्नाले कसलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of a Public Body.
Explanation: Section 2(g) defines Chief as the Chief of a Public Body.

English Question: What does the term “Commission” refer to under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार “आयोग” भन्नाले के जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer (EN): The National Information Commission constituted pursuant to Section 11.
Gold Answer (NE): दफा ११ बमोजिम गठन भएको राष्ट्रिय सूचना आयोग।
Explanation: Section 2(h) defines Commission by reference to the National Information Commission constituted under Section 11.

English Question: What is the distinction between the Chief Information Commissioner and an Information Commissioner under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त र सूचना आयुक्तबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Both are persons appointed pursuant to Section 11, but they are separately identified as the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioner.
Gold Answer (NE): दुवै दफा ११ बमोजिम नियुक्त व्यक्ति हुन्, तर उनीहरूलाई क्रमशः मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त र सूचना आयुक्तका रूपम

English Question: Who has the right to information under the Act, subject to the provisions of the Act?
Nepali Question: यस ऐनका प्रावधानहरूको अधीनमा रही सूचनाको हक कसलाई हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Every citizen.
Explanation: Section 3(1) provides that every citizen shall, subject to the Act, have the right to information.

English Question: What information shall every citizen have access to under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई कुन सूचनामा पहुँच हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Information held by Public Bodies.
Explanation: Section 3(2) provides that every citizen shall have access to information held by Public Bodies.

English Question: What types of information concerning Nepal's sovereignty, integrity, national security, public peace, stability, and international relations shall not be disseminated?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता, अखण्डता, राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा, सार्वजनिक शान्ति, स्थिरता र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धका सम्बन्धमा कस्तो सूचना प्रसार गर्न हुँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Information that seriously jeopardizes any of those interests.
Gold Answer (NE): तीमध्ये कुनै पनि हितमा गम्भीर रूपमा प्रतिकूल असर पार्ने सूचना।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(a) excludes information that seriously jeopardizes Nepal's sovereignty, integrity, national security, public peace, stability, or international relations.

English Question: What information related to a crime shall not be disseminated under the Act?
Nepali Question: अपराधसँग सम्बन्धित कुन सूचना ऐनअनुसार प्रसार गर्न हुँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Information that directly affects the investigation, inquiry, or prosecution of a crime.
Gold Answer (NE): अपराधको अनुसन्धान, छानबिन वा अभियोजनमा प्रत्यक्ष असर पार्ने सूचना।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(b) excludes information that directly affects the investigation, inquiry, or prosecution of a crime.

English Question: What types of interests or privacy are protected from serious harm under the information exception relating to economic, trade, monetary, intellectual property, banking, or trade matters?
Nepali Question: आर्थिक, व्यापारिक, मौद्रिक, बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति, बैंकिङ वा व्यापारिक विषयसँग सम्बन्धित अपवादअन्तर्गत कुन हित वा गोपनीयतालाई गम्भीर क्षतिबाट संरक्षण गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Economic, trade, or monetary interests, intellectual property, and banking or trade privacy.
Gold Answer (NE): आर्थिक, व्यापारिक वा मौद्रिक हित, बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति तथा बैंकिङ वा व्यापारिक गोपनीयता।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(c) excludes information that seriously affects these specified interests or forms of privacy.

English Question: What type of information concerning relationships among different castes or communities shall not be disseminated?
Nepali Question: विभिन्न जात वा समुदायबीचको सम्बन्धका सम्बन्धमा कस्तो सूचना प्रसार गर्न हुँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Information that directly jeopardizes the harmonious relationship among various castes or communities.
Gold Answer (NE): विभिन्न जात वा समुदायबीच कायम सद्भावपूर्ण सम्बन्धमा प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा खतरा पुर्‍याउने सूचना।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(d) excludes information that directly jeopardizes harmonious relationships among various castes or communities.

English Question: What personal interests are protected by the information exception concerning individual privacy and security?
Nepali Question: व्यक्तिगत गोपनीयता तथा सुरक्षासम्बन्धी अपवादले कुन व्यक्तिगत हितहरूको संरक्षण गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The privacy and security of a person's body, life, property, or health.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यक्तिको शरीर, जीवन, सम्पत्ति वा स्वास्थ्यको गोपनीयता तथा सुरक्षा।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(e) excludes information that interferes with individual privacy and the security of a person's body, life, property, or health.

English Question: What five broad categories of information held by a Public Body are excluded from dissemination under Section 3(3)?
Nepali Question: दफा ३(३) अन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको कुन पाँच व्यापक वर्गका सूचना प्रसार गर्न हुँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): Information seriously jeopardizing specified national interests; directly affecting crime investigation, inquiry, or prosecution; seriously affecting specified economic, trade, monetary, intellectual property, banking, or trade interests or privacy; directly jeopardizing harmony among castes or communities; or interfering with individual privacy and specified personal security.
Gold Answer (NE): निर्दिष्ट राष्ट्रिय हितमा गम्भीर प्रतिकूल असर पार्ने; अपराधको अनुसन्धान, छानबिन वा अभियोजनमा प्रत्यक्ष असर पार्ने; निर्दिष्ट आर्थिक, व्यापारिक, मौद्रिक, बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति, बैंकिङ वा व्यापारिक हित वा गोपनीयतामा गम्भीर असर पार्ने; जात वा समुदायबीचको सद्भावमा प्रत्यक्ष खतरा पुर्‍याउने; वा व्यक्तिगत गोपनीयता तथा निर्दिष्ट व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षामा हस्तक्षेप गर्ने सूचना।
Explanation: Section 3(3)(a)–(e) lists five categories of information that shall not be disseminated.

English Question: May a Public Body refuse to disseminate information without an appropriate and adequate reason?
Nepali Question: के सार्वजनिक निकायले उचित र पर्याप्त कारणबिना सूचना प्रसार गर्न अस्वीकार गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No.
Explanation: The proviso to Section 3(3) states that a Public Body shall not refrain from disseminating information without an appropriate and adequate reason.

English Question: What must the Information Officer do when a Public Body's records contain both information that may be made public and information that may not be made public?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायको अभिलेखमा सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने र सार्वजनिक गर्न नमिल्ने दुवै सूचना भएमा सूचना अधिकारीले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Separate the information that may be made public and provide it to the applicant.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने सूचना छुट्याई आवेदकलाई उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 3(4) requires the Information Officer to separate the disclosable information and provide it to the applicant.

English Question: If a single record contains both protected and disclosable information, does the presence of protected information automatically justify withholding the entire record?
Nepali Question: एउटै अभिलेखमा संरक्षित र सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने दुवै सूचना भएमा संरक्षित सूचना भएको कारणले मात्र सम्पूर्ण अभिलेख रोक्न मिल्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No. The disclosable information must be separated and provided.
Gold Answer (NE): मिल्दैन। सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने सूचना छुट्याई उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 3(4) establishes a partial-disclosure rule requiring separation of information that can be made public.

English Question: How do the general right of access under Section 3(2), the exceptions under Section 3(3), and the separation rule under Section 3(4) operate together?
Nepali Question: दफा ३(२) को सामान्य पहुँचको अधिकार, दफा ३(३) का अपवाद र दफा ३(४) को छुट्याउने नियम एकसाथ कसरी लागू हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Citizens generally have access to information held by Public Bodies, except for information falling within the specified non-dissemination categories; where a record contains both disclosable and non-disclosable information, the disclosable portion must be separated and provided.
Gold Answer (NE): नागरिकलाई सामान्यतः सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सूचनामा पहुँच हुन्छ, तर निर्दिष्ट गैर-प्रसारणयोग्य वर्गमा पर्ने सूचना अपवाद हुन्छ; अभिलेखमा सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने र नमिल्ने दुवै सूचना भएमा सार्वजनिक गर्न मिल्ने अंश छुट्याई उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Sections 3(2)–(4) establish the general right of access, specified exceptions, and a partial-disclosure mechanism.

English Question: What is the primary responsibility of every Public Body regarding the right to information of citizens?
Nepali Question: नागरिकको सूचनाको हकका सम्बन्धमा प्रत्येक सार्वजनिक निकायको मुख्य जिम्मेवारी के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To respect and protect the right to information of citizens.
Gold Answer (NE): नागरिकको सूचनाको हकको सम्मान र संरक्षण गर्नु।
Explanation: Section 4(1) requires each Public Body to respect and protect citizens' right to information.

English Question: What must a Public Body do to its information as part of its responsibilities under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार आफ्नो जिम्मेवारीअन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायले आफ्नो सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Classify and update the information and make it public, publish, and broadcast it.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना वर्गीकरण तथा अद्यावधिक गरी सार्वजनिक, प्रकाशन तथा प्रसारण गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 4(2)(a) requires Public Bodies to classify and update information and make it public, publish, and broadcast it.

English Question: What responsibility does a Public Body have regarding citizens' access to information?
Nepali Question: नागरिकको सूचनामा पहुँचका सम्बन्धमा सार्वजनिक निकायको जिम्मेवारी के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To make citizens' access to information simple and easy.
Gold Answer (NE): नागरिकको सूचनामा पहुँच सरल र सहज बनाउनु।
Explanation: Section 4(2)(b) requires Public Bodies to make citizens' access to information simple and easy.

English Question: How must a Public Body conduct its functions under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार सार्वजनिक निकायले आफ्ना कार्यहरू कसरी सञ्चालन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Openly and transparently.
Explanation: Section 4(2)(c) requires Public Bodies to conduct their functions openly and transparently.

English Question: What must a Public Body provide to its staff for the purpose of fulfilling its responsibilities regarding information?
Nepali Question: सूचनासम्बन्धी आफ्नो जिम्मेवारी पूरा गर्न सार्वजनिक निकायले आफ्ना कर्मचारीलाई के प्रदान गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Appropriate training and orientation.
Explanation: Section 4(2)(d) requires Public Bodies to provide appropriate training and orientation to their staff.

English Question: What are the four specific responsibilities of a Public Body under Section 4(2)?
Nepali Question: दफा ४(२) अन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायका चार विशिष्ट जिम्मेवारीहरू के-के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): To classify and update information and make it public, publish, and broadcast it; make citizen access simple and easy; conduct functions openly and transparently; and provide staff with appropriate training and orientation.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना वर्गीकरण तथा अद्यावधिक गरी सार्वजनिक, प्रकाशन तथा प्रसारण गर्ने; नागरिकको पहुँच सरल र सहज बनाउने; कार्य खुला र पारदर्शी रूपमा सञ्चालन गर्ने; तथा कर्मचारीलाई उपयुक्त तालिम र अभिमुखीकरण दिने।
Explanation: Section 4(2)(a)–(d) lists these four specific responsibilities.

English Question: What may a Public Body use when publishing, broadcasting, or making information public under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार सूचना प्रकाशन, प्रसारण वा सार्वजनिक गर्दा सार्वजनिक निकायले के प्रयोग गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Different national languages and mass media.
Gold Answer (NE): विभिन्न राष्ट्रिय भाषाहरू र आमसञ्चारका माध्यमहरू।
Explanation: Section 4(3) permits Public Bodies to use different national languages and mass media for publishing, broadcasting, or making information public.

English Question: What is the general requirement concerning the information held by a Public Body?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सूचनासम्बन्धी सामान्य आवश्यकता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): A Public Body shall keep its information updated.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक निकायले आफ्नो सूचना अद्यावधिक राख्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 5(1) requires a Public Body to keep its information updated.

English Question: How old may information be that a Public Body should update, as far as possible, from the commencement of the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐन प्रारम्भ भएको समयदेखि सार्वजनिक निकायले सम्भव भएसम्म कति वर्ष पुरानो सूचनासम्म अद्यावधिक गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least 20 years old.
Explanation: Section 5(2) requires a Public Body, as far as possible, to update at least twenty years old information related to it from the commencement of the Act.

English Question: What information concerning the structure and nature of a Public Body must it enlist and publish?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायको संरचना र स्वरूपसम्बन्धी कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The structure and nature of the Public Body.
Explanation: Section 5(3)(a) requires the structure and nature of the Public Body to be enlisted and published.

English Question: Which information about a Public Body's functions and authority must be enlisted and published?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायका कार्य र अधिकारसम्बन्धी कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Its functions, duties, and powers.
Explanation: Section 5(3)(b) requires the functions, duties, and powers of the Public Body to be enlisted and published.

English Question: What information about services must a Public Body enlist and publish, including information about service delivery?
Nepali Question: सेवा प्रवाहसम्बन्धी सार्वजनिक निकायले कुन-कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The services to be rendered, the branch and responsible officer providing the service, and the fee and time limit required for the service.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रदान गरिने सेवा, सेवा प्रदान गर्ने शाखा तथा जिम्मेवार अधिकारी, र सेवाका लागि लाग्ने शुल्क तथा समयसीमा।
Explanation: Sections 5(3)(d)–(f) require publication of information about services, responsible service branches or officers, and applicable fees and time limits.

English Question: What information concerning decision-making and accountability must a Public Body enlist and publish?
Nepali Question: निर्णय प्रक्रिया र जवाफदेहितासम्बन्धी सार्वजनिक निकायले कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The decision-making process and authority, the authority to hear appeals against decisions, and a description of functions performed.
Gold Answer (NE): निर्णय गर्ने प्रक्रिया र अधिकार, निर्णयविरुद्ध पुनरावेदन सुन्ने अधिकार, तथा सम्पादन गरिएका कार्यहरूको विवरण।
Explanation: Sections 5(3)(g)–(i) require publication of the decision-making process and authority, appeal authority, and a description of functions performed.

English Question: What institutional, legal, and financial information must a Public Body enlist and publish?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायले संस्थागत, कानुनी र वित्तीय पक्षसँग सम्बन्धित कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The name and designation of the Chief and Information Officer; a list of Acts, Rules, By-laws, or Guidelines; and an updated description of income, expenditures, and financial transactions.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रमुख तथा सूचना अधिकारीको नाम र पद; ऐन, नियम, विनियम वा निर्देशिकाको सूची; तथा आय, खर्च र वित्तीय कारोबारको अद्यावधिक विवरण।
Explanation: Sections 5(3)(j)–(l) require publication of these institutional, legal, and financial details.

English Question: In addition to the specifically listed categories, what other information must a Public Body enlist and publish?
Nepali Question: स्पष्ट रूपमा सूचीबद्ध गरिएका वर्गबाहेक सार्वजनिक निकायले अरू कुन सूचना सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Other particulars as prescribed.
Explanation: Section 5(3)(m) requires the enlistment and publication of other particulars as prescribed.

English Question: How many categories of information are expressly listed in Section 5(3) for a Public Body to enlist and publish, and within what time must the information be updated and published initially?
Nepali Question: दफा ५(३) मा सार्वजनिक निकायले सूचीबद्ध गरी प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्ने स्पष्ट रूपमा उल्लिखित सूचना वर्गहरू कति छन् र सुरुमा ती सूचना कति समयभित्र अद्यावधिक तथा प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Thirteen categories, within three months from the commencement of the Act.
Gold Answer (NE): तेह्र वर्ग, ऐन प्रारम्भ भएको मितिले तीन महिनाभित्र।
Explanation: Section 5(3)(a)–(m) lists thirteen categories, and Section 5(4) requires their initial updating and publication within three months from commencement.

English Question: After the initial three-month period, how frequently must a Public Body update and publish the information listed under Section 5(3)?
Nepali Question: प्रारम्भिक तीन महिनाको अवधिपछि दफा ५(३) अन्तर्गतको सूचना सार्वजनिक निकायले कति-कति अवधिमा अद्यावधिक तथा प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Every three months.
Explanation: Section 5(4) requires the Public Body to update and publish the information every three months thereafter.

English Question: What is the complete publication cycle for the information listed under Section 5(3)?
Nepali Question: दफा ५(३) अन्तर्गत सूचीबद्ध सूचनाको पूर्ण प्रकाशन चक्र के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The information must first be updated and published within three months from the commencement of the Act and then updated and published every three months thereafter.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना ऐन प्रारम्भ भएको मितिले तीन महिनाभित्र पहिलोपटक अद्यावधिक तथा प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ र त्यसपछि प्रत्येक तीन महिनामा अद्यावधिक तथा प्रकाशन गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 5(4) establishes both the initial three-month deadline and the recurring three-month update and publication cycle.

English Question: What arrangement must a Public Body make for disseminating information held in its office?
Nepali Question: सूचना प्रसार गर्न सार्वजनिक निकायले आफ्नो कार्यालयमा कस्तो व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must arrange for an Information Officer.
Explanation: Section 6(1) requires a Public Body to arrange for an Information Officer for disseminating information held in its office.

English Question: What must the Chief regularly provide to the Information Officer for the purpose of disseminating information?
Nepali Question: सूचना प्रसार गर्ने प्रयोजनका लागि प्रमुखले सूचना अधिकारीलाई नियमित रूपमा के उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Information held in the office.
Explanation: Section 6(2) requires the Chief to regularly provide information held in the office to the Information Officer.

English Question: Who may submit an application to obtain information under the Act and what must the application state?
Nepali Question: ऐनअनुसार सूचना प्राप्त गर्न कसले निवेदन दिन सक्छ र निवेदनमा के उल्लेख गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A Nepali citizen interested in obtaining information may apply to the concerned Information Officer and must state the reason for requesting the information.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना प्राप्त गर्न इच्छुक नेपाली नागरिकले सम्बन्धित सूचना अधिकारीसमक्ष निवेदन दिन सक्छ र सूचना माग्नुको कारण उल्लेख गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 7(1) provides that a Nepali Citizen interested in obtaining information shall submit an application to the concerned Information Officer stating the reason for obtaining it.

English Question: When must an Information Officer provide information that can be provided immediately by its nature?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको प्रकृतिअनुसार तुरुन्तै उपलब्ध गराउन सकिने सूचना सूचना अधिकारीले कहिले उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Immediately.
Explanation: Section 7(2) requires information that can by its nature be provided immediately to be provided immediately.

English Question: Within how many days must an Information Officer provide information that cannot be provided immediately by its nature?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको प्रकृतिअनुसार तुरुन्तै उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने सूचना सूचना अधिकारीले कति दिनभित्र उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within fifteen days from the date of application.
Explanation: Section 7(2) requires information that cannot be provided immediately by its nature to be provided within fifteen days from the date of application.

English Question: If requested information cannot be provided immediately and is related to the security of a person's life, within what maximum period must the Information Officer provide it?
Nepali Question: माग गरिएको सूचना तुरुन्तै उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने भए पनि व्यक्तिको जीवनको सुरक्षासँग सम्बन्धित भएमा सूचना अधिकारीले अधिकतम कति समयभित्र सूचना उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within twenty-four hours of the request.
Explanation: Section 7(4) creates an exception to the ordinary procedure by requiring information related to the security of a person's life to be provided within twenty-four hours of the request.

English Question: What are the three different time limits for providing information under Section 7 depending on the nature and circumstances of the request?
Nepali Question: निवेदनको प्रकृति र परिस्थितिअनुसार दफा ७ अन्तर्गत सूचना उपलब्ध गराउने तीन फरक समयसीमा के-के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Immediately if the information can be provided immediately; within fifteen days if it cannot be provided immediately; and within twenty-four hours if it relates to the security of a person's life.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना तुरुन्तै उपलब्ध गराउन सकिने भए तुरुन्तै; तुरुन्तै उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने भए पन्ध्र दिनभित्र; र व्यक्तिको जीवनको सुरक्षासँग सम्बन्धित भए चौबीस घण्टाभित्र।
Explanation: Sections 7(2) and 7(4) establish the immediate, fifteen-day, and twenty-four-hour timelines depending on the circumstances.

English Question: What must the Information Officer do if information cannot be provided immediately?
Nepali Question: तुरुन्तै सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने भए सूचना अधिकारीले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Information Officer must immediately give the applicant a notice stating the reason.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना अधिकारीले कारण उल्लेख गरी आवेदकलाई तुरुन्तै सूचना दिनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 7(3) requires immediate notice to the applicant with the reason when information cannot be provided immediately.

English Question: In what format must an Information Officer provide information to an applicant?
Nepali Question: सूचना अधिकारीले आवेदकलाई कुन ढाँचामा सूचना उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): In the format demanded by the applicant as much as possible.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्भव भएसम्म आवेदकले माग गरेको ढाँचामा।
Explanation: Section 7(5) requires the Information Officer to provide information in the format demanded by the applicant as much as possible.

English Question: When may an Information Officer provide information in a format different from the format requested by the applicant?
Nepali Question: आवेदकले माग गरेको भन्दा फरक ढाँचामा सूचना अधिकारीले कहिले सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): When providing the information in the requested format may damage, destroy, or spoil the source of the information, and the Information Officer states the reason for using the appropriate format.
Gold Answer (NE): आवेदकले माग गरेको ढाँचामा सूचना दिँदा सूचनाको स्रोतमा क्षति पुग्ने, नष्ट हुने वा बिग्रने सम्भावना भएमा र उपयुक्त ढाँचा प्रयोग गर्नुको कारण उल्लेख गरेमा।
Explanation: Section 7(6) permits an appropriate alternative format where the requested format may damage, destroy, or spoil the source of information, provided the reason is stated.

English Question: On what basis must the fee for providing information generally be determined?
Nepali Question: सूचना उपलब्ध गराउँदा लाग्ने शुल्क सामान्यतः कुन आधारमा निर्धारण हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The actual cost of providing the information.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना उपलब्ध गराउने वास्तविक लागतका आधारमा।
Explanation: Section 8(2) provides that the fee structure must be based on the actual cost of providing information.

English Question: What may a concerned person do if the prescribed fee for information is considered higher than the actual cost?
Nepali Question: सूचनाका लागि तोकिएको शुल्क वास्तविक लागतभन्दा बढी भएको लागेमा सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिले के गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person may file a petition before the Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिले आयोगसमक्ष निवेदन दिन सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 8(3) allows a concerned person to file a petition before the Commission if the prescribed fee is considered higher than the actual cost.

English Question: Within how many days must a person complain to the Chief after information is denied, partially provided, provided incorrectly, or denied on the ground that the applicant is not a stakeholder?
Nepali Question: सूचना अस्वीकार गरिएको, आंशिक रूपमा दिइएको, गलत सूचना दिइएको वा आवेदक सरोकारवाला नभएको आधारमा सूचना नदिइएको अवस्थामा सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिले कति दिनभित्र प्रमुखसमक्ष उजुरी गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within seven days from the date the information was denied or partially received.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना अस्वीकार गरिएको वा आंशिक सूचना प्राप्त भएको मितिले सात दिनभित्र।
Explanation: Section 9(1) requires the concerned person to make a complaint to the Chief within seven days of the denial or partial receipt of information.

English Question: Within how many days must an aggrieved individual appeal to the Commission against the Chief's decision, and within how many days must the Commission give its final verdict?
Nepali Question: प्रमुखको निर्णयबाट मर्का परेको व्यक्तिले आयोगसमक्ष कति दिनभित्र पुनरावेदन गर्नुपर्छ र आयोगले अन्तिम निर्णय कति दिनभित्र दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The appeal must be filed within thirty-five days of receiving notice of the decision, and the Commission must give its final verdict within sixty days of the appeal.
Gold Answer (NE): निर्णयको सूचना प्राप्त भएको मितिले पैंतीस दिनभित्र पुनरावेदन गर्नुपर्छ र आयोगले पुनरावेदन परेको मितिले साठी दिनभित्र अन्तिम निर्णय दिनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Sections 10(1) and 10(4) establish a thirty-five-day appeal period and a sixty-day period for the Commission's final verdict.

English Question: What independent body is established for the protection, promotion, and practice of the right to information?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको हकको संरक्षण, प्रवर्द्धन तथा अभ्यासका लागि कुन स्वतन्त्र निकायको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): An independent National Information Commission.
Explanation: Section 11(1) provides for an independent National Information Commission for the protection, promotion, and practice of the right to information.

English Question: How many members comprise the National Information Commission, and what are their positions?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सूचना आयोगमा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन् र उनीहरूका पदहरू के-के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): One Chief Information Commissioner and two Information Commissioners.
Gold Answer (NE): एक जना मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त र दुई जना सूचना आयुक्त।
Explanation: Section 11(2) provides that the Commission shall consist of a Chief Information Commissioner and two other Information Commissioners.

English Question: Who serves as the Chairperson of the committee responsible for recommending the appointment of the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्ने समितिको अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Speaker.
Explanation: Section 11(3)(a) provides that the Speaker shall be the Chairperson of the recommendation committee.

English Question: Which two government positions may serve as the government representative on the recommendation committee for appointing Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: सूचना आयुक्तहरूको नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्ने समितिमा सरकारी प्रतिनिधिका रूपमा कुन दुईमध्ये कुनै एक पद रहन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Minister or State Minister for Information and Communication.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना तथा सञ्चार मन्त्री वा राज्यमन्त्री।
Explanation: Section 11(3)(b) provides for the Minister or State Minister for Information and Communication as a member of the committee.

English Question: Who serves as the journalist-sector representative on the recommendation committee for appointing the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्ने समितिमा पत्रकारिता क्षेत्रबाट प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने व्यक्ति को हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The President of the Federation of Nepalese Journalists.
Explanation: Section 11(3)(c) provides that the President of the Federation of Nepalese Journalists shall be a member of the recommendation committee.

English Question: Who appoints the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners, and on whose recommendation are they appointed?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको नियुक्ति कसले गर्छ र कसको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal appoints them on the recommendation of the committee formed under Section 11(3).
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारले दफा ११(३) बमोजिम गठित समितिको सिफारिसमा उनीहरूको नियुक्ति गर्छ।
Explanation: Section 11(4) provides that the Government of Nepal shall appoint the Commissioners on the recommendation of the committee established under Section 11(3).

English Question: What minimum gender representation requirement applies when appointing the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको नियुक्तिमा न्यूनतम लैङ्गिक प्रतिनिधित्वसम्बन्धी के व्यवस्था छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one female must be included in the appointment.
Gold Answer (NE): कम्तीमा एक जना महिला समावेश हुनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 11(4) expressly requires at least one female to be included in the appointment of the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners.

English Question: What principle should the recommendation committee follow as much as possible when recommending candidates for appointment to the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगमा नियुक्तिका लागि उम्मेदवार सिफारिस गर्दा सिफारिस समितिले सम्भव भएसम्म कुन सिद्धान्त अपनाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The inclusive principle.
Explanation: Section 11(5) requires the recommendation committee to follow the inclusive principle as much as possible.

English Question: How does the Act distinguish between the mandatory gender requirement and the broader recommendation principle for appointments to the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगमा नियुक्तिसम्बन्धी अनिवार्य लैङ्गिक आवश्यकता र व्यापक सिफारिस सिद्धान्तबीच ऐनले कसरी भिन्नता गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least one female must be included in the appointment, while the recommendation committee should follow the inclusive principle as much as possible.
Gold Answer (NE): नियुक्तिमा कम्तीमा एक जना महिला समावेश हुनुपर्छ भने सिफारिस समितिले सम्भव भएसम्म समावेशी सिद्धान्त अपनाउनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 11(4) establishes the minimum female-inclusion requirement, while Section 11(5) requires the recommendation committee to follow the inclusive principle as much as possible.

English Question: What citizenship qualification is required to be appointed as the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तमा नियुक्त हुन नागरिकतासम्बन्धी कस्तो योग्यता आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person must be a Nepali citizen.
Explanation: Section 12(a) requires a person appointed to either position to be a Nepali citizen.

English Question: What minimum educational qualification is required for appointment as the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तमा नियुक्त हुन न्यूनतम शैक्षिक योग्यता के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): At least a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university.
Gold Answer (NE): मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालयबाट कम्तीमा स्नातक तहको उपाधि।
Explanation: Section 12(b) requires at least a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.

English Question: How many years of work experience must a person have to qualify for appointment as the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तमा नियुक्त हुन व्यक्तिसँग कति वर्षको कार्य अनुभव हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): At least fifteen years.
Explanation: Section 12(c) requires at least fifteen years of working experience in one of the specified fields.

English Question: In which fields must the required fifteen years of work experience be obtained for appointment to the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगमा नियुक्तिका लागि आवश्यक पन्ध्र वर्षको कार्य अनुभव कुन-कुन क्षेत्रमा हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Mass communication, law justice, public administration, information technology, or management.
Gold Answer (NE): आमसञ्चार, कानून न्याय, सार्वजनिक प्रशासन, सूचना प्रविधि वा व्यवस्थापन।
Explanation: Section 12(c) specifies these five fields as the areas in which the required fifteen years of work experience must be obtained.

English Question: What is the effect of not possessing the qualifications prescribed under Section 12 on appointment to the Commission?
Nepali Question: दफा १२ मा तोकिएका योग्यता नभएमा आयोगमा नियुक्तिका सम्बन्धमा के प्रभाव पर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person is disqualified for appointment.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो व्यक्ति नियुक्तिका लागि अयोग्य हुन्छ।
Explanation: Section 13(a) disqualifies a person who does not possess the qualifications prescribed under Section 12.

English Question: Which categories of persons are disqualified from appointment as Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner under Section 13?
Nepali Question: दफा १३ अन्तर्गत मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तमा नियुक्तिका लागि कुन-कुन व्यक्ति अयोग्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): A person lacking the qualifications under Section 12; a person convicted by a court of a criminal offence involving moral turpitude; an incumbent employee of the Government or a Public institution; a person holding a political position; or a person disqualified under prevailing laws.
Gold Answer (NE): दफा १२ बमोजिमको योग्यता नभएको व्यक्ति; नैतिक पतन देखिने फौजदारी कसुरमा अदालतबाट दोषी ठहरिएको व्यक्ति; सरकार वा सार्वजनिक संस्थाको बहालवाला कर्मचारी; राजनीतिक पदमा बहाल रहेको व्यक्ति; वा प्रचलित कानूनबमोजिम नियुक्तिका लागि अयोग्य व्यक्ति।
Explanation: Section 13(a)–(e) lists five categories of disqualification for appointment as Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner.

English Question: What is the tenure of office of the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको पदावधि कति हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Five years.
Explanation: Section 14(1) provides that the tenure of office of the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners shall be five years.

English Question: May the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner be re-appointed to the same post after completing a five-year tenure?
Nepali Question: पाँच वर्षको पदावधि पूरा गरेपछि मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तलाई सोही पदमा पुनः नियुक्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No, they cannot be re-appointed to the same post.
Gold Answer (NE): सकिँदैन, सोही पदमा पुनः नियुक्त गर्न सकिँदैन।
Explanation: Section 14(1) provides a five-year tenure and prohibits reappointment to the same post.

English Question: What exception allows an Information Commissioner to be appointed again to another position within the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगभित्र सूचना आयुक्तलाई अर्को पदमा पुनः नियुक्त गर्न सकिने अपवाद के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): An Information Commissioner may be re-appointed as the Chief Information Commissioner, subject to the applicable tenure provision.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना आयुक्तलाई लागू हुने पदावधिसम्बन्धी प्रावधानको अधीनमा मुख्य सूचना आयुक्तमा पुनः नियुक्त गर्न सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Section 14(2) creates an exception to the general restriction on reappointment by allowing an Information Commissioner to be appointed as Chief Information Commissioner.

English Question: How long before the expiry of the tenure must the recommendation committee recommend new appointments of the Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त तथा सूचना आयुक्तहरूको पदावधि समाप्त हुनुभन्दा कति समयअघि सिफारिस समितिले नयाँ नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): One month before the expiry of the tenure.
Explanation: Section 14(3) requires the recommendation committee to recommend new appointments one month before the expiry of the tenure.

English Question: At what age is the post of the Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner considered vacant?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तले कुन उमेर पूरा गरेपछि पद रिक्त भएको मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Upon completing 65 years of age.
Explanation: Section 15(b) provides that the post shall be considered vacant when the officeholder completes the age of 65 years.

English Question: What are the grounds specified in the Act for the post of Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner to become vacant?
Nepali Question: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तको पद रिक्त हुने ऐनमा उल्लिखित अवस्थाहरू के-के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): Death; completion of 65 years of age; resignation to the Prime Minister; completion of the term of office; conviction by a court for a criminal offence involving moral turpitude; or removal from office under Section 16.
Gold Answer (NE): मृत्यु; ६५ वर्ष उमेर पूरा हुनु; प्रधानमन्त्रीसमक्ष राजीनामा दिनु; पदावधि पूरा हुनु; नैतिक पतन देखिने फौजदारी कसुरमा अदालतबाट दोषी ठहरिनु; वा दफा १६ बमोजिम पदबाट हटाइनु।
Explanation: Section 15(a)–(f) specifies six conditions under which the post becomes vacant.

English Question: What majority is required in the meeting of the Legislature-Parliament to remove the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner after the prescribed recommendation?
Nepali Question: निर्धारित सिफारिसपछि मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तलाई पदबाट हटाउन व्यवस्थापिका–संसद्को बैठकमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A two-thirds majority of the meeting, with at least two-thirds of the total members present.
Gold Answer (NE): कुल सदस्यको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ उपस्थित भएको बैठकको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।
Explanation: Section 16 requires the recommendation to be endorsed by a two-thirds majority of the meeting, with at least two-thirds of the total members present.

English Question: On what grounds may the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner be removed from office under Section 16?
Nepali Question: दफा १६ अन्तर्गत मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तलाई कुन आधारमा पदबाट हटाउन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Incompetence, misbehavior, or failure to carry out duties honestly.
Gold Answer (NE): अयोग्यता, दुर्व्यवहार वा इमानदारीपूर्वक कर्तव्य निर्वाह नगर्नु।
Explanation: Section 16 permits removal on the ground that the officeholder is unfit to hold office due to incompetence, misbehavior, or failure to carry out duties honestly.

English Question: What procedural protection must be provided to a Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner facing accusations under Section 16?
Nepali Question: दफा १६ अन्तर्गत आरोप लागेका मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त वा सूचना आयुक्तलाई कुन प्रक्रियागत संरक्षण प्रदान गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A reasonable opportunity to provide clarification.
Explanation: The proviso to Section 16 states that the person charged with the accusation shall not be denied a reasonable opportunity of clarification.

English Question: Before whom does the Chief Information Commissioner take the oath of office before assuming office?
Nepali Question: पदभार ग्रहण गर्नुअघि मुख्य सूचना आयुक्तले कसको समक्ष पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ लिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Prime Minister.
Explanation: Section 18 provides that the Chief Information Commissioner shall take the oath of office before the Prime Minister before taking charge of office.

English Question: Before whom does an Information Commissioner take the oath of office before assuming office?
Nepali Question: पदभार ग्रहण गर्नुअघि सूचना आयुक्तले कसको समक्ष पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ लिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Information Commissioner.
Explanation: Section 18 provides that an Information Commissioner shall take the oath of office before the Chief Information Commissioner.

English Question: What types of actions may the Commission take regarding information held by Public Bodies?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा आयोगले कस्ता कार्य गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may observe and study records and documents of public importance, order Public Bodies to enlist and manage information-related records and materials, order information to be made public, prescribe a timeframe for providing requested information, order parties to fulfill liabilities under the Act, provide suggestions and recommendations, and issue appropriate orders for protecting, promoting, and exercising the right to information.
Gold Answer (NE): आयोगले सार्वजनिक महत्वका अभिलेख तथा दस्तावेजको अवलोकन र अध्ययन गर्न, सार्वजनिक निकायलाई सूचनासम्बन्धी अभिलेख तथा सामग्री सूचीबद्ध र व्यवस्थापन गर्न आदेश दिन, सूचना सार्वजनिक गर्न आदेश दिन, माग गरिएको सूचना उपलब्ध गराउने समयसीमा तोक्न, ऐनबमोजिमको दायित्व पूरा गर्न सम्बन्धित पक्षलाई आदेश दिन, सुझाव तथा सिफारिस दिन र सूचनाको हकको संरक्षण, प्रवर्द्धन तथा अभ्याससम्बन्धी उपयुक्त आदेश जारी गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 19(a)–(g) sets out the Commission's functions, duties, and powers, including oversight, orders, deadlines, recommendations, and other appropriate orders.

English Question: Which power of the Commission may not be delegated under Section 20?
Nepali Question: दफा २० अन्तर्गत आयोगको कुन अधिकार प्रत्यायोजन गर्न सकिँदैन?
Gold Answer (EN): The power to hear and decide an appeal under Section 9.
Gold Answer (NE): दफा ९ अन्तर्गत पुनरावेदन सुन्ने र निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार।
Explanation: Section 20 permits delegation of the Commission's functions, duties, or powers except the power to hear and decide an appeal under Section 9.

English Question: Where is the central office of the National Information Commission located, and where else may it open offices?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय सूचना आयोगको केन्द्रीय कार्यालय कहाँ रहनेछ र आयोगले अन्यत्र कहाँ कार्यालय खोल्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The central office is in Kathmandu Valley, and offices may be opened in various places of the country as necessary.
Gold Answer (NE): केन्द्रीय कार्यालय काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा रहनेछ र आवश्यकताअनुसार देशका विभिन्न स्थानमा कार्यालय खोल्न सकिन्छ।
Explanation: Section 21 provides for the central office in Kathmandu Valley and permits offices to be opened in various places of the country as necessary.

English Question: Who is responsible for managing the staff and arranging the necessary budget for the Commission?
Nepali Question: आयोगका लागि आवश्यक कर्मचारी र बजेटको व्यवस्था गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कसको हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Sections 22(2) and 23(1) provide that the Government of Nepal shall manage the required staff and arrange the necessary budget for the Commission.

English Question: From what other sources may the Commission receive necessary financial resources, and what condition applies?
Nepali Question: आयोगले अन्य क्षेत्रबाट आवश्यक आर्थिक स्रोत प्राप्त गर्न सक्छ भने त्यसमा कुन शर्त लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may receive necessary financial resources from other sectors after obtaining prior permission from the Government of Nepal.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपाल सरकारको पूर्व स्वीकृति लिएपछि अन्य क्षेत्रबाट आवश्यक आर्थिक स्रोत प्राप्त गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 23(2) permits the Commission to receive necessary financial resources from other sectors only after obtaining prior permission from the Government of Nepal.

English Question: What are Public Bodies required to provide to the Commission in relation to its activities?
Nepali Question: आयोगका गतिविधिहरूका सम्बन्धमा सार्वजनिक निकायहरूले के उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Necessary cooperation.
Explanation: Section 24 requires Public Bodies to provide necessary cooperation in the activities of the Commission.

English Question: To whom and through whom must the Commission submit its annual report, and what must it subsequently do with the report?
Nepali Question: आयोगले आफ्नो वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन कसलाई र कसको माध्यमबाट पेश गर्नुपर्छ तथा त्यसपछि प्रतिवेदनका सम्बन्धमा के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must submit the annual report of its activities to the Legislature-Parliament through the Prime Minister and publish the report publicly for public notice.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रधानमन्त्रीमार्फत व्यवस्थापिका–संसद्मा आफ्नो गतिविधिको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन पेश गरी सार्वजनिक जानकारीका लागि प्रतिवेदन सार्वजनिक गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 25(1) establishes the submission route through the Prime Minister to the Legislature-Parliament, while Section 25(2) requires public publication of the report.

English Question: Through which ministry must the Commission contact the Government of Nepal?
Nepali Question: आयोगले नेपाल सरकारसँग कुन मन्त्रालयमार्फत सम्पर्क गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Ministry of Information and Communication.
Explanation: Section 27 provides that the Commission shall contact the Government of Nepal through the Ministry of Information and Communication.

English Question: Who chairs the committee responsible for classifying information held by Public Bodies at the policy level?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सूचनालाई नीतिगत तहमा वर्गीकरण गर्ने समितिको अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief Secretary of the Government of Nepal.
Explanation: Section 28(1)(a) provides that the Chief Secretary of the Government of Nepal shall chair the information-classification committee.

English Question: Who are the other two members of the committee responsible for classifying information at the policy level?
Nepali Question: नीतिगत तहमा सूचना वर्गीकरण गर्ने समितिका अन्य दुई सदस्यहरू को-को हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Secretary of the concerned Ministry and an expert in the concerned subject assigned by the Chief of Office or Chairperson.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित मन्त्रालयका सचिव र कार्यालय प्रमुख वा अध्यक्षले तोकेको सम्बन्धित विषयको विशेषज्ञ।
Explanation: Section 28(1)(b)–(c) identifies the Secretary of the concerned Ministry and an expert in the concerned subject as the other members.

English Question: What two matters must the information-classification committee determine and report to the Commission regarding classified information?
Nepali Question: सूचना वर्गीकरण समितिले वर्गीकृत सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा कुन दुई विषय निर्धारण गरी आयोगलाई जानकारी गराउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The number of years the information should remain confidential and the method for protecting the information.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना कति वर्ष गोप्य राख्ने र सूचनाको संरक्षण गर्ने विधि।
Explanation: Section 28(2) requires the committee to determine the confidentiality period and the method of protecting the information and inform the Commission.

English Question: What remedy is available to a person dissatisfied with the classification of information by the committee?
Nepali Question: समितिले गरेको सूचना वर्गीकरणबाट असन्तुष्ट व्यक्तिले कुन उपचारको माग गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person may file a review petition before the Commission to make the information public.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यक्तिले सूचना सार्वजनिक गराउन आयोगसमक्ष पुनरावलोकनको निवेदन दिन सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 28(3) allows a dissatisfied person to file a review petition before the Commission seeking to make the information public.

English Question: What may the Commission do if, during its review, it finds that classified information no longer needs to remain confidential?
Nepali Question: पुनरावलोकनका क्रममा वर्गीकृत सूचना गोप्य राखिरहन आवश्यक छैन भन्ने आयोगलाई लागेमा आयोगले के गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may issue an order to make the information public.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचनालाई सार्वजनिक गर्न आदेश दिन सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 28(4) authorizes the Commission to order the publication of information if it finds that the information need not remain confidential.

English Question: What is the maximum period for which information classified as confidential may be kept confidential under Section 28?
Nepali Question: दफा २८ अन्तर्गत गोप्य रूपमा वर्गीकृत सूचना अधिकतम कति अवधिसम्म गोप्य राख्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Thirty years.
Explanation: Section 28(5) provides that classified information may be kept confidential for a maximum period of thirty years, according to the nature of the information.

English Question: How frequently must the committee review whether information classified as confidential still needs to remain confidential?
Nepali Question: गोप्य रूपमा वर्गीकृत सूचना अझै गोप्य राख्न आवश्यक छ वा छैन भनेर समितिले कति अवधिमा पुनरावलोकन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Every ten years.
Explanation: Section 28(6) requires the committee to review every ten years whether classified information still needs to remain confidential.

English Question: How do the maximum confidentiality period and the mandatory review period differ under Section 28?
Nepali Question: दफा २८ अन्तर्गत अधिकतम गोपनीयता अवधि र अनिवार्य पुनरावलोकन अवधिबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Information may be kept confidential for a maximum of thirty years, but the committee must review the need for continued confidentiality every ten years.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना अधिकतम तीस वर्षसम्म गोप्य राख्न सकिन्छ, तर गोपनीयता कायम राख्न आवश्यक छ वा छैन भनेर समितिले प्रत्येक दस वर्षमा पुनरावलोकन गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 28(5) sets a maximum confidentiality period of thirty years, while Section 28(6) requires review every ten years.

English Question: After a ten-year review, what options does the committee have if it determines that continued confidentiality is necessary or unnecessary?
Nepali Question: दस वर्षको पुनरावलोकनपछि सूचना थप समय गोप्य राख्न आवश्यक वा अनावश्यक ठहरिएमा समितिले के-कस्ता निर्णय गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may determine an additional confidentiality period and continue classification as confidential, or classify the information as non-confidential if continued confidentiality is unnecessary.
Gold Answer (NE): थप गोपनीयता अवधि तोकी सो अवधिका लागि गोप्य वर्गीकरण कायम राख्न वा गोप्य राख्न आवश्यक नभएमा गैर-गोप्य रूपमा वर्गीकरण गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 28(7) allows the committee either to extend confidentiality for a determined period or to classify the information as non-confidential after review.

English Question: If a person challenges the classification of information and the Commission determines during review that confidentiality is unnecessary, what procedural sequence follows?
Nepali Question: कुनै व्यक्तिले सूचना वर्गीकरणलाई चुनौती दिएपछि पुनरावलोकनका क्रममा गोपनीयता आवश्यक छैन भन्ने आयोगले ठहर गरेमा के प्रक्रियागत क्रम लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person files a review petition before the Commission, the Commission reviews the classification, and if it finds confidentiality unnecessary, it orders the information to be made public.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यक्तिले आयोगसमक्ष पुनरावलोकनको निवेदन दिन्छ, आयोगले वर्गीकरणको पुनरावलोकन गर्छ र गोपनीयता आवश्यक नभएमा सूचना सार्वजनिक गर्न आदेश दिन्छ।
Explanation: Sections 28(3)–(4) establish the review mechanism and the Commission's authority to order disclosure when continued confidentiality is unnecessary.

English Question: What responsibility does a Public Body have regarding personal information held by it?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायले आफूसँग रहेको व्यक्तिगत सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा के जिम्मेवारी वहन गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must protect the information from unauthorized publication and broadcasting.
Gold Answer (NE): अनधिकृत प्रकाशन तथा प्रसारणबाट सूचनाको संरक्षण गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 29(1) requires a Public Body to protect personal information held by it from unauthorized publication and broadcasting.

English Question: What is generally required before personal information held by a Public Body may be used?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको व्यक्तिगत सूचना प्रयोग गर्न सामान्यतया के आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The written consent of the concerned person.
Explanation: Section 29(2) provides that personal information shall not be used without the written consent of the concerned person, subject to specified exceptions.

English Question: Under what three circumstances may personal information be used without the written consent of the concerned person?
Nepali Question: सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिको लिखित सहमतिबिना व्यक्तिगत सूचना कुन तीन अवस्थामा प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): To prevent a serious threat to a person's life or body or to public health or security; when disclosure is required by prevailing laws; or when required to control corruption offences.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यक्तिको जीवन वा शरीर वा सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य वा सुरक्षामा गम्भीर खतरा रोक्न; प्रचलित कानूनबमोजिम खुलासा गर्न आवश्यक भएमा; वा भ्रष्टाचारसम्बन्धी अपराध नियन्त्रण गर्न आवश्यक भएमा।
Explanation: Section 29(2)(a)–(c) provides three exceptions to the general written-consent requirement.

English Question: What duty does an employee of a Public Body have regarding ongoing or probable corruption, irregularities, or acts constituting offences?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायका कर्मचारीले भइरहेको वा सम्भावित भ्रष्टाचार, अनियमितता वा कसुर हुने कार्यका सम्बन्धमा के कर्तव्य पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The employee must provide information about them.
Explanation: Section 30(1) makes it the responsibility of a Public Body employee to provide information about ongoing or probable corruption, irregularities, or acts constituting offences under prevailing laws.

English Question: What duty does the recipient of information have regarding the identity of a whistleblower?
Nepali Question: सूचना प्राप्त गर्ने व्यक्तिले सूचनादाताको पहिचानका सम्बन्धमा के कर्तव्य पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The recipient must keep the whistleblower's identity confidential.
Explanation: Section 30(2) requires the person receiving the information to keep the identity of the whistleblower confidential.

English Question: What forms of retaliation against a whistleblower are prohibited for providing information under Section 30?
Nepali Question: दफा ३० अन्तर्गत सूचना दिएको कारण सूचनादातामाथि कस्ता प्रतिशोधात्मक कार्य गर्न निषेध गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The whistleblower may not be terminated, punished with legal responsibility, or caused loss or harm.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचनादातालाई सेवाबाट हटाउन, कानूनी जिम्मेवारीसहित दण्डित गर्न वा कुनै हानि वा क्षति पुर्‍याउन पाइँदैन।
Explanation: Section 30(3) protects whistleblowers from termination, legal punishment, and loss or harm for providing information.

English Question: If a whistleblower is removed from office or otherwise harmed in violation of the protection under Section 30, what remedies may the whistleblower seek?
Nepali Question: दफा ३० अन्तर्गतको संरक्षणविपरीत सूचनादातालाई पदबाट हटाइएमा वा अन्यथा हानि पुर्‍याइएमा सूचनादाताले कुन उपचार माग्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The whistleblower may complain to the Commission and demand revocation of the decision and compensation.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचनादाताले आयोगसमक्ष उजुरी गरी निर्णय बदर र क्षतिपूर्तिको माग गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 30(4) allows a complaint to the Commission along with a demand for compensation, and Section 30(5) authorizes the Commission to order revocation of removal and compensation for damages.

English Question: What may the Commission order if its investigation finds that a whistleblower was removed from office or suffered damage in violation of Section 30(3)?
Nepali Question: दफा ३०(३) को उल्लङ्घन गरी सूचनादातालाई पदबाट हटाइएको वा क्षति पुर्‍याइएको पाइएमा आयोगले के आदेश दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may order revocation of the removal decision and compensation for any damage caused to the whistleblower.
Gold Answer (NE): पदबाट हटाउने निर्णय बदर गर्न र सूचनादातालाई भएको क्षतिको क्षतिपूर्ति दिन आदेश गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 30(5) grants the Commission authority to order revocation of the removal decision and compensation where the complaint is substantiated.

English Question: How does the Act protect a whistleblower's identity differently from protecting the whistleblower against retaliation?
Nepali Question: ऐनले सूचनादाताको पहिचानको गोपनीयता र प्रतिशोधबाट संरक्षणलाई कसरी फरक रूपमा व्यवस्था गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The recipient must keep the whistleblower's identity confidential, while the whistleblower is protected from termination, legal punishment, loss, or harm for providing information.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना प्राप्तकर्ताले सूचनादाताको पहिचान गोप्य राख्नुपर्छ भने सूचना दिएको कारण सूचनादातालाई सेवाबाट हटाउने, कानूनी दण्ड दिने वा हानि पुर्‍याउने कार्यबाट संरक्षण गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Section 30(2) concerns confidentiality of identity, while Section 30(3) prohibits retaliation against the whistleblower.

English Question: What restriction applies to a person who obtains information from a Public Body?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायबाट सूचना प्राप्त गर्ने व्यक्तिमाथि कस्तो प्रतिबन्ध लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The person must not misuse the information or use it for a purpose different from the purpose for which it was obtained.
Gold Answer (NE): व्यक्तिले सूचनाको दुरुपयोग गर्न वा जुन प्रयोजनका लागि प्राप्त गरेको हो त्यसबाहेक अन्य प्रयोजनका लागि प्रयोग गर्न हुँदैन।
Explanation: Section 31(1) prohibits a person who obtains information from a Public Body from misusing it or using it for a purpose other than the purpose considered when obtaining it.

English Question: Who may complain to the Commission when information obtained from a Public Body is misused?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायबाट प्राप्त सूचना दुरुपयोग भएमा आयोगसमक्ष कसले उजुरी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The concerned Public Body.
Explanation: Section 31(2) allows the concerned Public Body to complain to the Commission against a person who misuses information in violation of Section 31(1).

English Question: How does the protection of personal information under Section 29 differ from the prohibition on misuse of information under Section 31?
Nepali Question: दफा २९ अन्तर्गत व्यक्तिगत सूचनाको संरक्षण र दफा ३१ अन्तर्गत सूचनाको दुरुपयोग निषेधबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Section 29 restricts unauthorized use and disclosure of personal information, while Section 31 restricts a recipient's misuse of information or use for a purpose different from the purpose for which it was obtained.
Gold Answer (NE): दफा २९ ले व्यक्तिगत सूचनाको अनधिकृत प्रयोग तथा प्रकाशनलाई सीमित गर्छ भने दफा ३१ ले प्राप्तकर्ताले सूचनाको दुरुपयोग गर्ने वा प्राप्तिको उद्देश्यभन्दा फरक उद्देश्यमा प्रयोग गर्ने कार्यलाई निषेध गर्छ।
Explanation: Section 29 focuses on protecting personal information and consent-based use, while Section 31 focuses on the subsequent use and misuse of information obtained from a Public Body.

English Question: If a person lawfully obtains information from a Public Body but later uses it for a different purpose from the purpose for which it was obtained, which provision is potentially violated and who may complain?
Nepali Question: कुनै व्यक्तिले सार्वजनिक निकायबाट सूचना कानूनी रूपमा प्राप्त गरे पनि पछि प्राप्त गरेको उद्देश्यभन्दा फरक उद्देश्यमा प्रयोग गरेमा कुन प्रावधान सम्भावित रूपमा उल्लङ्घन हुन्छ र कसले उजुरी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Section 31 may be violated, and the concerned Public Body may complain to the Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): दफा ३१ उल्लङ्घन हुन सक्छ र सम्बन्धित सार्वजनिक निकायले आयोगसमक्ष उजुरी गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 31(1) prohibits use for a different purpose, and Section 31(2) authorizes the concerned Public Body to complain to the Commission.

English Question: A person reports probable corruption by a Public Body employee, the recipient discloses the person's identity, and the person is then removed from employment. Which protections under the Act are implicated?
Nepali Question: कुनै व्यक्तिले सार्वजनिक निकायका कर्मचारीको सम्भावित भ्रष्टाचारबारे सूचना दिएपछि सूचना प्राप्तकर्ताले उसको पहिचान सार्वजनिक गर्छ र त्यसपछि उसलाई सेवाबाट हटाइन्छ भने ऐनअन्तर्गत कुन संरक्षणहरू प्रभावित हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The duty to keep the whistleblower's identity confidential and the protection against removal or other harm for providing information.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचनादाताको पहिचान गोप्य राख्ने कर्तव्य तथा सूचना दिएको कारण सेवाबाट हटाउने वा अन्य हानि पुर्‍याउने कार्यविरुद्धको संरक्षण।
Explanation: Section 30(2) protects the whistleblower's identity, while Section 30(3) prohibits termination or harm for providing information about corruption, irregularities, or offences.

English Question: What fine may the Commission impose on the Chief of a Public Body or Information Officer who, without valid reason, withholds, refuses, partially provides, or provides wrong information, or destroys information?
Nepali Question: कुनै वैध कारणबिना सूचना लुकाउने, दिन अस्वीकार गर्ने, आंशिक वा गलत सूचना दिने वा सूचना नष्ट गर्ने सार्वजनिक निकायको प्रमुख वा सूचना अधिकारीलाई आयोगले कति जरिवाना गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A fine from NPR 1,000 to NPR 25,000.
Explanation: Section 32(1) authorizes the Commission to impose a fine of NPR 1,000 to NPR 25,000 for these forms of improper handling of information.

English Question: Which two officials may be fined under Section 32(1) for unjustifiably withholding, refusing, partially providing, or providing wrong information, or destroying information?
Nepali Question: सूचना लुकाउने, दिन अस्वीकार गर्ने, आंशिक वा गलत सूचना दिने वा सूचना नष्ट गर्ने कार्यका लागि दफा ३२(१) अन्तर्गत कुन दुई पदाधिकारीलाई जरिवाना गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief of the Public Body and the Information Officer.
Gold Answer (NE): सार्वजनिक निकायको प्रमुख र सूचना अधिकारी।
Explanation: Section 32(1) specifically applies to the Chief of a Public Body or the Information Officer.

English Question: What is the daily fine for unjustified delay in providing information that should have been provided within the prescribed time?
Nepali Question: निर्धारित समयमा उपलब्ध गराउनुपर्ने सूचना बिना कारण ढिला गरी उपलब्ध गराएमा दैनिक कति जरिवाना लाग्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): NPR 200 per day of delay.
Explanation: Section 32(2) provides a fine of NPR 200 for each day of unjustified delay in providing information that was required to be provided on time.

English Question: How does the penalty for unjustified delay in providing information differ from the penalty for withholding or improperly handling information?
Nepali Question: सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन अनुचित ढिलाइ गरेको जरिवाना र सूचना लुकाउने वा अनुचित रूपमा व्यवस्थापन गरेको जरिवानाबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Unjustified delay attracts NPR 200 per day of delay, while withholding, refusal, partial or wrong disclosure, or destruction of information may attract a fine of NPR 1,000 to NPR 25,000.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुचित ढिलाइमा ढिलाइ भएको प्रत्येक दिन रु. २०० जरिवाना लाग्छ भने सूचना लुकाउने, अस्वीकार गर्ने, आंशिक वा गलत सूचना दिने वा सूचना नष्ट गर्नेलाई रु. १,००० देखि रु. २५,००० सम्म जरिवाना हुन सक्छ।
Explanation: Sections 32(1) and 32(2) establish separate penalty structures for improper handling of information and unjustified delay.

English Question: What may the Commission do if the Chief of a Public Body or Information Officer is eligible for departmental action under Section 32(1)?
Nepali Question: दफा ३२(१) अन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायको प्रमुख वा सूचना अधिकारीमाथि विभागीय कारबाही गर्नुपर्ने अवस्था भएमा आयोगले के गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may write to the concerned Public Body for departmental action.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित सार्वजनिक निकायलाई विभागीय कारबाहीका लागि लेख्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Section 32(1) allows the Commission to write to the concerned Body for departmental action where the official is eligible for such action.

English Question: Within how long must a Public Body take departmental action after the Commission writes to it under Section 32(1)?
Nepali Question: दफा ३२(१) बमोजिम आयोगले लेखेपछि सार्वजनिक निकायले कति समयभित्र विभागीय कारबाही गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within three months.
Explanation: Section 32(3) requires the Public Body to take departmental action within three months and notify the Commission.

English Question: After a Public Body takes departmental action following a recommendation from the Commission, what additional obligation does the Public Body have?
Nepali Question: आयोगको सिफारिसपछि सार्वजनिक निकायले विभागीय कारबाही गरेपछि उसको थप दायित्व के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must notify the Commission of the departmental action.
Explanation: Section 32(3) requires the Public Body both to take departmental action within three months and notify the Commission of the action taken.

English Question: What fine may the Commission impose on a person who misuses information obtained from a Public Body instead of using it for the purpose for which it was obtained?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायबाट प्राप्त सूचना जुन प्रयोजनका लागि प्राप्त गरिएको हो त्यसको सट्टा दुरुपयोग गर्ने व्यक्तिलाई आयोगले कति जरिवाना गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A fine from NPR 5,000 to NPR 25,000, considering the seriousness of the misuse.
Gold Answer (NE): दुरुपयोगको गम्भीरता हेरी रु. ५,००० देखि रु. २५,००० सम्म।
Explanation: Section 32(4) authorizes a fine of NPR 5,000 to NPR 25,000 based on the seriousness of the misuse.

English Question: What is the maximum fine the Commission may impose on a person who does not comply with a decision or order issued under the Act?
Nepali Question: ऐनबमोजिम जारी गरिएको आयोगको निर्णय वा आदेश पालना नगर्ने व्यक्तिलाई आयोगले अधिकतम कति जरिवाना गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Up to NPR 10,000.
Explanation: Section 32(5) allows the Commission to impose a fine of up to NPR 10,000 for failure to comply with its decision or order under the Act.

English Question: Which penalty applies specifically to misuse of information, and which penalty applies to failure to comply with a Commission decision or order?
Nepali Question: सूचनाको दुरुपयोग र आयोगको निर्णय वा आदेश पालना नगरेमा क्रमशः कुन-कुन जरिवाना लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Misuse attracts NPR 5,000 to NPR 25,000, while failure to comply with a Commission decision or order may attract up to NPR 10,000.
Gold Answer (NE): दुरुपयोगमा रु. ५,००० देखि रु. २५,००० सम्म र आयोगको निर्णय वा आदेश पालना नगरेमा रु. १०,००० सम्म।
Explanation: Sections 32(4) and 32(5) establish distinct penalties for misuse of information and non-compliance with Commission decisions or orders.

English Question: A Chief of a Public Body unjustifiably delays providing information for five days, while another person misuses information obtained from a Public Body. What penalties may apply in the two cases?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायको प्रमुखले सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन पाँच दिनसम्म बिना कारण ढिलाइ गरेमा र अर्को व्यक्तिले सार्वजनिक निकायबाट प्राप्त सूचना दुरुपयोग गरेमा दुवै अवस्थामा कस्ता जरिवाना लागू हुन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief may be fined NPR 1,000 for the five-day delay, while the person misusing the information may be fined NPR 5,000 to NPR 25,000 depending on the seriousness of the misuse.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रमुखलाई पाँच दिनको ढिलाइका लागि रु. १,००० जरिवाना हुन सक्छ भने सूचना दुरुपयोग गर्ने व्यक्तिलाई दुरुपयोगको गम्भीरताअनुसार रु. ५,००० देखि रु. २५,००० सम्म जरिवाना हुन सक्छ।
Explanation: Under Section 32(2), the delay penalty is NPR 200 per day, resulting in NPR 1,000 for five days. Section 32(4) separately provides a NPR 5,000–25,000 fine for misuse.

English Question: What are the four distinct monetary penalty structures under Section 32 for improper information handling, unjustified delay, misuse of information, and non-compliance with a Commission decision or order?
Nepali Question: सूचना अनुचित रूपमा व्यवस्थापन गर्ने, बिना कारण ढिलाइ गर्ने, सूचना दुरुपयोग गर्ने र आयोगको निर्णय वा आदेश पालना नगर्ने कार्यका लागि दफा ३२ अन्तर्गतका चार फरक मौद्रिक दण्ड संरचना के-के हुन्?
Gold Answer (EN): NPR 1,000–25,000 for unjustified withholding, refusal, partial or wrong information, or destruction; NPR 200 per day for unjustified delay; NPR 5,000–25,000 for misuse; and up to NPR 10,000 for non-compliance with a Commission decision or order.
Gold Answer (NE): अनुचित रूपमा सूचना लुकाउने, दिन अस्वीकार गर्ने, आंशिक वा गलत सूचना दिने वा सूचना नष्ट गर्नेमा रु. १,०००–२५,०००; बिना कारण ढिलाइमा दैनिक रु. २००; सूचनाको दुरुपयोगमा रु. ५,०००–२५,०००; र आयोगको निर्णय वा आदेश पालना नगरेमा रु. १०,००० सम्म।
Explanation: Section 32(1)–(5) establishes four separate penalty regimes with different triggering conduct and monetary thresholds.

English Question: Who may file a petition for compensation under Section 33?
Nepali Question: दफा ३३ अन्तर्गत क्षतिपूर्तिका लागि कसले निवेदन दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A person who has suffered loss or damage due to the specified failure or improper handling of information.
Gold Answer (NE): तोकिएको सूचना उपलब्ध नगराउने वा अनुचित रूपमा व्यवस्थापन गर्ने कार्यबाट हानि वा क्षति व्यहोरेको व्यक्ति।
Explanation: Section 33(1) allows a person who incurs loss or damage due to failure to provide, refusal to provide, partial or wrong information, or destruction of information to file a compensation petition.

English Question: What actions by a Chief or Information Officer may give rise to a person's right to seek compensation under Section 33?
Nepali Question: प्रमुख वा सूचना अधिकारीका कुन कार्यबाट व्यक्तिलाई दफा ३३ अन्तर्गत क्षतिपूर्ति माग्ने अधिकार उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Failure to provide information, refusal to provide information, providing partial or wrong information, or destroying information, where the person suffers loss or damage.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना उपलब्ध नगराउनु, सूचना दिन अस्वीकार गर्नु, आंशिक वा गलत सूचना दिनु वा सूचना नष्ट गर्नु, जसबाट व्यक्तिलाई हानि वा क्षति भएको अवस्थामा।
Explanation: Section 33(1) identifies these four forms of conduct as grounds for seeking compensation when they cause loss or damage.

English Question: Within what period must a person file a compensation petition before the Commission under Section 33?
Nepali Question: दफा ३३ अन्तर्गत व्यक्तिले आयोगसमक्ष क्षतिपूर्तिको निवेदन कति अवधिभित्र दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Within three months.
Explanation: Section 33(1) requires the compensation petition to be filed within three months from the relevant failure, partial or wrong disclosure, or restriction of information.

English Question: On what basis may the Commission award compensation after investigating a compensation petition?
Nepali Question: क्षतिपूर्तिको निवेदनमाथि छानबिन गरेपछि आयोगले कुन आधारमा क्षतिपूर्ति दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It may award a reasonable amount based on the actual loss suffered.
Gold Answer (NE): भएको वास्तविक क्षतिको आधारमा उचित रकम।
Explanation: Section 33(2) provides that, if the petition is found reasonable, the Commission may award a reasonable amount after considering the actual loss.

English Question: From whom may the Commission order compensation to be paid when a compensation petition is found reasonable?
Nepali Question: क्षतिपूर्तिको निवेदन उचित ठहरिएमा आयोगले क्षतिपूर्ति कसबाट उपलब्ध गराउन आदेश दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): From the concerned Public Body.
Explanation: Section 33(2) provides that the Commission may compensate the applicant from the concerned Public Body after considering the actual loss.

English Question: What is the difference between the remedy for loss caused by failure to provide information and the remedy against a decision of the Commission under Section 32?
Nepali Question: सूचना उपलब्ध नगराउँदा भएको क्षतिका लागि उपलब्ध उपचार र दफा ३२ अन्तर्गत आयोगले गरेको निर्णयविरुद्धको उपचारबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer (EN): A person suffering loss or damage may file a compensation petition before the Commission within three months under Section 33, while a person dissatisfied with a Commission decision under Section 32 may appeal to the Appellate Court within thirty-five days under Section 34.
Gold Answer (NE): हानि वा क्षति व्यहोरेको व्यक्तिले दफा ३३ अन्तर्गत तीन महिनाभित्र आयोगसमक्ष क्षतिपूर्तिको निवेदन दिन सक्छ भने दफा ३४ अन्तर्गत आयोगको निर्णयबाट असन्तुष्ट व्यक्तिले पैंतीस दिनभित्र पुनरावेदन अदालतमा पुनरावेदन गर्न सक्छ।
Explanation: Sections 33 and 34 establish different remedies, deadlines, and forums: compensation before the Commission for qualifying loss, and appeal to the Appellate Court against a Commission decision under Section 32.

English Question: Who may apply for the correction of information held by a Public Body that they believe is wrong?
Nepali Question: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सूचना गलत छ भन्ने विश्वास भएमा त्यसको सुधारका लागि कसले आवेदन दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Any person who believes that the information is wrong.
Gold Answer (NE): सूचना गलत छ भन्ने विश्वास भएको कुनै पनि व्यक्ति।
Explanation: Section 35(1) allows anyone who believes that information held by a Public Body on a particular matter is wrong to apply for its correction.

English Question: To whom must an application for correction of wrong information be submitted, and what must accompany the application?
Nepali Question: गलत सूचना सच्याउनको लागि आवेदन कसलाई दिनुपर्छ र आवेदनसँगै के पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): It must be submitted to the concerned Chief together with necessary evidence.
Gold Answer (NE): सम्बन्धित प्रमुखसमक्ष आवश्यक प्रमाणसहित पेश गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 35(1) requires the application to be made to the concerned Chief and accompanied by necessary evidence.

English Question: What must the Chief do after investigating an application for correction and finding that the information is wrong?
Nepali Question: सूचना सच्याउन दिइएको आवेदनमाथि छानबिन गर्दा सूचना गलत पाइएमा प्रमुखले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Chief must correct the information and inform the applicant within seven days from the date of the application.
Gold Answer (NE): प्रमुखले सूचना सच्याई आवेदन दिएको मितिले सात दिनभित्र आवेदकलाई जानकारी गराउनुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 35(2) requires the Chief to conduct the necessary investigation and, if the information is found to be wrong, correct it and inform the applicant within seven days of the application.

English Question: What protection does Section 36 provide to a Chief or Information Officer who performs information-dissemination work in good faith?
Nepali Question: दफा ३६ ले सद्भावनापूर्वक सूचना प्रसारसम्बन्धी काम गर्ने प्रमुख वा सूचना अधिकारीलाई कस्तो संरक्षण प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): No case may be filed and no punishment may be imposed against them for such work.
Gold Answer (NE): त्यस्तो कामका लागि उनीहरूविरुद्ध मुद्दा चलाउन वा सजाय गर्न पाइँदैन।
Explanation: Section 36 protects a Chief or Information Officer from legal proceedings and punishment for work related to information dissemination performed in good faith.

English Question: How does the Act determine which law applies to matters covered by the Act and matters not covered by it?
Nepali Question: ऐनमा समेटिएका र ऐनमा नसमेटिएका विषयमा कुन कानून लागू हुने व्यवस्था ऐनले गरेको छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Matters covered by the Act must be dealt with under this Act, while other matters must be dealt with under the prevailing laws.
Gold Answer (NE): ऐनमा उल्लिखित विषयहरू यसै ऐनबमोजिम र अन्य विषयहरू प्रचलित कानूनबमोजिम कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Section 37 establishes the Act as the governing law for matters it covers and refers other matters to prevailing laws.

English Question: Who makes the Rules necessary to implement the objectives of the Act, and what procedural requirement applies before doing so?
Nepali Question: ऐनका उद्देश्य कार्यान्वयन गर्न आवश्यक नियम कसले बनाउँछ र नियम बनाउनुअघि कुन प्रक्रियागत आवश्यकता पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The Government of Nepal makes the Rules after consultation with the Commission.
Gold Answer (NE): आयोगसँग परामर्श गरी नेपाल सरकारले नियम बनाउँछ।
Explanation: Section 38 authorizes the Government of Nepal to frame necessary Rules upon consultation with the Commission to implement the objectives of the Act.
